briefs.name: 環境微生物學
briefs.tags: 微生物生態，環境微生物學，微生物指標，應用微生物學，生物環境復育
briefs.desc: 本課程著重於環境微生物之基礎、生態與其在環境科學上的應用。微生物基礎部分包括細菌、真菌、藻類等微生物之分類、形態 和生理基本特性、培養、生長、代謝與控制等學理與操作技術等。而微生物生態則以其碳、氮循環與個別代謝的生化反應為基 礎，說明各類微生物於環境生態中所扮演的角色和重要性。同時說名類微生物之特殊生理代謝能力得於應用在能源工業、廢水和 廢棄物處理、生態環境復育，及農業等領域的學理依據與技術。

briefs.name: 永續環境治理的設計思考
briefs.nameEn: Design Thinking for Sustainable Environmental Governance
briefs.tags: 永續環境治理 Sustainable Environmental Governance,設計思考 Design Thinking,流域治理 Watershed Governance,水資源管理 Water Resource Management,社會實踐與公民參與 Social Practice and Civic Engagement
briefs.desc: 本課程以頭前溪流域為學習場域，結合永續發展目標（SDGs）、環境治理與設計思考方法，帶領學生從真實世界問題出發，探討 河川生態、水質污染、水資源治理、環境正義及地方文化等議題。課程透過課堂講授、實地走讀、專家座談、資料分析與團隊 專題等方式，培養學生跨域整合、問題分析、利害關係人溝通及社會實踐能力。學生將運用設計思考流程，發展兼顧環境、社 會與治理面向之創新方案，並藉由與在地社群、學校及公民團體互動，深化對流域治理與公共參與的理解，培養面對永續發展 挑戰所需之專業能力與社會責任。

briefs.name: 專題演講
briefs.tags: 批判思考（critical thinking), 邏輯訓練(logistic training), 時間管理(time management), 資料整理（Literature Review), 專業養成(Professional Training)
briefs.desc: 此課程主要培養碩博士班研究生對各領域新知的批判思考能力。藉由邀請國內外優秀學者前來進行近年來不同領域的新知演講， 除讓研究生瞭解各領域重要的學術發展新知，也培養學生對於新知的學習與批判思考能力。 This course is designed for master and Ph.D. students to strengthen their advanced knowledge and critial thinking skills. The professional training, time management, and logistic training abilities will also be emphasized in this course.

briefs.name: 碩士班專題研究
briefs.tags: 專題
briefs.desc: 由各指導教授指導碩士班學生進行研究

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: 研究生(postgraduate students), 文獻整理 (literature review), 口頭宣讀報告(oral presentation), 問題回答(Q &A), 尖端技術(Cutting-edge Technology), 邏輯訓練(logic training)
briefs.desc: 本課程主要培養碩士生文獻資料彙整與口頭報告的能力與技巧。藉由與論文相關最新文獻資料的蒐集與整理，增進研究生 對論 文領域最新發展技術的深入瞭解，同時藉由上台報告及問答過程的訓練，培養學生口頭報告及對問題提問與回答的技巧，進 而 促進學生對專業領域及跨領域的認識與邏輯訓練。

briefs.name: 環境化學
briefs.tags: 化學反應(Chemical reaction), 水化學（Aquatic Chemistry), 大氣化學(Atmospheric Chemistry), 天然環境(Natural Environment), 污染物宿命（Fate and Transport)
briefs.desc: This course is designed for postgraduate students who have learned analytical chemistry and physical chemistry. The main goal of this course is to provide comprehensive chemistry principles to instruct students to learn the advanced knowledge in chemical reaction of chemicals in the natural environment. Several main topics in aquatic chemistry and atmospheric chemistry will be addressed.

briefs.name: 表面分析技術
briefs.tags: 電子光譜, 表面增強光譜, 表面分析, electron spectroscopy, surface enhanced spectroscopy, surface analysis
briefs.desc: This course is designed to provide a basic understanding of surface analysis techniques and the applications how surface analysis can be utilized in research. In addition to conventional characterization, advanced experimental design for surface analysis, such as synchrotron-based techniques, in situ methodologies and time-resolved experiments, are also introduced in this course.

briefs.name: 環境質譜分析
briefs.tags: 環境質譜分析、新興污染物、層析分離技術、微量分析、環境監測 Environmental Mass Spectrometry、Emerging Contaminants、Chromatographic Separation、Trace Analysis、Environmental Monitoring
briefs.desc: 本課程介紹質譜技術於環境分析之原理與應用，涵蓋液相與氣相層析串聯質譜（LC–MS/MS、GC–MS/MS）及感應耦合電漿質譜 （ICP–MS），並說明不同類型污染物之分析策略。課程強調環境污染物之檢測原理與應用，培養學生於環境監測與污染分析之基 本能力。

briefs.name: 當代環境醫學特論一
briefs.nameEn: Specific Topic for Contemporary Environmental Medicine (I)
briefs.tags: Environmental Medicine, Human Epidemiology, System-specific Toxicology, Environmental Biology, Human Health, 環境醫學，人類流行病學，系統特定的毒理學，環境生物學，人類健康
briefs.desc: 引導學生研讀當今環境醫學領域重要期刊的習慣與能力，並訓練修課學生口頭報告答辯與發問的技巧。同時鼓勵修課學生分享 自己的研究成果，以發覺自己的潛力及未來可能的研發領域。

briefs.name: 環境新興污染物
briefs.tags: Emerging Contaminants, Water Pollution, Water Reuse, Wastewater Treatment, Environmental Science and Engineering
briefs.desc: This course will introduce the detection and analysis methods, environmental occurrence/distribution, environmental fate and treatment technology of emerging pollutants in water environments.

briefs.name: 空氣汙染控制
briefs.tags: 空氣污染, 粒狀物, 氣狀物, 污染控制，環境工程 Air pollution, particulates, gaseous pollutants, pollution control, environmental engineering
briefs.desc: 介紹粒狀及氣狀空氣污染物控制的方法和設備,讓學生瞭解目前工業界常用的控制設備及其設計操作原理,並說明各種控制設備的 收集效率及應用. Introduces the methods and equipment for controlling granular and gaseous air pollutants, allowing students to understand the control equipment commonly used in the industry and its design and operating principles, and explain the collection efficiency and application of various control equipment.

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文, Thesis
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 專題書報討論
briefs.tags: 口頭表達 oral presentation
briefs.desc: A one-semester course teaching graduate students how to deliver an oral presentation. Students will be required to give presentation and host a discussion session. The topics are limited to the areas of students' specialties.

briefs.name: 博士班專題研究一
briefs.tags: 論文研究, Thesis
briefs.desc: 於本所規劃之「分析化學」、「生態與健康」及「綠色科技」等三大發展領域中，在指導教授的指導下擬定研究題目，並針對 研究主題培養資料收集、實驗規劃、專業實驗技術及相關知識的能力，同時訓練系統性思考組織能力與實驗技術，提昇學生解 決問題的能力。

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文, Thesis
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 統計學暨實習--台大
briefs.tags: Statistics
briefs.desc: This course introduces students to the core concepts and methods of statistics, with a focus on learning how to use data effectively in the face of uncertainty. Key topics include data visualization, descriptive statistics, probability, statistical inference, and linear regression. Emphasis will be placed on building intuition and practical understanding rather than mathematical rigor. Students will develop the skills to make sense of data, draw meaningful conclusions, and communicate results with clarity and confidence. The tools and thinking developed in this course are valuable for making informed decisions and conducting research across a wide range of disciplines. They also form the foundation of many modern applications, including machine learning and artificial intelligence.

briefs.name: 基礎程式設計(C++)--陽明交大
briefs.tags: 程式,邏輯思考,人工智慧,專題應用
briefs.desc: 本門課程設計從基礎的程式設計開始，透過循序漸進的修課規劃，讓學生除有完備的人工智慧技術外，也了解相關倫理議 題，最後透過人工智慧專題應用，讓學生們?972;解人工智慧技術在產業上?768;地的考?870;。因此本課程設定適合所有跨 域(非電資專業)的學生。旨在培養學生運用邏輯思維解決問題的能力，位居人類知識版圖中「計算思維」與「工具理性」的 交會處。程式設計不再只是工程師的專利，而是現代公民理解世界與參與社會的基本素養之一。從智慧型手機應用到醫療數 據分析，程式無所不在；本課程讓來自不同背景的學生能以程式語言參與這個由數位邏輯驅動的社會。透過設計演算法、撰 寫簡易應用程式，學生將不僅學會「如何寫程式」，更能體會「如何用邏輯思考」，落實人類追求真理、效率與創新之普世價 值。

briefs.name: 人工智慧導論--成大
briefs.tags: intelligent agents, AI applications,statistical learning,problem-solving methods
briefs.desc: This course introduces students to the fundamentals, problem-solving methods, and learning paradigms of artificial intelligence. Topics covered include intelligent agents, uninformed and informed searching, adversarial search and games, statistical learning, neural networks, and AI applications.

briefs.name: 金融科技導論--台大
briefs.desc: 金融科技(Financial Technology, FinTech)是目前全球金融業與科技業的焦點，它所引發的破壞式創新，正挑戰既有金融 服務的供給方式和消費行為。本課程由資工、數學教授群共同開設，旨在釐清 FinTech 本質、相關的創新科技、以及關鍵的趨 勢。 同時我們也會在課程當中邀請相關學者專家進行演講，並在金融機構（或金融科技新創公司）的協助之下完成期末的AI程式競 賽。歡迎想參與或是有志於跨金融與科技領域的同學們，來共同一窺金融科技殿堂之美。

briefs.name: 機器學習--台大
briefs.desc: Machine learning allows computational systems to adaptively improve their performance with experience accumulated from the data observed. This course introduces the basics of learning theories, the design and analysis of learning algorithms, and some applications of machine learning.

briefs.name: 智慧人機互動--北科大
briefs.tags: AI,interaction,互動設計
briefs.desc: 隨著生成式AI與大型語言模型迅速融入設計流程與數位產品開發，互動設計者需具備整合AI技術與人機介面設計的跨域素 養。本課程旨在探討人工智慧技術於人機互動設計中的應用，培養學生設計與開發智慧互動系統的核心能力。課程內容涵蓋 人機互動及互動設計之基本概念、語意理解與回應機制、以及AI驅動之使用者體驗創新。教學上將透過講述法和工作坊建立 基礎觀念，搭配上機實作強化技術操作能力，並以專題導向學習形式，引導學生完成從構思到原型開發之完整設計流程。 As generative AI and large language models (LLMs) reshape design processes, interaction designers must integrate AI technologies with human-computer interface design to enhance the user experience. This course explores the application of AI in human-computer interaction (HCI), focusing on essential skills for developing intelligent interactive systems. Topics include HCI fundamentals, semantic understanding and response mechanisms, and AI-driven innovations in user experience. Lectures build theoretical foundations, hands-on practice strengthens te

briefs.name: 生成式AI:文字與圖像生成的原理與實務-政大
briefs.nameEn: Generative AI: Text and Image Synthesis Principles and Practice--NCCU
briefs.tags: 神經網路, GAN, Transformer, 大型語言模型, RAG, AI Agents, Diffusion Models
briefs.desc: 「生成式 AI：文字與圖像生成的原理與實務」是一門兼具理論深度與實作樂趣的課程，專為希望深入了解生成式 AI 的技術與 應用的學生而設計。不論對 AI 的認識是基礎還是進階，我們都希望透過這門課程，帶領同學探索生成式 AI 的無限可能。學 生將會學習神經網路、GAN、Transformer、大型語言模型、RAG、AI Agents、Diffusion Models 等技術，並運用工具如 OpenAI API、LangChain、HuggingFace 及 AISuite 等等，完成從文字生成到圖像生成的多樣應用。

briefs.name: 實體人工智慧--陽明交大
briefs.desc: In this course, Physical AI serves as the central lens through which all projects and discussions are contextualized. Students will explore how modern AI models are integrated into real-world systems such as robots, smart homes, and autonomous vehicles, and how intelligence, embodiment, and environment jointly shape system behavior. As AI systems increasingly operate around us in everyday life, critical questions emerge: How do these systems function in real-world settings? How do we ensure their reliability, safety, and alignment with human values? And what new challenges arise when AI is deployed in open, dynamic environments? If these questions inspire you, this course is designed for you.

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文研究, Thesis
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行深入研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之創新性成果。

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 文化人類學專題
briefs.tags: cultural anthropology, social anthropology, theory
briefs.desc: This course serves as an introduction to some of the key concepts and developments in the field of cultural anthropology. We will examine the basic ideas and debates that shaped the discipline and look at how anthropology might contribute to our understanding of contemporary world.

briefs.name: 中國考古學
briefs.tags: 中國考古學史，中國早期的狩獵採集者，中國新石器時代，中國青銅時代，中國文明的形成，the history of Archaeology in China, the ancient hunters and gathers in China, the Neolithic age of China, the Bronze age of China, the formation of Chinese civilization
briefs.desc: 自二十世紀初現代考古學從西方傳入中國，這門學問便很快地在歷史悠久、族群及文化多元的中國土地上生根成長，至今已取 得了大量的研究資料和豐富的研究成果，不只對促進中國古代人類文化和歷史研究及文明進程的新理解有重要的貢獻，即使對 其它人文、社會科學，甚而自然科學領域的一些研究課題，例如:中國古代的社會型態、經濟變遷、工藝美術、科技發展、宗 教禮制、民族發展、族群遺傳、農業起源和天文星象等，也提供了非常珍貴的出土資料與證據。有些考古發現甚而成為令人嚮 往的世界文化遺產。因此，過去半個多世紀以來的這段時間，考古學在中國成為一門顯學，被稱為是中國考古學的黃金時代。 本課程的目的是要介紹中國考古學的發展、發現，以及重要的研究成果和所探討的重要課題，期使選課的同學對中 國考古學有所認識和瞭解，並培養研究的視野、興趣和發展的能力。

briefs.name: 身體與文化
briefs.tags: embodiment, biopower, bodily practice, habitus, sex and gender, Body and the Senses, sport, medical technology, consumption, fashion
briefs.desc: 本課程為人類所的選修課程，大四學生也可選修。課程著重於人類學對身體的探討、及身體與文化相關面向的研究。希望藉由經 典文獻與相關主題的文本研讀，介紹人類學研究身體的相關理論、概念與研究成果，培養學生對於身體研究的興趣，理解身體與 文化的密切關係，並能進一步運用在日後的實際研究中。

briefs.name: 陶瓷與世界史研究專題
briefs.tags: 陶瓷,世界史,文化資產, 考古學,物質文化, ceramics, world history, cultural heritage, archaeology, material culture
briefs.desc: 陶瓷是研究季風亞洲區域歷史發展最主要的考古材料之一。本課程將引導同學熟悉涵蓋九世紀到二十世紀東亞、東南亞海域出土、出水的陶 瓷器類別，尤其是貿易陶瓷的部分，並同時討論生產技術的發展與傳播、運輸航路與消費地的脈絡與再脈絡化、科學分析資料等等。 本課程為討論課，學生將專責收集特定主題的材料於課堂上發表，並藉由實際接觸庫房材料、建置檔案了解考古學觀察陶瓷器的重點。

briefs.name: 當代人類學理論
briefs.tags: anthropological theory, cultural anthropology, contemporary theory
briefs.desc: This course provides an overview of the major issues in anthropology since the 1970s. While it attempts to cover most of the dominant themes, it concentrates on those that remain influential today. These include all the major issues from classical anthropological theories. As a reminder: What accounts for the stability of practices and social forms? What accounts for their transformation? When thinking about stability or change, what kinds of people or things are attributed “agency,” or the power to impact social outcomes whether large or small? To what extent is something like “consciousness” important when thinking about “agentive” action? At what temporal or social scale should we think about any of these questions? Are there sociologically meaningful “groups,” in the sense of distinctive social units that persist through time and space? What counts as a “group”? What are the processes that make people part of such groups? How deeply does that process p

briefs.name: 文化人類學田野實習
briefs.tags: 研究方法, 田野工作, 民族誌, research methodology, fieldwork, ethnography
briefs.desc: 本課程為《人類學方法論》的進階課程，主要目的在於訓練學生具有從事獨立研究之能力。所有選修過《人類學方法論》之同 學，必須在暑假期間從事一個短期的可行性田野研究，實際體驗田野調查工作，練習操作人類學之研究方法，整理及分析田野資 料，最後並將之書寫成研究成果報告，在學生之田野實習成果發表會中公開發表。期使學生經由實際之田野經驗，對人類學研究 之性質及方法有進一步地認識。最後，我們希望田野實習能做為學生將來發展其碩、博士論文的基礎。未修過《人類學方法論》 者，無法修選本門課，請留意。

briefs.name: 考古學田野實習
briefs.tags: 考古田野,研究計畫,考古理論,分析技術,考古材料, archaeological fieldwork, research plan, archaeological theory, analysis, archaeological material
briefs.desc: 本課程為碩士班有志以考古學為畢業論文主題的學生之必修課程，旨在協助學生於碩一暑假田野結束後更有系統的消化田野經驗，並實際轉 化成論文研究計畫。

briefs.name: 原住民族與國家
briefs.tags: Historical and Transitional Justice; Settler Colonialism, Fourth World, Neoliberalism, Reconciliation (歷史與轉型正義/定居殖民主義/第四世界/新自由主義/和解)
briefs.desc: This seminar examines the relationships between the indigenous peoples and the state in Taiwan through historical periods, situating it in the settler colonial contexts. Historical reflection on the changing relationship between the indigenous peoples and the state equipped students to explain the contemporary dilemma faced by the indigenous people worldwide. With the concept of transitional justice emerging in Taiwan and elsewhere, this seminar will draw on materials and experiences in other Fourth World to compare with those of Taiwan’s indigenous peoples and seek to advance a better path forward.

briefs.name: 情感政治與倫理生活
briefs.nameEn: The politics of emotion and Ethical Life
briefs.tags: Emotion, Affect, Ethnic, Morality, Anthropology
briefs.desc: 在日常生活中，許多時候情緒與倫理幾乎無法分開，而這份交纏並不止於私人生活，在現代制度之中同樣運作。本課程便從這份交纏出發， 借助人類學中兩個重要卻長期平行發展的理論傳統來理解它：倫理轉向（ethical turn）與情緒人類學（anthropology of emotions）。前者問的是人們如何在日常生活中成為倫理主體，後者則把情緒當作一個可以被田野觀察與描述的問題，去看人們如何在語 言、身體與人際關係之中感受、命名並賦予情緒意義。情緒的養成與倫理主體的形成，何以在許多時候難以分開，正是這門課想要一路追問 的問題。

briefs.name: 臺灣恆春半島史前考古學專題
briefs.nameEn: Prehistoric Archaeology of the Hengchun Peninsula, Taiwan Seminar Course
briefs.tags: 恆春半島考古、鵝鑾鼻考古遺址群、生態適應、工藝技術、南島語族起源 Archaeology of the Hengchun Peninsula, Eluanbi Archaeological Site, Complex Ecological Adaptation, Craft Technology, Origins of the Austronesian Peoples
briefs.desc: 本專題課程聚焦臺灣最南端的恆春半島，自約五千年前舊石器時代晚期延續型文化至金屬器時代之發展歷程，該時期不僅銜接 史前與歷史階段，更構成臺灣近代史的重要基礎場景。課程聚焦考古學文化類型討論、生態人類學與跨領域自然科學研究方 法，引導學生探索史前文化的變遷脈絡與族群互動，培養整合分析與問題探究能力。 在內容設計上，首先認識各時期史前考古文化之內涵，進一步深入探討史前人群如何因應多元的海陸域生態環境，發展出 漁撈、狩獵、採集與栽培作物利用的複合型生業模式。這些多樣化的適應策略，使恆春半島的史前時代出現高度多元適應型 態，從生計韌性理論（Resilience Theory in Archaeology）探討該區域在不同時期的適應模式。其次，物質文化以貝器加 工場為核心，分析其工藝技術與器物類型，說明其在南島語族臺灣起源論中的重要性，並探討其所呈現的專業分工與區域交流 現象。培養學生對臺灣史前文化的系統性認識，並建立其對人群遷徙、環境適應與文化交流之整體理解。此外透過玉石器、骨 角牙器與陶器類型的比較研究，課程將引導學生辨識臺灣東西部之間可能存在的史前交通要道，理解物質文化如何呈現文化傳 播與區域互動的線索。最後，結合體質

briefs.name: 石器分析
briefs.tags: 石器、考古學、製作技術、分類、經濟文化
briefs.desc: 本課程將引導學生系統性認識考古學中石器研究的核心理論與分析方法，透過討論與案例分析，理解石器在重建人類行為與社會組織中的關 鍵角色。石器作為考古遺存中最常見且保存良好的材料之一，不僅提供了理解史前技術與日常實踐的證據，更是連結環境、經濟與文化行為 的重要媒介。課程內容涵蓋石器的類型特徵、原料選擇與取得策略、製作技術與操作序列、分類原則等基礎，以及技術組織理論、功能研 究、實驗考古學、民族考古學、過程與後過程等分析取徑，也討論如何從石器探討生計活動、勞動分工、資源利用與貿易交換等議題。透過 系統性的理論學習、案例研讀與實作訓練，學生將建立石器辨識、記錄與分析的基礎能力，也理解石器技術與使用策略所反映的人群行為與 文化意義，並能將相關分析方法應用於實際研究。

briefs.name: 想像與圖像
briefs.tags: 人類學、想像、圖像、相化、他者
briefs.desc: 本課程是想像人類學的研究系列，將討論想像與圖像的相化問題。包括當代圖像的入侵、想像新體制的質問、相化他者與自我的拉 扯問題、相化的場域、形狀與時刻等。除了想像與圖像的知識系譜的認識，也將討論一些想像民族誌的圖像案例，以及進行田野調 查的實作練習。

briefs.name: 南島飲食文化與身體哲學
briefs.nameEn: Food Cultures and Bodily Philosophies of Austronesian-speaking Peoples
briefs.tags: Austronesian-speaking peoples/南島語族, Oceania/大洋洲, Taiwan/台灣, food cultures/飲食文化, bodily philosophies/身體哲學
briefs.desc: Conceptually, the Austronesian language family includes Micronesia, Melanesia, and Polynesia. While this course will discuss Taiwan and the Oceania region separately by theme, it will adopt the perspective of "Our Sea of Islands," shifting the political geography of Taiwan's Indigenous peoples from East Asia into Oceania. Through the concepts of food and bodily encounters, as well as wayfinding, the course will explore the food cultures and sensory concepts of the island communities in Oceania, facilitating an understanding of the differences and similarities between the Indigenous peoples of Taiwan and Oceania. Practically, this course will focus on discussions and hands-on activities related to food culture and the bodily issues it encompasses. The course will begin with Taiwan's Indigenous peoples and extend into the Oceania region, examining the essence of different foods, their ritual significance, social implications, sensory experiences,

briefs.name: 天文物理導論
briefs.tags: astrophysics天文物理, observational astronomy觀測天文學, radiative transfer輻射轉移, stellar physics恆星物理, interstellar medium星系介質
briefs.desc: This course is aimed at building a solid foundation for science majors inclined to pursue research in astronomy-related fields. Lectures in the first semester cover broad, considerable knowledge of modern astrophysics, including astronomical measurements, physical processes in celestial objects, dynamics in stellar systems, the Solar system objects, etc. Students must have prerequisite skills in Physics at the undergraduate level unless otherwise approved by the instructor.

briefs.name: 近代宇宙學導論
briefs.tags: Cosmology, Astronomy, Astrophysics, Cosmological Observations, Galaxy Formation
briefs.desc: This course is an undergraduate-level introduction to physical cosmology: the application of basic physics concepts to study the origin and evolution of the Universe. The emphasis will be on the "big picture" of how we learn about the structure and evolution of the universe from astronomical observations.

briefs.name: 系外行星導論
briefs.tags: astronomical observations, exoplanet detection, exoplanet atmosphere, planet formation, planetary orbits
briefs.desc: The field of extra-solar planets, i.e. exoplanet, has become a popular and important subject in astronomy and astrophysics. This course will provide students opportunities to learn about the background, the knowledge, and the research of exoplanets.

briefs.name: 星系天文學
briefs.tags: Astronomy, Astrophysics, Galaxy Observations, Galaxy Formation, Galaxy Evolution
briefs.desc: This course is a graduate-level introduction to theories and observations of galaxy formation and evolution, in the concordance Dark Energy and Cold Dark Matter (LambdaCDM) cosmogony. It is a core course of the Institute for Astronomy graduate syllabus.

briefs.name: 專題演講一
briefs.tags: Colloquium, Seminar, Astronomy, Presentation Skills, Professional Development
briefs.desc: This is the weekly colloquium of the NTHU Institute of Astronomy. Talks in a wide range of fields in astronomy and astrophysics will be delivered by visiting speakers.

briefs.name: 天文研究演講
briefs.tags: Astronomy, Seminar, Presentation Skills, Professional Development
briefs.desc: This course provides a structured forum for graduate students to present their research, develop professional-level scientific presentation skills, and become familiar with the breadth of ongoing research within the institute, fostering scientific discussion and potential collaboration.

briefs.name: 天文物理的前沿一
briefs.tags: latest papers arxiv preprints cutting-edge
briefs.desc: It is an essential task for all researchers to stay current with the latest publications in their field. However, in the field of astronomy alone, nearly 40 new papers are published every day. It is a significant amount of work to stay abreast of such a flood of papers. The purpose of this course is to train students on how to efficiently read and comprehend the essence of new research papers within a limited timeframe. Students should aim to spend no more than one hour reading a paper of their choice and then take turns presenting a concise summary in 10 minutes. The focus should be on understanding the core ideas rather than delving into the details. It is not necessary to read every detail of the paper. Additionally, this format provides other students in the class with a valuable opportunity to learn about the latest papers while listening to the speaker. After each presentation, the instructor will teach a relevant physics concept related to the concep

briefs.name: 天文觀測
briefs.tags: 天文觀測, 天文物理, 數據分析, astronomical observations, astrophysics, data analysis
briefs.desc: The course will cover astronomical observations across the electromagnetic spectrum, an introduction to gravitational wave and neutrino observatories, and statistical analysis of astronomical data.

briefs.name: 電波天文學
briefs.tags: Astronomy天文,Radio Astronomy電波天文學,Telescope望遠鏡,Observational Astrophysics觀測天文學,Radio Signals電波訊號
briefs.desc: This course is intended for graduate and senior undergraduate students whose major is Physics or Astrophysics. We will discuss various aspects of radio astronomy, such topics as the nature of radio signals, signal processing, designs of receiving systems, atmospheric effects, and observing strategies with modern radio observatories, including single-aperture telescopes and interferometric arrays. The class is aimed at building a foundation for students to further pursue astrophysical research in the radio and (sub)millimeter waveband.

briefs.name: 高能天文物理
briefs.tags: astrophysics, high-energy astrophysics, radiation mechanisms, particle acceleration, astronomical accretion
briefs.desc: This course, High Energy Astrophysics (ASTR6350), is aiming at providing students a general introduction to the basics and topics in high energy astrophysics. It consists of two parts: The first is an overview on various physical processes relevant to phenomena in high energy astrophysics. The second is several selected topics.

briefs.name: 計算天文物理
briefs.tags: computational astrophysics, programming, agentic coding, vibe coding
briefs.desc: Computational astrophysics is being reshaped by large language models (LLMs) and AI coding tools, which are changing how scientific software is written, tested, and maintained. This graduate course teaches AI-assisted coding as a practical methodology and applies it directly to core problems in computational astrophysics. The course has two intertwined goals. First, students will build enough working understanding of how LLMs operate to use them deliberately rather than superstitiously. Second, and primarily, students will apply AI-assisted workflows to develop, debug, and validate real astrophysical codes, from a simple orbit integrator up to a fluid solver and a machine-learning project. The emphasis throughout is on amplifying computational skill, not replacing it. AI tools can accelerate a capable researcher dramatically, but they can also produce wrong results with great confidence. Learning to tell the difference is the central skill this course aims to deve

briefs.name: 專題演講
briefs.tags: Artificial intelligence, biomedical sensors, smart biomaterials, data science, bioimaging, structural biology, neural science, biomedical imaging.
briefs.desc: Brief Course Description (required) BAI Colloquium delves into the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) and high-performance computing across scientific and biomedical domains, e.g., brain-machine interfaces, biosensors, precision medicine. Domain experts (Scholars and key opinion leader from industry) will be invited to give a talk, followed by Q&A.

briefs.name: 統計與機器學習概論一
briefs.nameEn: Introduction of Statistics and Machine Learning (I)
briefs.teacher: 楊立威,羅中泉,竹村和浩
briefs.tags: Statistics, 統計, Machine Learning, 機器學習, Python
briefs.desc: 統計與機器學習概論一 (Introduction of Statistics and Machine Learning (I)) is designed for machine learning beginners where many examples (but not all) are made for students with biomedical background. The class lays a sufficient mathematical foundation for its sequel class 統計與機器學習概論二 (Introduction of Statistics and Machine Learning (II)) that we recommend against students to take if MLI or similar has never been taken. These relevant mathematical concept and details include but not limited to relation between statistics and probability, concept of and inference from sampling, distributions, linear algebra, linear transformation, regression and correlation, Goodness-of-fit test, discriminant analysis, training methods, maximum likelihood and Bayesian parameter estimation, and ODEs applied for biomedical research and Machine Learning Basics. Python workshop is provided along with the class.

briefs.name: 實驗輪轉一
briefs.tags: Lab rotation (I), research culture，實驗室輪轉一
briefs.desc: 智慧生醫博士學位學程博一新生須至少完成兩次實驗輪轉，並於每次輪轉後繳交學習報告。每次輪轉至少三個半月，最長不超過一 學期。本學程透過實驗輪轉與雙導師制，協助學生接觸不同實驗室、指導教授與研究文化，作為選擇研究方向的重要參考。 First-year PhD students in the Biomedical AI Degree Program must complete at least two Lab Rotations and submit a learning report after each rotation. Each rotation should last at least three and a half months and no longer than one semester. Through Lab Rotation and the dual-advisor system, students can explore different laboratories, advisors, and research cultures before choosing their research direction.

briefs.name: 分子模擬與建模
briefs.tags: molecular simulation, molecular dynamics simulation, statistical mechanics, numerical methods, optimization, sampling methods, free energy, 分子模擬, 分子動力學模擬, 統計力學, 數值方法, 最適化, 取樣方法, 自由能
briefs.desc: Molecular Simulation and Modeling (MD I) is the first half of a year-long sequence that introduces the theoretical foundations of molecular simulations. The course focuses on helping students understand key concepts behind molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of biomolecules. Topics include statistical mechanics and several widely used ideas and methods in molecular simulations. Although modern software makes simulations easy to perform, correctly interpreting and troubleshooting simulations still requires understanding the basic principles on which these methods are built. This course therefore explains these principles clearly and systematically.

briefs.name: 生物工程導論
briefs.teacher: 鄭兆珉,萬德輝,魯才德,黃玠誠,林幸瑩,李泓邦
briefs.tags: 生物工程、生物材料、再生醫學、生物感測、組織工程(Bioengineering, Biomaterials, Regenerative Medicine, Biosensing, Tissue Engineering)
briefs.desc: 本課程以深入淺出的方式介紹生物工程，內容橫跨多項核心與新興主題，主要涵蓋生物力學、生物感測與疾病檢測、生物材料與再生醫學、 癌症治療與藥物遞送、幹細胞與組織工程、金屬與無機醫藥化學、生醫影像與奈米科技應用等領域。期待給清華大學工學院學士班或校內其 他系所大學部學生(不限科系)，對於生物工程一個廣泛但深入的認識。

briefs.name: 專題研究
briefs.tags: 專題
briefs.desc: 本課程授課對象是大學部同學，學習內容包括:1.專題研究計畫之擬定 2.專題研究方法 3.文獻搜集閱讀整理 4.研究成果之分 析表達 5.口頭論文宣讀技巧 6.海報型論文之製作 7.數據分析 8.圖形影像表達研究成果 9.研究成果歸納

briefs.name: 分子與細胞生物學
briefs.tags: 基礎生命科學, 細胞生物學, 分子生物學, cell biology, molecular biology
briefs.desc: This course introduces the fundamental concepts of cellular and molecular biology to students with an engineering background. It offers a comprehensive yet concise overview of biological sciences, with an emphasis on their relevance to biomedical engineering.

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: 醫學工程 生命科學 精準醫療 創新創業 環安
briefs.desc: 本課程邀請生物醫學工程相關領域專家演講，由指派學生負責召集同學上課並點名，希望透過本課程能使學生對不同研究領域有所涉獵，對 生醫工程獲得廣泛的認識，並加強學生互動與彼此了解。

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文研究, Thesis
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 奈米生醫材料
briefs.tags: Biomaterials, Nanomaterials, Naturally-derived biomaterials, Polymeric biomaterials, Nanotechnology, Biotechnology
briefs.desc: This course will provide students with an introduction to nanomaterials and biomaterials used in different kinds of applications. We will survey important classes of nanomaterials (e.g., carbon- based nanomaterials and quantum dots) and biomaterials (e.g., naturally-derived biomaterials and polymeric biomaterials), discussing materials preparation, processing, properties and applications. We will also offer at least two experimental sections about the preparation of paper diagnostic devices and the cell culture.

briefs.name: 奈米光學材料
briefs.tags: 奈米, 光學, 金屬, 非金屬, 表面電漿
briefs.desc: 本門課將分為上下學期教授，涵蓋無機材料的基礎光學性質(上學期)以及表面電漿(下學期)，並著重介紹無機材料在生醫工程及奈米光電之應用。在上學期的課程中，將以良好光學基礎為主軸，引導學生從邏輯思考進而瞭解材料光學原理，同時增強學生應有的實驗理論，包含基礎電磁波理論、金屬材料之光學性質、非金屬材料之光學性質，並進行其在國際間尖端應用之介紹。

briefs.name: 金屬生物醫藥與生醫材料
briefs.tags: 金屬(metal)、生物(biology)、醫藥(medicine)、材料(material)、酵素(enzyme)
briefs.desc: 本門課程旨在(1)回顧四大生物分子及基礎無機化學、(2)金屬酵素功能以及作用機制介紹、(3)臨床使用金屬生物醫藥介紹、 (4)金屬生物醫藥及生醫材料的設計與開發。於學期末則安排由學 生挑選相關主題，進行口頭報告。 This class aims to (1) review four kinds of biomolecules and basic inorganic chemistry, (2) function and reaction mechanism of metalloenzymes, (3) introduction of FDA-approved metallopharmaceutics, (4) design and development of metal- based biomedicine and biomaterials. In the end of the semester, students have to choose a topic and give an oral presentation relevant to the metal pharmaceutical chemistry & biomaterial.

briefs.name: 前瞻生物醫學技術概論
briefs.tags: 基因體學、奈米科技、蛋白質體學、代謝體學、吞服式科技、數位藥丸、誘導式幹細胞、奈米顯微鏡、表皮電子技術、腦科學、精準醫療、AI人工智慧醫療、大數據、系統生物學
briefs.desc: 因應全球生物醫學工程與技術之發展，在生物、醫學、與工程三領域之間的跨領域創新應用，致使新的生醫科技研發方興未 艾，包含基因體學、奈米科技、蛋白質體學、代謝體學、吞服式科技、數位藥丸、誘導式幹細胞、奈米顯微鏡、表皮電子技 術、腦科學、精準醫療、AI人工智慧醫療、大數據、系統生物學、基因檢測與伴隨式診斷、腫瘤免疫療法、基因編輯、基因修 復、基因剔除與轉殖、體細胞核移植、擴增實境、虛擬實境、3D生物列印、腦(神經)–機介面、強化感官技術等、近年來均蓬勃 發展，創造出許多新穎的預防、診斷、與治療工具，最終目的在促進人類的健康與福祉。

briefs.name: 生醫工程光學與顯微影像分析
briefs.nameEn: Biomedical Engineering Optics and Microscopic Imaging Analysis
briefs.tags: Biomedical Optics; Microscopic Imaging; Optical Imaging; Fluorescence Microscopy; Image Analysis
briefs.desc: 本課程介紹生醫工程光學與顯微影像分析之核心概念，涵蓋光學成像原理、顯微鏡系統架構、螢光與多模態影像技術，以及影像處理與分 析方法。課程結合理論講授、文獻討論與應用，培養學生掌握生醫影像擷取、定量分析與結果判讀能力，並進一步連結疾病診斷、細胞觀 察與醫學研究等實際應用，建立跨領域研究與創新發展基礎。 This course introduces the core concepts of biomedical engineering optics and microscopic image analysis, covering optical imaging principles, microscope system architecture, fluorescence and multimodal imaging techniques, and image processing and analysis methods. Combining theoretical lectures, literature discussions, and applications, the course cultivates students' abilities in biomedical image acquisition, quantitative analysis, and result interpretation. It further connects to practical applications such as disease diagnosis, cell observation, and medical research, establishing a foundation for interdisciplinary research and innovative development.

briefs.name: 柔性生醫光電感測及技術應用
briefs.nameEn: Flexible Biomedical Optoelectronic Sensing and Technology Applications (AI with BioMEMS sensors)
briefs.tags: Flexible biomedical optoelectronic sensing; BioMEMS; Wearable sensing; Artificial intelligence analytics; Smart healthcare
briefs.desc: 本課程介紹柔性生醫光電感測之核心原理、材料、元件製作與系統整合，涵蓋柔性基板、光電感測機制、BioMEMS微製程、可 穿戴與即時 監測技術，以及AI輔助訊號分析與判讀。課程將結合理論講授、文獻討論與應用案例，培養學生掌握生醫感測器設計、資料 處理與臨床轉 譯能力，並能進一步發想智慧醫療、健康監測與精準診斷之創新解決方案。 This course introduces the core principles, materials, component fabrication, and system integration of flexible biomedical optoelectronic sensing. It covers flexible substrates, optoelectronic sensing mechanisms, BioMEMS microfabrication, wearable and real-time monitoring technologies, and AI- assisted signal analysis and interpretation. The course combines theoretical lectures, literature discussions, and application case studies to cultivate students' skills in biomedical sensor design, data processing, and clinical translation, and to further develop innovative solutions for smart healthcare, health monitoring, and precision diagnosis.

briefs.name: 軟物質工程
briefs.tags: Bioengineering, Hydrogels, Polymers, Rheology, Biomaterials
briefs.desc: This course introduces soft materials from an engineering perspective, emphasizing how to design, process, characterize, and apply polymers, hydrogels, colloids, emulsions, and other soft systems in biomedical, manufacturing, and electronic applications. Learning goals 1. identify major classes of soft materials and where they are used 2. connect material composition and processing to performance 3. interpret common characterization data such as rheology, swelling, and mechanical tests 4. choose suitable soft materials for a practical engineering problem 5. analyze case studies in biomaterials, coatings, printing, and soft devices

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文研究, Thesis
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 生醫工程與環境科學導論
briefs.nameEn: Introduction to Biomedical Engineering and Environmental Sciences
briefs.tags: 生醫工程,奈米科技,微生物,熱帶雨林,環境科學與工程,微量分析,超音波,核子醫學,核磁共振影像
briefs.desc: This course is designed for undergraduate students to know about Biomedical Engineering and Environmental Sciences, and assists them in arranging the learning schedule for college life and future career.

briefs.name: 工程數學一
briefs.tags: 常微分方程式，拉普拉斯轉換，級數解 Ordinary Differential Equations, Laplace Transform, Series Solutions
briefs.desc: 本課程提供學生解決科學與工程問題所需的工程數學知識。課程涵蓋的主題包括常微分方程（ODE）、拉普拉斯轉換與級數解。 This course provides students with engineering mathematics knowledge for solving science and engineering problems. Topics that will be covered include Ordinary Differential Equations (ODE), Laplace Transform, and Series Solutions.

briefs.name: 機率與統計
briefs.tags: Probability,Sampling distributions,,Point estimation of parameters,Statistical intervals,Test of statistical hypotheses, linear regression and correlation
briefs.desc: This is a one-semester based introduction to probability and statistics for undergraduate students in engineering. The course aims to provide elementary topics needed for an understanding of basic statistics and its applications. Topics cover probability, random variables, sampling, point estimation, statistical intervals, test of statistical hypotheses, and linear regression. Statistics program Python will be introduced in class.

briefs.name: 電子學一
briefs.tags: 半導體Semiconductors, 二極體Diodes, 電晶體Transistors, 雙載子接面電晶體Bipolar Junction Transistors, 場效電晶體Field-Effect Transistors
briefs.desc: 本課程主要介紹基本電子元件原理及其應用電路，使修課同學具備電子元件使用與應用電路之分析及設計能力，授課方式 為課堂講授，使修課同學充分瞭解電子電路之功能與對應之生醫工程方面應用。

briefs.name: 有機化學一
briefs.tags: structure, stereochemistry, acid and base, reaction types, electron delocalization
briefs.desc: 此課程乃為對化學領域有興趣之醫環系學生所設計的基礎課程.涵蓋鍵結電子軌域,路易士酸鹼定義,化學命名,立體化學,反 應型態,酸鹼度觀念推導,光譜,有機金屬與有機合成設計o課程並將穿插現代有機化學在藥物設計扮演之重要角色o

briefs.name: 醫學工程與科技之專業英語
briefs.nameEn: English for Biomedical Engineering and Technology
briefs.tags: English for Specific Purposes, English for Academic Purposes, Biomedical Engineering English, Technical English
briefs.desc: This course is designed for first- and second-year BMES bachelor students, aiming to develop technical English skills specific to the discipline of Biomedical Engineering. The course will focus on improving students’ abilities in listening, reading, writing, and speaking. By the end of the course, each student will be expected to give an oral presentation, demonstrating their ability to organize content, utilize graphics and visual aids, and present information in a clear and logical manner.

briefs.name: 生醫電子與儀器實驗
briefs.tags: 電子實驗(Electronics Experiments), 影像處理(Imaging Processing), 程式設計(Programming), 光學實驗(Optics Experiment), 光電實驗 (Photo-electric Experiment)
briefs.desc: 生醫電子與儀器實驗是一為培養學生進入醫學工程領域所設計的跨領域應用課程。課程設計上，含跨基本電子元件儀器介紹及操 作、影像處理分析、自動控制程式與電訊號量測、基礎光學、微波與電磁波量測實驗。課程設計以生醫儀器所需的基本能力為主 軸，期透過實驗課程，以動手實做的上課過程，讓學生實地整合基礎科學知識，進而能啟發其創新能力。

briefs.name: 生醫電子與儀器實驗
briefs.tags: 基本電子元件儀器，影像處理分，電訊號量測，基礎光學，微波與電磁波量測
briefs.desc: 生醫電子與儀器實驗是一為培養學生進入醫學工程領域所設計的跨領域應用課程。 課程設計上，含跨基本電子元件儀器介紹及 操作、影像處理分析、自動控制程式與電訊號量測、基礎光學、微波與電磁波量測實驗。課程設計以生醫儀器所需的基本能力為 主軸，期透過實驗課程，以動手實做的上課過程，讓學生實地整合基礎科學知識，進而能啟發其創新能力。

briefs.name: 生物化學一
briefs.tags: 生物化學 蛋白質結構 生物分子 核酸與基因 酵素作用 English Keywords: Biochemistry Protein Structure Biomolecules Nucleic Acids and Genetics
briefs.desc: 本課程旨在介紹生物化學之基本原理與生命分子之結構、功能及其相互作用，建立學生對生命現象分子基礎的理解。課程內容涵蓋水與生物 系統之熱力學、胺基酸與蛋白質結構、醣類、脂質、生物膜與膜運輸，以及核酸與酵素等重要主題。透過系統性講授與案例說明，使學生了 解生物大分子的化學特性與生理功能，並奠定後續分子生物學、生物技術、生醫工程及生命科學相關課程之基礎知識。

briefs.name: 專題研究一
briefs.tags: 專題研究
briefs.desc: 由教授與學生擬定研究題目，以進行專題研究，培養學生解決問題的能力。

briefs.name: 數值方法
briefs.tags: Numerical methods, modeling, roots and optimization, linear systems, curve fitting, integration and differentiation
briefs.desc: This course provides students with basic mathematics knowledge and computational tools for solving science and engineering problems. Topics that will be covered include modeling, computers and error analysis, roots and optimization, linear systems, curve fitting, integration and differentiation, and ordinary differential equations.

briefs.name: 生醫材料
briefs.tags: metal, materials, crystalline, structure, property
briefs.desc: This course is to provide the students who lack basic training in materials science an introduction to the fundamental concepts of biomaterials, including three types of biomaterials (metals, ceramics and synthetic and natural macromolecules) and their chemical structure, physical properties, processing and applications. Biocompatibility of materials pertinent to their applications in biomedical engineering is the other important issue to be given in this course. This includes the interactions of biomaterials with proteins and cells and biomaterial-elicited specific immune responses.

briefs.name: 儀器分析
briefs.tags: 層析技術, 光譜技術、X-ray、核磁共振、熱分析, 原子力顯微鏡
briefs.desc: 本課程將提供大學部學生基礎的分析基礎化學結構與組成所需之重要儀器分析技術，包括基本原理、儀器介紹、 及主要 應用。 擬介紹之儀器分析技術包括層析技術、光譜技術(如紫外光/可見光光吸收光譜、紅外光譜術、X-ray、核磁共振等)、原 子力顯微鏡及熱分析等 This course will provide undergraduate students a basic training on the principles of analysis of chemical structures and compositions determination/analyses through the use of various modern state- of-art instruments.

briefs.name: 物理化學一
briefs.tags: 化學平衡, 功與熱, 相變化, 亂度, 真實氣體
briefs.desc: Physical chemistry is essential for developing and interpreting the modern techniques used to determine the structure and properties of matter. The course will focus on equilibrium.

briefs.name: 醫學儀器
briefs.tags: medical instrumentation, biopotential, X-ray, CT, NM, SPECT, PET, MRI,Ultrasound,Radiotherapy
briefs.desc: This course introduces the fundamental concepts and applications of Medical Instrumentation. The concepts include physiological signals, ECG and EEG, non-electrical measurements, biomedical sensors, and biopotential amplifiers. The biomedical applications regarding X-ray, CT, US, NM, MRI, and Radiotherapy will be covered in this course.

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: oral presentation, scientific report, speech, audience, chairman
briefs.desc: This course is designed for senior undergraduate students how to make an oral presentation for specific scientific researches published in five years. The purpose of this course is to preside in the presentation including speech performance and preparation of PowerPoint slides , and being an audience to listening interdisciplinary topics from other classmates and raise some questions as well. Students in this course will take turns to make a presentation, and serve as a chairman.

briefs.name: 專題研究三
briefs.tags: 專題研究
briefs.desc: 由教授與學生擬定研究題目，以進行專題研究，培養學生解決問題的能力。

briefs.name: 分子細胞生物學
briefs.tags: cell biology, membrane transport, intracellular trafficking, cytoskeleton, cell division
briefs.desc: 課程目標 (Purpose): To provide students with knowledge on the fundamentals of cell biology and its linking to applications in biomedical engineering and applied sciences. Specifically, this course will cover: (1) structure/function of cellular components; (2) cellular transport; (3) cell division and (4) cellular communication.

briefs.name: 臨床醫學影像概論
briefs.tags: medical imaging, medical physics, radiology, radiation biology, digital informations
briefs.desc: 本課程由臨床診察需求為起點 以影像判讀的角度 探討現行常見之醫療影像檢查與預期之未來發展方向 培養相關於影像診斷之醫學物理學專業能力為課程設計 本課程無涉及AI使用

briefs.name: 放射物理
briefs.tags: X光的產生及特性，原子核物理，輻射與物質的作用，輻射劑量學，輻射度量儀器，核子醫學; Production and properties of X-rays, Fundamentals of nuclear physics,Interactions of ionizing radiation with matter, Radiation dosimetry, Instrumentation and techniques of Radiation Measurement, Nuclear medicine
briefs.desc: 放射物理乃放射醫學診療及各種輻射應用的基礎，內容包括基礎原子核物理、輻射與物質之作用、輻射劑量學、輻射量測技術及 各種輻射偵測儀器之基本原理。

briefs.name: 臨床醫學總論
briefs.tags: 臨床醫學(clinical medicine)，醫學知識(medical knowledge)，生醫科技(biomedical technology)，創新臨床醫療(medical innovation)，轉譯醫學(translational medicine)
briefs.desc: 1) 瞭解臨床醫學基本觀念及其相關疾病的表徵和治療重點 2) 內科、外科、急診、急救、婦產科、兒科等相關科學的基本介紹 3) 瞭解相關醫學術語、一般醫學知識、及臨床評估之意義 4) 瞭解並落實生醫科技領域當中基礎與臨床之結合

briefs.name: 生醫訊號與系統
briefs.tags: biomedical signals and systems
briefs.desc: This is an introductory course of signals and systems with special emphasis on their biomedical applications.

briefs.name: 專題演講
briefs.tags: oral presentation
briefs.desc: This is a graduate seminar course to foster the presentation ability and comprehension of research articles.

briefs.name: 書報討論(一)-分子生醫工程與材料
briefs.tags: Scientific presentation
briefs.desc: Course description: This course is designed for graduate students to learn how to present scientific projects. Students are expected to select specific scientific topic and present the research topics with PowerPoint or other preferred styles. Teaching Method: Oral presentation: Every student has to deliver a 12 min presentation and 3 min Q&A in this course. Please select research papers/reviews based on your research interests. Report: Before the presentation, please upload the papers with presentation slides by Tuesday 23:00. Grades: Oral Presentation: 60% Report: 20% Participation: 20% (Ask 2 questions at least.)

briefs.name: 書報討論(一)-生醫影像工程
briefs.tags: 生物醫學工程，學術簡報 Biomedical engineering, academic presentation
briefs.desc: 本課程以學生報告與討論為主要形式，訓練學生閱讀文獻、整理研究內容、進行口頭簡報、主持討論與參與提問。課程中學生將 輪流擔任報告者與主持人，透過簡報討論與回饋，培養學術表達、批判思考與專業溝通能力。 This course is conducted mainly through student presentations and discussions. Students will take turns serving as presenters and moderators to practice literature reading, oral presentation, discussion moderation, and question-and-answer participation. The course aims to develop students’ academic communication, critical thinking, and professional presentation skills.

briefs.name: 碩士班專題研究一
briefs.tags: 專題研究
briefs.desc: 由教授與學生擬定研究題目，以進行專題研究，培養學生解決問題的能力。

briefs.name: 分子生醫基礎
briefs.tags: Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Molecular medicine, Precision medicine, Genomics
briefs.desc: This course includes lecture topics, laboratory technique concepts, and periodic examinations covering the fundamentals of molecular biology and medicine. Students are expected to develop a thorough understanding of molecular biology and to critically evaluate and select appropriate techniques for their own research. The course is intended for graduate students and advanced undergraduates interested in molecular biomedicine, and is suitable even for those without a formal background in biology.

briefs.name: 生醫感測器
briefs.tags: biological sensors, chemical sensors, point of care testing
briefs.desc: This course will provide students with the basic introduction of physical, chemical, and biological sensors. The purpose of this course is to introduce the basic design and working principles of various biomedical sensors that are currently used in biomedical research and the healthcare industry. Recent advances and trends of biosensing technologies and future biosensing platforms will also be discussed.

briefs.name: 器官晶片與人工器官設計與應用
briefs.nameEn: Design and Application of Organ on a Chip and Bioartificial Organ
briefs.tags: stem cells (幹細胞), organ on a chip(器官晶片), Brain on a chip(仿大腦晶片), bioartificial organ(人工器官), 3D bioprinting(三維器官列印))
briefs.desc: The aims of this course is to introduce the technology platforms, methodologies, and the design of organ on a chip and artificial organs. This course emphasizes the following objectives: 1. Knowledge of organ on a chip design including brain on a chip, lung on a chip, liver on a chip, and disease on a chip. 2.Introduction of various engineering issues surrounding the design of artificial organs including biopolymers and biocompatibility, stem cell technology, biomimetic systems, design principles for tissue and blood contact, and control of artificial organs. 3. Application of the knowledge to the design of artificial organs including circulatory support devices, drug delivery systems, artificial kidney, and other bioartificial organs. 課程主旨在介紹器官晶片與人工器官的技術平台、製備方法、與相關設計。本課程強調以下目標: 1. 介紹以下器官晶片設 計所需的知識，包含大腦晶片、肺部晶片、肝臟晶片以及疾病模式。2. 介紹人工器官設計所需的工程與技術，包含生醫高 分子及生物A

briefs.name: 生醫耦合化學
briefs.tags: mechanism, biological reaction, lipid metabolism, glycochemistry, peptide chemistry
briefs.desc: 本課程旨在介紹生醫代謝與合成之化學,透過既有之有機化學基礎,加強同學理解生物系統如何以有機化學之反應機制進行 蛋白酵素催化,分子辨識與藥物運作之方式o This course aims to introduce the chemistry of biomedical metabolism and synthesis. based on the fundamental of organic chemistry, the biological function of living organism will be understood in a straightforward manner. Natural products such as carbohydrate, protein and nucleic acid as well as the protease catalysis and molecular recognition will be also introduced.

briefs.name: 人工智慧於醫學影像之應用
briefs.nameEn: Application of artificial intelligence in medical image
briefs.tags: 醫學影像，深度學習，DICOM處理，電腦視覺，跨域人工智慧
briefs.desc: 本課程探討人工智慧在醫學影像分析中的理論基礎與實務應用，涵蓋影像前處理、深度學習模型建構（CNN、Transformer）、 分類、偵測、分割任務等內容。學生將實作 DICOM 影像處理，學習使用 Python 進行醫學影像分析，並認識臨床應用與法規 挑戰。課程強調跨領域整合與團隊合作，適合醫學、工程、生物資訊等背景學生修習。

briefs.name: 穿戴式生醫電子裝置設計
briefs.nameEn: Design of Wearable Biomedical Electronic Device
briefs.tags: 可穿戴感測器、電子感測器、非侵入式量測、非接觸式感測、磁場刺激
briefs.desc: With the internet of things (IoT) rapid development and advanced devices that can monitor a myriad of biometric parameters, wearable biomedical device has gained the interest of physicians and researchers due to the benefits that could be associated with long-term monitoring of patients for healthcare. The course will provide students with introduction to wearable biomedical devices and its principle is based on the latest academic research and commercial biomedical product development. The course will guide students to see the overview of the current wearable biomedical devices and help them to train their scientific thinking from initial unmet needs to device design, and further fabrication technologies for wearable biomedical devices.

briefs.name: 生醫影像處理
briefs.tags: Image Processing, Python
briefs.desc: This course will cover basic concepts of medical image processing combined with basic training for image programming using c or c++. Students will build the ability to solve some image processing task along by using programming language.

briefs.name: 核磁共振影像原理及應用
briefs.nameEn: Magnetic Resonance Imaging Principles and Applications
briefs.tags: MRI, signal source, excitation and detection, relaxation
briefs.desc: This course introduces the fundamental concepts and applications of magnetic resonance imaging. The concepts include spin behavior, NMR signals, hardware, pulse sequence, and k-space. The technical applications regarding fast scan, parallel imaging, and artifacts will be covered in this course. We will also introduce some of the clinical applications, e.g., fMRI, angiography, diffusion, and perfusion.

briefs.name: 超音波與光學：生醫技術與應用
briefs.nameEn: Ultrasound and Optics : Biomedical Imaging Techniques and applications
briefs.tags: Medical diagnostics, Biological Imaging, Ultrasound imaging, Optical technique, Photoacoustic/ Optoacoustic imaging, Image processing，醫療診斷, 生物影像，超音波成像，光學技術，光聲成像，影像處理
briefs.desc: The course will cover three biomedical imaging techniques: Ultrasound, Optical, and Optoacoustics. Fundamentals physics, signal detection, and image formation for each modality will be discussed, followed by their applications. An emphasis will be placed on the contrasting and complementary nature between the first two: ultrasound and optical methods. This will lead the discussion into the third topic of photoacoustic techniques and applications, where the characteristics, highlights, and current limitations will be explored. In the last portion of this course, students will have a chance to exercise logical reasoning and creative problem solving skill in anticipating and resolving potential problems

briefs.name: 生醫工程企業實習
briefs.nameEn: Internship in the Biomedical Engineering Industry
briefs.tags: 生物醫學工程、生醫材料、生物電子學、生物感測器、生醫影像、生物微機電系統、精準醫療Biomedical Engineering, Biomaterials Bioelectronics, Biosensor, Biomedical Imaging, BioMEMS, Precision Medicine
briefs.desc: 這門實習課程可於學期中或寒暑假期間進行。學生需在生物醫學工程相關公司完成至少 150小時的實務訓練。該課程旨在提 供生物醫學工程產 業的實務經驗，並將理論知識與專業實踐相結合。 This internship course may be undertaken during the academic semester or in the summer/winter break. Students are required to complete at least 150 hours of practical training at one or several biomedical engineering–related company. The program is designed to provide hands-on experience in the biomedical engineering industry and to bridge theoretical knowledge with professional practice.

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文, Thesis
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 書報討論(二)-分子生醫工程與材料
briefs.tags: Scientific presentation
briefs.desc: Course description: This course is designed for graduate students to learn how to present scientific projects. Students are expected to select specific scientific topic and present the research topics with PowerPoint or other preferred styles. Teaching Method: Oral presentation: Every student has to deliver a 12 min presentation and 3 min Q&A in this course. Please select research papers/reviews based on your research interests. Report: Before the presentation, please upload the papers with presentation slides by Tuesday 23:00. Grades: Oral Presentation: 60% Report: 20% Participation: 20% (Ask 2 questions at least.)

briefs.name: 書報討論(二)-生醫影像工程
briefs.tags: 生物醫學工程，學術簡報 Biomedical engineering, academic presentation
briefs.desc: 本課程以學生報告與討論為主要形式，訓練學生閱讀文獻、整理研究內容、進行口頭簡報、主持討論與參與提問。課程中學生將 輪流擔任報告者與主持人，透過簡報討論與回饋，培養學術表達、批判思考與專業溝通能力。 This course is conducted mainly through student presentations and discussions. Students will take turns serving as presenters and moderators to practice literature reading, oral presentation, discussion moderation, and question-and-answer participation. The course aims to develop students’ academic communication, critical thinking, and professional presentation skills.

briefs.name: 專題書報討論
briefs.tags: Oral Presentation Skills, Literature Reviews, Research Coomunication Skills.
briefs.desc: This course is designed for undergraduate students how to make a speech and preside in the presentation including speech performance and PowerPoint slides preparation. Every student presents once in this course and serves as a chairman in turn.

briefs.name: 博士班專題研究一
briefs.tags: 專題研究
briefs.desc: 由各指導教授指導博士班學生進行研究

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文研究, Thesis
briefs.desc: 由各指導教授指導博士班學生進行研究

briefs.name: 化學工程導論
briefs.tags: 研究領域探索,專業方向探索,化工前沿科技,跨領域應用,化工製程,工程實作,咖啡烘焙 Research Field Exploration,Professional Field Exploration,Frontiers in Chemical Engineering,Interdisciplinary Applications,Chemical Processes,Engineering Practice,Coffee Roasting
briefs.desc: 本課程旨在引導大一學生建立對化學工程領域的整體認識。課程邀請系上不同專長教師，從各自研究領域出發，介紹化學工 程的核心概念、實際應用及最新發展趨勢，使學生了解化工在能源、材料、生醫、環境、製程及新興科技等領域所扮演的角 色，並建立未來選擇專業與研究方向的基本輪廓。除專題講授外，課程亦結合實作活動，以咖啡烘焙為例，引導學生從乾 燥、熱質傳遞及製程操作等化工觀點理解日常生活中的工程原理，並透過咖啡烘焙與品評競賽，培養學生的實作、觀察、分 析及團隊合作能力，提升對化學工程的興趣與認同。 This course is designed to provide first-year students with a broad and integrated understanding of chemical engineering. Faculty members with diverse expertise will introduce the fundamental concepts, practical applications, and recent advances in their respective fields, helping students explore the roles of chemical engineering in areas such as energy, materials, biotechnology, environmental engineering, process engineering, and emerging technologies. The course also incorporates hands-on activit

briefs.name: 工程數學一
briefs.tags: 工程數學(Engineering Mathematics),常微分方程式(Ordinary Differential Equation),拉普拉斯轉換(Laplace Transform),冪級數解(Power Series Solution),斯圖姆-劉維爾問題(Sturm-Liouville Problem)
briefs.desc: 工程數學為化工系必修課,分兩學期講授化工專業課目(如:輸送現象,反應工程,程序控制等)中需要之數學基礎(如:ODE,Linear Algebra,Vector Calculus,Fourier Analysis,PDE),課程中盡量以化工專業科目內容為舉例對象。工程數學(I)之內容包 括：一階，二階及高階之常微分方程式及其解法；聯立一階常微分方程組；Laplace Transform 及其應用； Power Series Solution 與 Sturm-Liouville 問題。本課程無涉及AI使用。

briefs.name: 工程數學一
briefs.tags: 1st order ODE, 2nd order ODE, Systems of ODE, 一階常微分方程, 二階常微分方程, 常微分方程組
briefs.desc: Engineering Mathematics (I) covers the basics of the mathematical tools essential for defining and solving problems encountered by chemical engineers. These problems include by are not limited to transport of maters and energy, thermodynamics and separation processes, chemical reaction engineering, process control, and process design. We will start our course with the introduction of 1st-order ordinary differential equations (ODE). Such equations are commonly encountered in simple chemical kinetics or steady-state heat and mass transfer problems. We will cover several types of ODE starting from separable homogeneous ODE to general 1st- order ODE. We will also cover 2nd-order ODE, which serves as an important foundation for dealing with partial differential equations students will encounter in non-steady state transfer problems. Finally, toward the end of the semester, we will cover systems of ODEs that can be used to deal with kinetics in series reac

briefs.name: 物理化學一
briefs.tags: Gas Laws, Thermodynamics, Mixtures, Phase Diagram, and Equilibrium
briefs.desc: Physical Chemistry I is a class focusing on gaining understandings toward chemical thermodynamics topics such as work, heat, internal energy, heat capacity, enthalpy, entropy, free energy, Helmholtz free energy, Gibbs free energy, Maxwell relations, chemical potential…etc. In this class, we will focus on (but not limited to) the following topics: 1. The properties of gases 2. The first law of thermodynamics 3. The second law of thermodynamics 4. Physical transformations of pure substances 5. Simple mixture 6. Phase diagrams 7. Chemical equilibrium After this class, you should be able to use the methods of equilibrium thermodynamics to describe the properties and processes of macroscopic systems.

briefs.name: 能源科技與環境概論
briefs.nameEn: Introduction to Energy Technology and Environment
briefs.tags: 環境能源科技, Energy Technology and Environment
briefs.desc: Net-zero carbon emissions by 2050 is necessary to limit the global temperature increase within 1.5 C and avoid irreversible damage from global warming. Fossil fuel power plants are responsible for the most carbon emissions among the anthropogenic sources. Carbon capture and sequestration (CCS) is an essential technology to decarbonize power generation and achieve the net-zero carbon emission target. This course will focus on the CCS technology development in the context of mitigating the global warming. In this class, the students will be expected to learn: 1. The greenhouse gas sources and the mitigation methods 2. The low-emission power generation technology 3. The carbon capture and sequestration technology with amine scrubbing 4. Current status of carbon capture in industry

briefs.name: 化工熱力學
briefs.tags: 熱力學第一定律, 熱力學第二定律, 純流體體積性質, 流體熱力學性質, 溶液熱力學, 相平衡; First law of thermodynamics, second law of thermodynamics, volumetric properties of fluids, thermodynamics of fluids, solution thermodynamics, phase equilibria
briefs.desc: This course introduces the basic laws of thermodynamics and its applications in chemical engineering. The course contents include: the first and second laws, volumetric properties, heat effects, thermodynamic properties of fluids, solution thermodynamics, phase equilibrium, production of power from heat and applications.

briefs.name: 化工熱力學
briefs.tags: Polymer Characterization; Molecular Weight Determination; Thermal Properties, Chemical Structures; Physical Structures
briefs.desc: This class aims to give the fundamentals of polymer characterization for the understandings of structure/property relationship so as to build up the strengths for the applications of polymer materials in different research areas.

briefs.name: 化學反應工程
briefs.tags: 化學反應, 動力學, 反應器, 質量平衡, 觸媒
briefs.desc: 本課程在培養學生具備基礎的化學反應動力學與化學反應器之設計觀念，並對目前工業常用之化學反應器與相關技術作介紹。 本課程首先從動力學與反應熱力學開始介紹, 之後由基礎的質量平衡進行批次與連續式操作反應器進行介紹與討論, 之後進入 反 應器串並聯與設計, 最後介紹觸媒特性與應用. 本課程會透過教材，作業與文獻的導讀，使學生能從事相關問題之研究。

briefs.name: 化學反應工程
briefs.tags: 反應器基本介紹(Introduction of reactors), 當量表之建立(Set up stoichiometric table), 反應器中的壓降(Pressure drop in reactors), 觸媒反應與反應器設計(Catalyst reaction and reactor design), 非等溫反應器(Non-isothermal reactor), 動力學數據處理(The treatment for kinetics data)
briefs.desc: Chemical Reaction Engineering is a field that studies the chemical reaction kinetics and the design of the reactors in which they take place. Advanced chemical reaction engineering will focus on non-ideal condition or more practical situation. Modern reactors will be also included in the lectures.

briefs.name: 儀器分析及實驗一
briefs.tags: Instrumental Analysis, Spectrometry, Atomic Analysis, Molecular Analysis, Chromatography, Microscopy
briefs.desc: Instrumental Analysis bridges fundamental theory with real-world applications. In this course, students will explore key analytical techniques in chemical engineering through lectures and hands-on laboratories, which will cover principles, instrumentations, data acquisition, and interpretation.

briefs.name: 儀器分析及實驗一
briefs.tags: 儀器分析 Instrumental analysis, 光譜 spectrometry, 原子分析 atomic analysis, 分子分析 molecular analysis, 層析 chromatography
briefs.desc: Instrumental analysis is linked with many fields of science and engineering. Due to the large number and diversity of instrumental methods, beginners typically will need a large amount of work to collect the necessary knowledge in order to understand of the fundamentals of the methods.

briefs.name: 輸送現象及單元操作一
briefs.tags: 動能傳遞, 流體力學, 動量守恆方程式, 黏度, 高分子流體, momentum transport, fluidic dynamics, momentum conservation equation, viscosity, polymeric liquids
briefs.desc: The course content primarily focuses on the theory and applications of fluid mechanics, including the following topics: an introduction to fluid properties, shell balance, the formulation of continuity and momentum equations under isothermal conditions, laminar flow, turbulent flow, boundary layer theory, interfacial momentum transfer and friction coefficients, macroscopic fluid flow phenomena, and non- Newtonian fluid flow.

briefs.name: 材料科學
briefs.tags: 晶體結構、結晶缺陷、固化、擴散、機械性質與加工、相圖、陶瓷與陶瓷加工 、工程合金 、複合材料; crystal structures, crystal defects, solidification, diffusion, mechanical properties and processing, phase diagrams, ceramics and ceramic processing, alloys, composite materials
briefs.desc: Materials science investigates the microstructure of materials and their physical, chemical and mechanical properties. This course is divided into three parts: (1) Microstructure of materials, atomic bonding and coordination, atomic arrangement in crystals and crystal defects (especially the theory of vacancies and dislocations). (2) Thermodynamics and kinetics of materials Science: phase diagrams, solid diffusion and heat treatment, which are the basis for controlling and changing the microstructure of materials. (3) Properties of materials: discussing the physical, chemical, and mechanical properties of metals, ceramics, composite materials, and semiconductors.

briefs.name: 程序設計
briefs.tags: Heat Integration, Chemical Process Design, Aspen, Chemical Reactor Modeling, Project
briefs.desc: 這門課是給化工系四年級的學生運用二到三年級之所學(質能均衡、單元操作、化工熱力學、反應器設計等專業課程)設計一個 化工程序。課程的重點將擺在實務上如何從經濟的角度去製造、分析評估、和優化設計中的程序。

briefs.name: 程序設計
briefs.tags: 程序設計process design, 製程模擬process simulation, 最適化optimization, heat integration熱整合, 工程經濟engineering economics
briefs.desc: This course aims to teach how to apply heat and material balance, thermodynamics, process optimization, and unit operation method to design chemical processes using process simulators. The students are expected to: 1. Understand the procedure for chemical process design and delivery 2. Apply basic knowledge of chemical engineering to design a chemical process 3. Calculate process economics and implement optimization 4. Gain open-ended problem-solving skill 5. Learn how to use chemical process simulators 6. Present the results through written and verbal reports

briefs.name: 單元操作實驗
briefs.tags: 實驗操作，口頭報告，書面報告，資料分析，結果討論
briefs.desc: 本課程進所包括之各種單元操作之實驗，使學生可以從實驗學習過程中，瞭解各種單元操作。

briefs.name: 單元操作實驗
briefs.tags: 實驗操作，口頭報告，書面報告，資料分析，結果討論
briefs.desc: 本課程進所包括之各種單元操作之實驗，使學生可以從實驗學習過程中，瞭解各種單元操作。

briefs.name: 高分子材料與加工技術
briefs.tags: 高分子材料, 高分子流變性質, 高分子機械性質，模具設計，電腦輔助工程分析, Injection molding, extrusion, polymer, fiber reinforced composites，塑膠加工, 先進封裝
briefs.desc: This course provides an introduction to polymer materials and processing technologies, with an emphasis on the relationship between polymer structure, material properties, and processing behavior. Topics include polymer classification, molecular structure, crystallinity, mechanical behavior, viscoelasticity, creep, stress relaxation, and melt flow characteristics. The course further introduces major polymer processing methods, including extrusion, injection molding, additive manufacturing, advanced packaging, and fiber-reinforced composite processing. Students will learn how processing conditions influence polymer flow, deformation, material structure, and final product performance. Applications of computer-aided engineering (CAE) in polymer processing and packaging will also be discussed.

briefs.name: 生物技術概論
briefs.tags: 基因工程 (genetic engineering), 細胞培養 (cell culture and fermentation), 下游程序工程(downstream process), 生質化學品 (bio-derived chemicals), 生技產業(biotechnology industry)
briefs.desc: This course covers basic cell biology, fundamental genetic engineering, cell culture, bioreactor design, downstream bioprocesses and applications of biotechnology. In the end of the semester, the students are grouped to design and present the production process of some products, starting from market research, genetic engineering of the cells, production process (including bioreactor design and operation) and downstream purification process.

briefs.name: 專題研究一
briefs.tags: 專題研究
briefs.desc: 在指導老師指導下，進行不同領域之研究工作，以建立對該領域知識與技術之深入瞭解。特別有興趣之同學可在三下暑假開始前 選定指導教授，以便利用假期進行研究工作。同學應於當學期末提出研究成果報告。

briefs.name: 專題研究二
briefs.tags: 專題研究
briefs.desc: 在指導老師指導下，進行不同領域之研究工作，以建立對該領域知識與技術之深入瞭解。特別有興趣之同學可在三下暑假開始前 選定指導教授，以便利用假期進行研究工作。同學應於當學期末提出研究成果報告。

briefs.name: 分子工程一
briefs.tags: 分子設計、光電材料、製程技術、元件製作 \ Molecular Design, Optoelectronic Materials, Processing Technology, Device Fabrication
briefs.desc: 本課程主要是探討分子的結構與其性質、製程上的關係，藉由從原子尺度下去調控分子的結構，進而推展至巨觀尺度的分子行為之認識，是 本課程的主要目的。學習從量子化學的光電效應與光電材料的設計、性質、製程與應用。 同時學生也將藉由實務上的分子構想設計與工程 來達成此目標。 This course primarily explores the relationship between the structure and properties of molecules and their processing. The main objective of this course is to understand macroscopic molecular behavior by regulating molecular structures at the atomic scale. Students will learn about the photoelectric effect in quantum chemistry and the design, properties, processing, and applications of photoelectric materials. Additionally, students will achieve this objective through practical molecular design and engineering projects.

briefs.name: 高等化工熱力學
briefs.tags: 統計熱力學, 系綜理論, 配分函數, 近獨立粒子的統計行為, 分子動力學模擬; Statistical thermodynamics, ensemble theory, partition functions, particle statistics, molecular dynamics simulations
briefs.desc: based on the foundation of classical thermodynamics, this course will introduce the key concepts of statistical thermodynamics and show a few examples of its applications. This includes the basic assumptions and how we could link the microstates with the macrostates via ensemble theory. In addition, we will use this tool to calculate thermodynamic variables (e.g. free energies) of simple systems from their accessible quantum states.

briefs.name: 高等化學反應工程
briefs.tags: Chemical reaction engineering (化學反應工程), reaction kinetics (反應動力學), chemical reactor (化學反應器), Analysis of kinetics data (動力學數據分析), Catalysis Engineering (催化工程)、Pressure drop (壓降)
briefs.desc: Advanced Chemical Reaction Engineering focuses on understanding the rates and mechanisms of chemical reactions and designing the reactors in which these reactions occur. This field is central to nearly all chemical processes.

briefs.name: 化工原理一
briefs.tags: pump, flow meters, heat exchanger, dryer, distillation, leaching, extraction, absorption, adsorption, mechanical separation
briefs.desc: 本課程為包含化工系大學部必修課程兩部分之簡述:輸送現象與化工單元操作。課程目的在於提供化工所同學對化工 系基礎課程對應專業能力提升。詳見課程敘述。

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: seminar, chemical engineering, biomolecular engineering, polymer science, applied materials
briefs.desc: 課堂將邀請專家學者至系上演講，並提供系上博士班研究生公開演講之機會。此外，研究生的安全、環保、衛生等方面訓練也 將於此課程加以訓練。成績考核以出席率為主(佔60%)，參與程度/聽講後之提問與討論為輔(佔40%)。

briefs.name: 石油化學工業
briefs.tags: petroleum, petrochemical, energy, green processes, green products & polymers
briefs.desc: 本課程宗旨在介紹石油/石化學之基本概念，以建立選修同學日後從事於石油/石化學工業之進一步研究或投入生產事業之基 礎。內容涵蓋石油/石化學工業之主要製程、產品、品質與市場，天然氣生產與市場，國內石化工業近況。

briefs.name: 綠能發展與環境控制
briefs.nameEn: Green Energy Development and Environmental Control
briefs.tags: 綠能(green energy)、環境污染(environmental pollution)、永續發展(sustainable development)、水資源再利用(water reuse)、氫能與燃料電池(hydrogen energy and fuel cell)
briefs.desc: 隨著經濟發展，人類活動所需要的水、空氣、能源等，皆是從大量地球資源中所獲得。在這過程必定會造成一次能源的短缺和環 境污染破壞。本課程介紹綠色能源的種類及應用原理與發展，並說明永續發展的環境科技，藉以培養學生對於綠色能源與永續環 境科技之專業知識和開發創意，讓學生未來選擇於綠色能源產業就業時，能先有基本的概念。

briefs.name: 代謝工程與生質化學品概論
briefs.nameEn: Metabolic Engineering and Renewable Chemical Production
briefs.tags: metabolic engineering, synthetic biology, biobased chemical, biorefinery, biofuel, biochemistry
briefs.desc: 此課程將會介紹代謝工程領域中所需的基礎分子生物技術，微生物之各式代謝途徑，及其在生質燃料和化學品方面之應用 Selected topics in molecular biology and biochemistry that form the foundation of biotechnology and metabolic engineering will be discussed. Along with introduction of cell metabolism, this course will focus on the application of various techniques in the production of renewable chemical and fuel.

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文,Thesis
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行深入研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之創新性成果。

briefs.name: 小角度散射原理與應用
briefs.nameEn: Principles and Applications of Small Angle Scattering
briefs.tags: 小角度散射，軟物質，高分子，結構，同步輻射，small angle scattering, soft matter, polymer, synchrotron radiation
briefs.desc: This course will cover the principles and applications of small angle X-ray and neutron scattering, which are important tools for exploring the nanostructures, thermodynamics and dynamics of matters. The objective is to provide the students a solid background on these techniques, which may be helpful for their research in related subjects. The topics covered in this course are outlined as follows. 1. Basics of X-ray and Neutron Scattering 2. Small Angle Scattering 2. Applications to Polymer Blends and Block Copolymers 4. Application to Amorphous Polymers 5. Study of Surfaces and Interfaces 6. Inelastic Scattering for Dynamics Studies The materials taught in class will be based largely on the book of: R. J. Roe, “Methods of X-ray and Neutron Scattering in Polymer Science”, Oxford University Press (2000) Two exams will be held and a final written report is required.

briefs.name: 化工中的數據科學與人工智慧
briefs.nameEn: Data science and artificial intelligence in chemical engineering
briefs.tags: 智慧化工，人工智慧，數據分析，化工製程，機器學習
briefs.desc: 介紹數據分析及人工智慧（機器學習，含深度學習）之原理，通過化工案例講解相關技術之應用，講述其對於提昇製程性能、實 現智慧化工生產之意義。並提供相關程式語言使用訓練，使學生具有一定實際應用的能力。 本課程使用AI的規則：有條件開放，請註明如何使用生成式AI於課程產出。

briefs.name: 同步輻射在物質結構上的應用
briefs.tags: Synchrotron Radiation, Structure Analysis, diffraction and scattering, absorption spectroscopy, photoemission spectroscopy, imaing techniques

briefs.desc: General Chemistry (I) is the second half of a two-semester, accelerated, first-year college chemistry sequence designed for science and engineering majors. The course builds a strong foundation in problem- solving, mathematical reasoning, and analytical thinking, while deepening students' understanding of the fundamental chemical principles that govern matter and energy. The topics covered include chemical reactions and stoichiometry, thermochemistry, electronic structures of atoms, chemical bonding theories, molecular geometry, states of matter, properties of solutions, chemical kinetics, and thermodynamics. These principles will be applied to explore reaction mechanisms such as condensation– hydrolysis and acid–base reactions.

briefs.tags: organic molecule, organic reaction, reaction mechanism, regioselectivity, substitution, elimination
briefs.desc: Concept of organic chemistry including introduction of organic molecules and reactions for alkenes, alkynes, substitutions, eliminations, and organometallics. In addition, this course will focus on understanding how to draw reaction mechanisms.

briefs.name: 有機化學一
briefs.tags: 分子結構 Molecular Structure, 結構與性質關聯 Structure–Property Relationship, 酸鹼性 Acidity and Basicity, 立體化學 Stereochemistry, 加成反應 Addition Reactions, 親核取代反應 Nucleophilic Substitution, 消去反應 Elimination Reactions, 自由基反應 Radical Reactions
briefs.desc: 本課程介紹有機化學的基礎概念與重要反應類型，協助學生建立「分子結構—物理化學性質—反應性」之間的關聯。課程內容涵 蓋有機分子的結構與鍵結、酸鹼性、官能基特性、結構異構物與立體化學、烯類與炔類的加成反應、鹵素取代烷的取代與消去反 應，以及自由基反應等主題。 本課程特別強調有機化學在日常生活、材料、能源、藥物、聚合物與化工製程中的應用，使化工系學生能從分子層次理解物質性 質與反應行為，並培養後續學習高分子化學、反應工程、生物化學、材料化學與製程設計所需的有機化學基礎。

briefs.name: 有機化學一
briefs.tags: 有機化學 Organic Chemistry, 反應機構 Reaction Mechanisms, 立體化學 Stereochemistry, 官能基化學 Functional Group Chemistry, 芳香族化學 Aromatic Chemistry, 有機合成 Organic Synthesis, 酸鹼化學 Acid-base Chemistry, 分子結構 Molecular Structure, 化學反應性 Chemical Reactivity
briefs.desc: 本課程為有機化學基礎課程，介紹有機分子的結構、命名、立體化學、酸鹼性及反應性等核心概念。課程內容涵蓋烷類、烯 類、炔類、芳香族化合物及 各類官能基的化學性質與反應機構，並強調電子效應、反應機構分析與有機合成思維的建立。透過系統性的學習與問題演 練，培養學生理解有機化學原 理及解決化學問題的能力，作為後續進階化學課程與研究訓練的重要基礎。 This course introduces the fundamental principles of organic chemistry, including molecular structure, nomenclature, stereochemistry, acidity and basicity, and chemical reactivity. Topics include the chemistry and reaction mechanisms of alkanes, alkenes, alkynes, aromatic compounds, and major functional groups. Emphasis is placed on understanding electronic effects, reaction mechanisms, and synthetic strategies. Through lectures and problem- solving exercises, students will develop the ability to analyze organic reactions and build a solid foundation for advanced studies in chemistry.

briefs.name: 有機化學實驗一
briefs.tags: 有機化學實驗, 專業實作, 專業儀器操作, Organic experiment, Techniques and Experiments for Organic
briefs.desc: 本課程是有機化學專業實作科目，基於實作安全及難度考量，修習前須經過普化實驗之基礎訓練。本課程將連結實驗、儀器 及生活應用，目的在訓練學生獨立思考完成實作，將實驗結果利用儀器進行分析並和生活應用連結。 1.選擇新奇有趣及生活化的教材：使用原文教學實驗課本，加強學生閱讀外語文章及熟悉化學專業用語。選新奇有趣及生活 化的實驗(如從天然物裡取得有用的純化物、生化藥物抗生素之全合成、化學鑑定所使用魯米諾的合成及放光等)，激發學生 做實驗的興趣並能更有切身的體會。 2.嚴謹扎實的實驗訓練及經驗的傳承：有機實驗基本技巧是所有實驗的根本，加強訓練基礎技巧。督促學生邊實驗邊思考問 題及預判可能發展性，才能養成其從事研究之獨立思考能力。加強實作經驗的傳承，連想思考研究方向及知道如何開始著手 解決問題。 3.藥品安全與增添特殊器材增廣見識：養成學生閱讀藥品性質的習慣，隨時閱讀該藥品性質及知悉其危險性，增加使用藥品 安全性。增添新器材的使用，如短管蒸餾、冷凝管、乾浴器等應用等，讓實驗更多元化更活用器材的運用度。

briefs.name: 有機化學實驗一
briefs.tags: 有機化學實驗, 專業實作, 專業儀器操作, Organic experiment, Techniques and Experiments for Organic
briefs.desc: 本課程是有機化學專業實作科目，基於實作安全及難度考量，修習前須經過普化實驗之基礎訓練。本課程將連結實驗、儀器 及生活應用，目的在訓練學生獨立思考完成實作，將實驗結果利用儀器進行分析並和生活應用連結。 1.選擇新奇有趣及生活化的教材：使用原文教學實驗課本，加強學生閱讀外語文章及熟悉化學專業用語。選新奇有趣及生活 化的實驗(如從天然物裡取得有用的純化物、生化藥物抗生素之全合成、化學鑑定所使用魯米諾的合成及放光等)，激發學生 做實驗的興趣並能更有切身的體會。 2.嚴謹扎實的實驗訓練及經驗的傳承：有機實驗基本技巧是所有實驗的根本，加強訓練基礎技巧。督促學生邊實驗邊思考問 題及預判可能發展性，才能養成其從事研究之獨立思考能力。加強實作經驗的傳承，連想思考研究方向及知道如何開始著手 解決問題。 3.藥品安全與增添特殊器材增廣見識：養成學生閱讀藥品性質的習慣，隨時閱讀該藥品性質及知悉其危險性，增加使用藥品 安全性。增添新器材的使用，如短管蒸餾、冷凝管、乾浴器等應用等，讓實驗更多元化更活用器材的運用度。

briefs.name: 物理化學一
briefs.tags: thermodynamics, state functions, ideal gases, thermochemistry, enthalpy, Gibbs energy
briefs.desc: 1. Gas 2. Work, Heat, Internal energy, the first law 3. Enthalpy, state functions, heat capacity 4. J-T expansion 5. Thermochemistry 6. Entropy, the second law 7. The third law 8. Chemical equilibrium, Gibbs energy 9. Real gases, Fugacity 10. Phase diagram 11. Phase rules 12. Ideal solution, colligative properties 13. Electrolyte solutions

briefs.name: 應用數學
briefs.tags: Complex numbers (複數), Multivariable calculus (多變數微積分), Linear algebra (線性代數), Ordinary differential equations (常微分方程)
briefs.desc: This course is an introduction to applied mathematics required by chemistry undergraduate students including multivariable calculus, linear algebra, and ordinary differential equations. Examples will be drawn from a variety of scientific and mathematical areas.

briefs.name: 有機化學三
briefs.tags: bio-organic, carbohydrates, amino acids-peptides, nucleic acids, metabolic catalysis, lipids, and polymers
briefs.desc: This course will be mainly focused on bio-organic related chemistry including carbohydrates, amino acids, peptides/proteins, catalysis, coenzyme and metabolic pathways, lipids, and nucleic acids. A couple of special topics including polymers and pericyclic reactions will be discussed if there are enough time.

briefs.name: 分析化學一
briefs.tags: Chemical Equilibria, Electrochemical Methods, Spectrochemical methods, Separations, Data Analysis
briefs.desc: This course introduces the fundamental principles and methods of classical analytical chemistry, supplemented with selected modern analytical techniques. Upon completion, students will have a comprehensive understanding of chemical analysis methods. The knowledge and skills acquired will prepare students to independently design and conduct experiments across diverse scientific fields.

briefs.name: 分析化學實驗一
briefs.tags: 學習古典分析實驗的技巧
briefs.desc: 學習古典分析實驗的知識與技巧

briefs.name: 分析化學實驗一
briefs.tags: 學習古典分析實驗的技巧
briefs.desc: 學習古典分析實驗的知識與技巧

briefs.name: 無機化學一
briefs.tags: 無機化學, 有機金屬化學, 群論, 固態化學, 分子軌域,主族元素, Inorganic chemistry, organometallic, group theory, solid state chemistry, molecular orbital, main group elements
briefs.desc: 無機化學為有機化學的相對延伸，探討週期表中所有元素（除了碳與氫）及有機金屬化合物中碳的化學特性。無機化學的領域極 為廣泛，在現代科學發展應用上愈趨重要。例如有機金屬化學涵蓋對金屬-碳化合物的鍵結與有機反應的催化機制等研究；生物 無機化學為跨生物化學與無機化學領域的研究；環境化學則包含有機化學與無機化學二大領域。本課程將廣泛介紹現代無機化學 中各項主題，並著眼在基本知識的學習和思考能力的啟發，以作為未來深入研究的基石。

briefs.name: 物理化學三
briefs.tags: 核磁共振光譜學（Nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy），統計熱力學（Statistical thermodynamics），氣體動力論（Kinetic theory of gases），基礎化學動力學（Elementary chemical kinetics）
briefs.desc: The undergraduate course offers introduction to selected topics in physical chemistry. The topics include: (1) Nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy, (2) Statistical thermodynamics, (3) Kinetic theory of gases, and (4) Elementary chemical kinetics.

briefs.name: 物理化學實驗二
briefs.tags: Adsorption,electrical Conductance,Spectrum,電池,分子量的測定
briefs.desc: 本系所開設之”物理化學實驗”課，乃為配合大學部物理化學課程所開設的進階實驗課程。其宗旨為希望能藉由實際的實驗 操作 到基本電學及光學儀器之使用，來印證課堂上所學習之理論，特別是肉眼無法看到又特別難以理解的量子力學現象， 也可在實 驗中獲得驗證。因此在實驗設計上分別包括: 熱力學實驗、動力學實驗、電化學實驗及量子力學實驗，以期能提升學生對未來 從事高等研究的創造力與觀察力。
