briefs.tags: 論文研究, Thesis
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行深入研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之創新性成果。

briefs.name: 永續科技導論
briefs.tags: 永續科技Sustainable technology, 淨零轉型Net-zero transition, 循環經濟Circular economy, 生命週期評估Life cycle assessment, 能源轉型Energy transition, 資源循環Resource recovery, 系統思維 Systems thinking, ESG與治理ESG and governance
briefs.desc: 本課程為永續科技碩士學位核心院必修，旨在協助研究生建立跨領域之整體視野理解發展目標、氣候變遷、淨零轉型、循環 經濟、資源循環、綠色材料、能源轉型、生命週期思維與技術擴散等核心議題，並培養從問題界定、系統分析到技術方案評 估之能力。課程將以案例討論、文獻閱讀、專案提案與口頭報告為主，結合理論、政策與產業實務，訓練學生以科技方法回 應真世界之永續挑戰。 This graduate-level core course introduces students to the foundations and applications of sustainable technology. The course covers sustainable development goals, climate change and net-zero transition, circular economy, resource recovery, green materials, energy transition, life cycle thinking, and technology deployment. Emphasis is placed on systems thinking, problem framing, and the evaluation of technological solutions in environmental, social, and economic contexts. Through case discussions, literature reading, mini workshops, and a semester-long team project, students will learn how to analyze sustainability challenges an

briefs.name: 永續治理、創新與領導能力
briefs.tags: Sustainability Governance, Systems Thinking, Circular Economy, Anthropocene, Reflexive Leadership, ESG Reporting, Just Transition, Fiduciary Duty
briefs.desc: By the end of this 16-week course, students would be capable of: ● Explain the scientific, institutional, and systemic foundations of sustainability in the Anthropocene ● Critically evaluate sustainability governance frameworks (SDGs, ESG, ISO, reporting standards) ● Analyse organisations and systems using advanced systems-thinking approaches ● Design sustainability interventions that integrate governance, innovation and leadership ● Demonstrate ethical and reflexive leadership suited to complex sustainability challenges ● Communicate sustainability insights effectively and professionally

briefs.name: 台灣電力市場與能源戰略
briefs.nameEn: Taiwan Electricity Market and Energy Strategy
briefs.tags: 台灣電力市場,Taiwan power market,能源安全與風險治理,Energy security and risk governance,能源轉型與電網韌性
briefs.desc: 本課程以台灣電力市場與能源戰略為主題，從電力系統物理、法制制度、市場設計、能源轉型與地緣政治風險等面向，探討台 灣在高進口依賴、孤島電網、高科技產業用電成長與淨零轉型壓力下，如何維持供電穩定並強化能源韌性。課程內容涵蓋頻率 與備轉、輔助服務、儲能與需求反應、綠電交易、LNG 與咽喉點風險、AI 與半導體用電、核能與核廢料、漁電共生、BIPV、 電價補貼及國際能源危機應變。透過案例分析與政策討論，培養學生理解電力市場作為風險治理與轉型工具的能力。

briefs.name: 關鍵科技探索：人工智慧(磨課師)
briefs.tags: Artificial Intelligence, Medical AI, Computer Vision, LLM, AI Fairness, Trustworthy AI
briefs.desc: 人工智慧已經悄悄融入我們的生活：手機的推薦內容、自駕車的判斷、醫療診斷的輔助分析，這些日常操作的背後，都有 AI 正在運作。 這門課，帶你看清楚這場變革背後的技術與邏輯，一步步理解它的學習方式、判斷機制與生成能力。從 AI 的發展 歷程談起，進入機器學習、影像辨識與語言生成的世界，再延伸到最重要也最常被忽略的一環：AI 值得信任嗎？它做的決定公 平嗎？

briefs.name: 計算機程式設計一
briefs.tags: introduction to programming, Python language, computer science, structured language, modules
briefs.desc: This course introduces fundamental programming concepts using primarily the Python language and related environments. Fundamental concepts include overview of computer systems, language overview, numbers, string formatting, sequences, dictionaries and sets, control flow, exception, file, function, recursion, object orientation, inheritance, polymorphism, modules, generators, iterators, type hints, and match statements. The programming environment will be primarily text-based in Unix environment, although graphical user interface (IDLE) and web-based (Jupyter) will also be demonstrated.

briefs.name: 計算機程式設計一
briefs.tags: 計算機程式設計Introduction to Programming, Python程式設計Python Programming, 電腦科學Computer Science, 計算思維Computational Thinking, 結構化程式設計Structured Programming
briefs.desc: This course introduces fundamental programming concepts using primarily the Python language and related environments. The primary goal is to build a solid conceptual and practical foundation for subsequent coursework in data structures, systems programming, and software design. Fundamental concepts include an overview of computer systems, language overview, numbers, string formatting, sequences, dictionaries and sets, control flow, exceptions, files, functions, recursion, object orientation, inheritance, polymorphism, modules, generators, iterators, type hints, and match statements. The programming environment will be primarily text-based in a Unix environment. Graphical user interface and web-based tools will also be demonstrated.

briefs.name: 計算機程式設計二
briefs.tags: C/C++ 程式設計, C/C++ Programming
briefs.desc: 清華大學資工系必修課，主要對象為大一學生，延續計算機程式設計一，繼續磨練程式能力。

briefs.name: 電路與電子學一
briefs.tags: Circuits, Microelectronics, Diode, CMOS, Transistor, Field Effect Transistor
briefs.desc: This course is intended for undergraduates in the computer science and other engineering department. In this course, we focus on two main topics, electronics and circuits. To give students better understanding of the models and circuits of the electronics devices, we will introduce the basic concepts of electric circuits first. It starts from the definition of current, voltage, power and energy. Then it covers the basic circuit components including resister, capacitor, and inductor. We also discuss the basic circuit analysis, such as nodal analysis of resistive circuits, transients in electrical circuits and sinusoidal steady-state circuit behavior. For electronics section, we will present the diode and MOS field-effect transistor. We will use simple models to describe these electronic devices and their I-V characteristics. Since the majority of electronic circuits today are designed as integrated circuits (ICs), we will discuss how to analyze and design the basi

briefs.name: 硬體設計與實驗
briefs.tags: Digital, Logic Design, Hardware, Laboratory, 數位, 邏輯設計, 硬體設計, 實驗
briefs.desc: 本課程能讓同學深入了解數位硬體之設計流程，需先修過邏輯設計(EECS1010)課程。課程內容幫助同學快速領悟數位邏輯設計 理論，藉由高階硬 體描 述語言加以實現硬體設計，並在FPGA實驗版上驗證並展示，同時也學習如何與外界輸出入裝置如鍵 盤、螢幕，以及感測器等元件整合，因而能對 數位 邏輯設計有更深一層的體驗與認知。

briefs.name: 線性代數
briefs.tags: 線性方程Linear equations, 矩陣Matrices, 向量空間Vector spaces,內積空間Inner-product spaces, 特徵值與特徵向量Eigenvalues and eigenvectors,奇異值分解Singular value decomposition
briefs.desc: Linear algebra is a fundamental branch of mathematics with wide-ranging applications in science, engineering, computer science, economics, and many other areas. This course begins with solving systems of linear equations, then progresses to linear transformations, the study of matrices and their properties, and the abstract framework of vector spaces. The course aims to provide students with a solid foundation in linear algebra while developing mathematical rigor through proofs and abstract reasoning. A variety of applications will be covered with particular emphasis on their relevance to computer science.

briefs.name: 線性代數
briefs.tags: System of linear equations, determinant, vector space, orthogonality, eigenvalues
briefs.desc: Linear algebra is a fundamental branch of mathematics focused on the study of linear equations and the properties of matrices. Its concepts are widely applicable in engineering, physics, economics, social sciences, and natural sciences. This course aims to provide students with a solid foundation in elementary linear algebra and will also introduce its diverse applications across various areas.

briefs.name: 離散數學
briefs.tags: Logic, proofs, sets, functions, sequences, combinatorics, graph, and tree.
briefs.desc: An introduction to the discrete mathematics of computer science, including logic, methods of proof, sets and set operations, functions, sequences, combinatorics, and graph theory.

briefs.name: 離散數學
briefs.tags: Logic, Relations and Functions, Generating Functions, Graph Theory, Group
briefs.desc: This course is to provide an introductory survey in both discrete and combinatorial mathematics.

briefs.name: 資料結構
briefs.tags: Data Structure, Programming, C/C++, Stacks and Queues, linked Lists, Trees, Graphs, Sorting, Hashing
briefs.desc: This course introduces basic concepts of data representation and manipulation. We will teach how to solve a given problem efficiently and effectively by using proper and specific structures to organize data and by adapting algorithms to solve the problem. For instance, given a list of names and corresponding personal information such as cellphone number, home address, etc, how do we organize the data such that we could efficiently perform a query of specific information? After taking this course, you would immediately answer the question by using “Array” structure to store data and then sort it in decreasing or increasing order based on a certain kind of property. Finally the query could be effectively responded by using a binary search algorithm.

briefs.name: 資料結構
briefs.tags: Data Structure, Programming, C++, Arrays, Stacks and Queues, linked Lists, Trees, Graphs, Sorting, Hashing, Hash Tables
briefs.desc: This course introduces the basic concepts of data representation and manipulation in computer programs. We will introduce common data structures, including arrays, stacks, queues, linked lists, trees, graphs, and hash tables, and discuss their advantages and disadvantages. We will also discuss how to solve problems efficiently and effectively by using proper data structures to organize data, and adapting algorithms. This course will be offered in English.

briefs.name: 密碼與網路安全概論
briefs.tags: Encryption; DES; AES; Algebra; Security
briefs.desc: The course intends to provide a practical, up-to-date, and comprehensive survey of Cryptography and Network Security. This course will introduce the symmetric-key cryptography, both traditional and modern; asymmetric-key cryptography; hash function for message integrity and authentication, network security protocols, and some practical security issues.

briefs.name: 最佳化理論與應用
briefs.tags: 最佳化 Optimization, 數學建模 Mathematical Modeling, 決策分析 Decision Making, 分析方法 Analytical Methods, 計算方法 Computing Approaches
briefs.desc: Optimization Paradigms introduces the fundamental principles and frameworks of mathematical optimization. It equips students with the analytical tools necessary to make effective decisions in complex systems. Key topics explore different optimization paradigms through mathematical modeling and computational strategies for solving real-world problems. Students will learn how to model decision- making scenarios, analyze systems, allocate resources efficiently, and derive optimal or near-optimal solutions.

briefs.name: 作業系統
briefs.tags: operating systems, thread, process, memory, synchronization, IO, storage
briefs.desc: 本課程將介紹作業系統的基本架構和技術，主要分成程序(process)、記憶體(memory)、以及儲存(storage)三大部分。課程 的進行除了用投影片講解基本觀念之外，還會使用Nachos這套教學用的作業系統，讓學生實際解析和實作作業系統的程式碼。

briefs.name: 作業系統
briefs.tags: Hand-on Experiment, Scheduling, Performance, Storage, Resource Distribution, System Programming 實做導向, 排程, 效能, 儲存, 資源分配, 系統程式設計
briefs.desc: This course explores how modern operating systems work. You will learn how an operating system manages hardware resources, and how it ensures secure and fair resource sharing among processes. We will cover process management, system calls, virtual memory, storage, scheduling, virtualization, and modern system architectures. You learn by doing. You will acquire the skills to analyze, debug, and improve the complex systems you use every day. You will run virtual machines and containers in a miniR09;cloud, trace system calls, and write programs that communicate with each other through the interfaces the operating system offers. You will form a team, maintain shared notes, and explore together. The course follows a flippedR09;classroom format. You watch videos and read textbook articles to learn the basics at home, then come to class to test your knowledge and interact with others.

briefs.name: 計算機系統管理
briefs.tags: 資訊,電腦,雲端,資安,UNIX,BSD,Linux,Information,Computer,Cloud,Security
briefs.desc: 本課程將訓練選修同學具有UNIX(BSD/Linux)系統管理、使用與操作的能力,並且能在其平台上開發新的應用平台。

briefs.name: 競技程式設計一
briefs.tags: C++ 程式設計, Algorithm 演算法,Data Structure 資料結構,ICPC 國際大學生程式設計競賽,Team Work 團體合作
briefs.desc: 這是參與國際性程式設計競賽的入門課程。它將涵蓋基本的問題 解決技能，如分治法、貪心算法、動態規劃等。將教授資料結 構、圖論和 C++STL 等主題。本課程旨在鼓勵學生參加國際性程式設計競賽，並為參賽者提供基礎培訓。

briefs.name: 系統整合實作一
briefs.tags: 系統整合實作
briefs.desc: 專題生本學期需跟著指導教授做研究，指導教授將依學生的表現來評分。

briefs.name: 系統整合實作二
briefs.tags: 系統整合實作
briefs.desc: 專題生本學期需跟著指導教授做研究，指導教授將依學生的表現來評分。

briefs.name: 獨立研究一
briefs.tags: 特殊選才、獨立研究、優等計畫
briefs.desc: 本課程由學生基於自己特殊專長自行向任課教師提出優等研究計畫書，由學生主導執行

briefs.name: 獨立研究二
briefs.tags: 特殊選才、獨立研究、優等計畫
briefs.desc: 本課程由學生為獨立研究一之延續，基於自己特殊專長自行向任課教師提出優等研究計畫書，由學生主導執行。

briefs.name: 計算機結構
briefs.tags: computer architecture, instruction set architecture, processor design, memory design, data path, cache design, pipelined processor
briefs.desc: To understand how a computer system works. Emphasis will be placed on 1. What characterizes the performance of a computer 2. Instruction set design 3. Basic building blocks: I/O, Memory, Datapath, Control 4. Pipelined datapath 5. Memory hierarchy

briefs.name: 計算方法設計
briefs.tags: algorithms, data structures
briefs.desc: 大網： I Foundations 1. The role of Algorithms in Computing 2. Getting Started 3. Growth of Functions 4. Divide-and-Conquer II Sorting and Order Statistics 6. Heapsort 7. Quicksort 8. Sorting in Linear Time 9. Medians and Order Statistics IV Advanced Design and Analysis Techniques 15. Dynamic Programming 16. Greedy Algorithms 17. Amortized Analysis V Advanced Data Structures 21. Data Structures for Disjoint Sets VI Graph Algorithms 22. Elementary Graph Algorithms 23. Minimum Spanning Trees 24. Single-Source Shortest Paths 25. All-Pairs Shortest Paths 26. Maximum Flow VII Selected Topics 31. Number-Theoretic Algorithms 33. Computational Geometry 34. NP-Completeness 35. Approximation Algorithms

briefs.name: 計算方法設計
briefs.tags: Approximation Algorithms，Divide and Conquer，Dynamic Programming，Greedy Algorithms ，Graph，NP-Complete，Time Complexity Analysis
briefs.desc: 本課程主要內容為各種演算法的設計及其時間複雜度的分析，演算法設計策略包含Divide-and-Conquer、Dynamic Programming、Greedy Algorithms等，時間複雜度的分析包含Growth of Functions、 Amortized Analysis。此外也 會介紹一些解決圖形(Graph)方面的問題如最短路徑問題。 最後也會介紹NP-Completeness 及Approximation Algorithms。

briefs.name: 進階C++：物件導向與大型專案
briefs.nameEn: Advanced C++: Large-Scale Projects and Object-Oriented Design
briefs.tags: C++17/20, object-Oriented Design, Templates, Concurrency, Performance Optimization, TBB, Large-Scale Project Management
briefs.desc: 本課程聚焦於現代 C++ (17/20) 的工程實踐，涵蓋大型專案的架構設計、物件導向模式、錯誤處理、並行程式設計、效能分 析與資料導向設計。課程將結合理論與開源專案導讀，並透過專案整合，培養學生管理大型 C++ 專案的能力。

briefs.name: 機器學習概論
briefs.tags: Machine learning, pattern recognition, artificial intelligent, representation learning, deep learning
briefs.desc: This course covers principles, algorithms, and applications of machine learning. The topics include formulation of learning problem, supervised learning, unsupervised learning, and model evaluation. Some classical methods such as support vector machines, random forests, and neural networks will be introduced. Upon successful completion of this course, students will be expected to become familiar with widely used machine learning algorithms and to be able to apply the algorithms to real data.

briefs.name: FPGA結構及設計自動化
briefs.tags: field programmable gate arrays, design flow, CAD tools, technology mapping, placement, routing, timing optimization, power optimization
briefs.desc: Field programmable gate arrays (FPGAs) are computer logic chips whose function and wiring can be re-programmed. FPGAs enable the creation of custom computing engines with higher efficiency than conventional software-programmed processors. FPGA-based electronic designs are found everywhere such as consumer gadgets, wired and wireless communication, automotive, industrial, medical, scientific, aerospace, military, etc. FPGAs are one of the first commercially available 3D/2.5D ICs. FPGAs are highly power-efficient for implementing neural networks for accelerating AI applications. Cloud service providers are offering customers the ability to use FPGAs as accelerators. Increasingly, FPGAs are displacing ASICs and ASSPs as IC design complexity and manufacturing costs continue to rise. This course first introduces the characteristics, evolution and usage of field-programmable technologies, and then continues to look into some advanced researches related to FPGA

briefs.name: 寬頻行動通訊
briefs.tags: communication technology, channel models, wireless networks, OFDM, resource allocation
briefs.desc: This course covers technologies aiming at providing high data rate in wireless networks, with an emphasis on broadband-related techniques.

briefs.name: 網路之隨機程序
briefs.tags: Poisson processes, renewal processes, Markov chains
briefs.desc: This course will cover the fundamental theory of random processes with emphasis on applications to a variety of networks. This is a basic yet important course for students pursuing studies in these fields.

briefs.name: 社群網路
briefs.tags: social networks, economics, graph theory, game theory, network science
briefs.desc: The past decade has seen a growing interest in the complex “connectedness” of modern society. At the heart of this fascination is the idea of a network. How we make decisions to adopt a new idea, to invest by buying/selling security stocks, or even to vote for a specific campaign candidate is influenced by the people that we are linked with. How people behave is affected by incentives and by their expectations about the behaviors of the people with whom they are linked. In this course the students will be exposed to an interdisciplinary body of knowledge in sciences, engineering, social sciences, economics, business, political science and medical health studies. The goal of this course is to show how social network is applied to the study of economics, political science, and medical health study.

briefs.name: 計算生物學
briefs.tags: 演算法, 序列比對, 序列片斷重組, 種族樹建構, RNA二級結構
briefs.desc: 這門課將介紹一些有關於分子生物的計算問題(即計算生物學)，並且著重於解決這些問題的演算法設計與分析。在這門課程中將討論的主題包含序列比對、字串配對、序列片斷重組、物理圖譜、種族樹建構、RNA二級結構預測等。

briefs.name: 隨機演算法
briefs.tags: Randomization, Algorithms, Probability, Computing, Analysis
briefs.desc: Randomization and probabilistic techniques play an important role in modern computer science, with applications ranging from combinatorial optimization and machine learning to communication networks and secure protocols. This course intends to give an introduction to the probabilistic techniques and paradigms used in the development of probabilistic algorithms and analyses. Only elementary background in discrete mathematics is required. ** This course does not involve the usage of AI.

briefs.name: 數值最佳化
briefs.tags: Numerical optimization; linear programming; constrained optimization; linear algebra; machine learning
briefs.desc: Numerical optimization concerns the computations of the maximum (or the minimum) of differentiable functions which can have one or several variables, with or without constraints. Important classes in the numerical optimization problems include linear programming, unconstrained optimization, and nonlinear programming. This course will study the numerical algorithms and the theoretical background for each kind of problems. Applications that motivate the computation, especially for machine learning and deep learning, will be focused.

briefs.name: 計算理論
briefs.tags: Automata, regular language, pumping lemma, Turing maching, decidable language
briefs.desc: 這門課程的名稱為計算理論，主要探 討的內容是計算的內涵與極限。本課程也 將同時涵蓋 automata theory。課程主要以上課為 主，再搭配作業及考試。

briefs.name: 量子計算概論
briefs.tags: 量子計算quantum computation 量子力學quantum mechanics 複雜度理論complexity theory 量子演算法quantum algorithm 量子搜尋quantum search 量子因數分解quantum factoring
briefs.desc: 本課程介紹基礎量子計算原理與理論 量子計算理論為整合了量子力學與計算機理論的跨領域學科 本課程會對兩方面都進行教學 於量子力學方面 會介紹量子態 量子糾纏 量子測量等基本概念 於計算機理論則會介紹複雜度 預言機等概念 而量子計算部分 除基礎理論外 會介紹Shor演算法與Grover演算法

briefs.name: 高等編譯器
briefs.tags: Compiler, C, C++, Optimizations, OpenCL
briefs.desc: This course will introduce the aspect of embedded compiler techniques in ILP code optimizations, DSP Compilers, multi-core compilers for low power, and embedded and heterogeneous dual-core optimizations. This course now also covers basic prospect of AI compiler. This course will include LLVM software projects and use of embedded tools. This course is considered as an advanced course after basic compiler course and before the more advanced graduate compiler course. This can also be considered as the 1st course of compiler course in the graduate school. Following the experiences last year, we will also include special topic presentations from registered students.

briefs.name: 虛擬化技術與應用
briefs.tags: 虛擬機器；容器技術；雲端計算；資料中心；容錯系統；5G基地台；邊緣計算
briefs.desc: 虛擬化技術已經廣泛被應用於遊戲開發、雲端計算、邊緣計算、5G基地台等應用。不但軟體上的改進，連帶的硬體上的設計也 以輔助虛擬化為主要的訴求之一，現今高端的CPU都已經能支援虛擬化技術，而越來越多的GPU和網路卡也有支援虛擬化的設 備。可以說虛擬化的技術已經普及到各個領域。本課程將介紹虛擬機器與container系統，包括他們的原理和實作細節，並且 配合系統的實作，讓學生可以更深入的了解虛擬技術的運作。此外，我們也將介紹虛擬化技術的各項運用，包含雲端計算的資 料中心、容錯系統、5G基地台、邊緣計算等。

briefs.name: 平行程式
briefs.tags: parallel programming, performance optimization, distributed computing
briefs.desc: 本課程將介紹平行計算的基礎觀念和電腦系統架構，並教授針對不同平行計算環境所設計的程式語言，包括多核心系統使用的 Pthread、OpenMP, 叢集計算使用的MPI, GPU使用的CUDA。修課同學必須使用這些平行計算的語言和工具完成數個程式作業，並 且以程式的執行效能結果作為學習的評量標準。

briefs.name: 進階高效能計算叢集電腦實務
briefs.nameEn: Advanced High Performance Computing Cluster Practice
briefs.tags: 叢集電腦,高效能計算,系統操作,效能優化分析,基礎系統建設
briefs.desc: 本課程將結合講義授課、競賽討論、實驗操作等方式教授進階的叢集電腦部署管理技術，和在叢集電腦優化分析平行計算軟體效 能的方法。修課者必須已經熟悉linux系統的管理使用，並對應用程式的編譯安裝有基礎知識和經驗。

briefs.name: 軟體專案管理
briefs.tags: Software Quality Assurance, Software Project Management, Software Measurement, Software Metrics, Software Testing
briefs.desc: This course provides an overview of the roles, responsibilities, and management methods of the technology project manager. The course assumes no prior knowledge in management techniques and is intended to teach students how to develop approaches and styles of management for software projects. The course assumes a basic understanding of software analysis techniques.

briefs.name: 遊戲程式設計
briefs.tags: Game programming, Unity 3D
briefs.desc: Game development is a hot topic in the modern entertainment industry. In this course, we will introduce a popular game engine, Unity3D. In the first half of the course, we will present various components in Unity3D that are fundamental for the beginner of game development. The remaining lectures will cover advanced topics necessary for producing games with large-scale, high quality, and rich interactivity. Every student is requested to participate in a team-project with the capacity of up to 4 persons. Each team will present a complete and original game at the end of the semester. Those outstanding works will be recommended to join a domestic game competition.

briefs.name: 繪圖程式設計與應用
briefs.nameEn: Introduction to Graphics Programming and Applications
briefs.tags: Computer Graphics, OpenGL, Rendering Pipeline, Shader, GLSL, WebGL
briefs.desc: Introducing the programmable graphics rendering pipeline in the context of OpenGL shading language.

briefs.name: 多媒體技術於運動科學之應用
briefs.tags: Sports technology, computer vision, action analysis, virtual reality, data visualization
briefs.desc: 本課程以 Project-based Learning 為核心，由授課教師提出運動科技專題題目（涵蓋運動影像分析、VR/AR 訓練系統、運動資料視 覺化等方向），學生分組認領題目、進行分工實作。課程結合 NTHU × Qualcomm University Engagement Program，於期中後安排 三週 Qualcomm Edge AI 平台模組教學（Qualcomm AI Hub、Edge Impulse、Arduino UnoQ、HTC VIVE Eagle AR glasses），學生將學習 on-device AI 模型部署與 edge 裝置整合，並將其應用於專題後期開發。其餘技術（電腦視覺、動作分析、 虛擬實境、資料視覺化等）由各組依專題需求，在授課教師與課程助教指導下自主學習。學生將完整經歷從需求分析、系統設計、原型開 發、edge 部署、使用者測試到成果發表之流程，培養跨領域團隊協作、自主學習與系統整合能力。

briefs.name: 圖形識別
briefs.tags: pattern classification, supervised learning, unsupervised learning, feature selection, dimension reduction
briefs.desc: The goal of pattern recognition is to classify unknown patterns into a number of categories, to automatically detect patterns in data, and to make data-driven decisions. This course will teach students basic pattern recognition procedures as well as some selected techniques.

briefs.name: 醫學資訊簡介
briefs.teacher: 唐傳義,林沿妊,林文綺,葉肩宇
briefs.tags: 醫療數據 (health data),醫學影像 (medical image),電子病歷(electronic health records, HER),國際醫療資料交換標準(FHIR)
briefs.desc: 本課程目的在讓學生了解醫療數據，醫療數據裡存在著資料結構及傳輸中需要的標準，能讓學生了解醫療數據的重要性。

briefs.name: 數位醫療資料科學
briefs.tags: Data Science資料科學, Digital Health 數位醫療, Computer-Aided Diagnosis 電腦輔助診斷, Smart Healthcare 智慧醫療, Artificial Intelligence for Medicine醫療人工智慧, Machine Learning 機器學習
briefs.desc: This course explores the practical aspects of implementing data science in digital healthcare settings. The course emphasizes the importance of creating robust, private, and fair models using real retrospective healthcare data. Throughout the course, students will complete homework assignments and will finish with a project proposal and presentation. The course provides hands-on experience in dataset creation and curation, machine learning training, visualization, and deployment considerations that target utility and clinical value. Additionally, students will partner with computer scientists, social scientists, and clinicians to gain a better understanding of the multidisciplinary nature of data science in healthcare.

briefs.name: 人工智慧倫理、法律與社會
briefs.teacher: 賴尚宏,李怡俐,林勤富,郭昱廷
briefs.tags: AI, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, AI Ethics, AI Privacy, AI Safety, AI Fairness, AI Equality, AI Explanability, Democrazy, Responsible AI, Explainable AI, AI governance, AI laws, AI regulation
briefs.desc: This AI Ethics, Laws, and Society class aims to provide an introduction of various topics of AI Ethics to help establish a foundation for the students to better understand the importance, design/principles, technology, policy/regulation/governance, implementation, and impact of all aspects of AI ethics. We will discuss these topics from the perspectives of Privacy, Safety, Fairness, Equality, Robustness, Accountability, Explanability, Human dignity, Human rights, Democracy, etc. We will also introduce various use cases and scenarios of challenges in AI ethics (e.g., surveillance, recruitment, autonomous driving, finance, etc.).

briefs.name: 演化計算
briefs.tags: 演化計算 Evolutionary Computation, 人工智慧 Artificial Intelligence, 計算智慧 Computational Intelligence, 基因演算法 Genetic Algorithm, 演化策略 Evolution Strategies, 遺傳規劃 Genetic Programming, 最佳化 Optimization
briefs.desc: Evolutionary computation is a significant subfield of AI and serves as a powerful problem solver for search, optimization, and machine learning problems. This course provides an introduction to the algorithms, theory, and application of evolutionary computation, geared toward students who are interested in development and/or application of the subject. Topics in algorithms and theory include genetic algorithms, evolution strategies, genetic programming, parameter setting and analysis. Topics in application include optimization, constraint handling, machine learning, and multi-objective optimization.

briefs.name: 自然語言處理
briefs.tags: 資訊檢索,資訊擷取,語言模型,生成式AI,大型語言模型,自然語言理解,情緒分析,Information retrieval, Information extraction, language model, Generative artificial intelligence, Natural language understanding, Sentiment analysis
briefs.desc: 介紹自然語言處理概念與相關理論，包含文字基本處理技術，資訊檢索與擷取和各種自然語言處理應用任務。並利用介紹預訓練 語言模型的發展與應用，帶入生成式AI的相關文字處理模型。並從大型語言模型訓練與微調角度看待文字相關應用的前瞻解決方 案，並導入實際場域資料與應用練習。

briefs.name: 深度學習
briefs.tags: machine learning, deep learning, neural networks, artificial intelligence, 機器學習, 深度學習, 類神經網路, 人工智能
briefs.desc: This class introduces the concepts and techniques of deep learning. The course consists of three parts. In the first part, we give a quick introduction of classical machine learning and review some key concepts required to understand deep learning. In the second part, we discuss how deep learning differs from classical machine learning and explain why it is effective in dealing with complex problems such as the image and natural language processing. Various types of deep models will be covered. In the third part, we introduce the deep reinforcement learning and its applications. This course also gives coding labs. We will use Python 3 as the main programming language throughout the course. Some machine learning libraries such as Scikit-learn and TensorFlow will be explained and heavily used.

briefs.name: 圖探勘
briefs.tags: 圖 (graph), 資料探勘 (data mining), 查詢處理 (query processing),圖深度學習 (deep learning on graphs), 圖樣式 (graph patterns)
briefs.desc: In this course, we will first introduce the patterns and laws of the graphs, followed by the graph generators. Then, we will introduce important graph mining applications, with graph querying and indexing techniques. We will also cover the topics of deep learning on graphs.

briefs.name: 研究方法一
briefs.tags: 研究方法
briefs.desc: 研究生本學期需跟著指導教授做研究，期末繳交成績報告，指導教授將依學生的表現與報告來評分。

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: 書報討論, 資訊工程, 人工智慧, 演算法, 網路, 人機界面, 資訊安全
briefs.desc: 每週邀請學界業界專業學者演講，介紹資訊工程學系內各領域的最新進展與研究成果。

briefs.name: 平行計算方法設計
briefs.tags: parallel, algorithms
briefs.desc: PART I 1. Introduction .Classification of parallel computers .Performance of parallel algorithms 2. Shared-memory computers, basic techniques, and Brent Theorem PART II 3. Tree Machine 4. Linear-processor array 5. Mesh-connected computers 6. Hypercubes 7. Perfect shuffles 8. Mesh-connected computers with multiple broadcasting 9. Processor arrays with reconfigurable bus systems PART III 10. Systolic architectures 11. Fault-tolerance, randomized algorithms, P-completeness

briefs.name: 計算機視覺理論
briefs.tags: computer vision, pattern recognition, machine learning, image processing, deep learning
briefs.desc: This course is to give an introductory background in computer vision for senior undergraduate students and graduate students. It will cover the following main topics: image formation, feature extraction, texture, multi-view geometry, camera calibration, 3D geometry reconstruction, image motion analysis, image segmentation, object detection, image classification, deep learning and related applications.

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 行動計算專題
briefs.tags: mobile computing, networks, communication systems, probability modeling, analysis
briefs.desc: Discuss current research issues of mobile computing and networking. The course will be run in a survey manner. We will examine a collection of papers from prestigious conference proceedings and journals, as well as technical reports and documents.

briefs.name: 網際網路平台設計專題
briefs.nameEn: Special Topic on Internet Platform Design
briefs.tags: Internet, map-reduce, distributed system, cloud computing, fault tolerance
briefs.desc: 本課程限碩博生修習，是一個研究性 的專題課程，藉著收 集，研讀相關的論文，以及定期的討 論會，並鎖定一個研 究題目，進 行研究，最後目標是產生一篇高品質 的論文

briefs.name: 邊緣智慧專題
briefs.tags: 次世代通訊, 邊緣運算, 邊緣智慧, 聯邦式學習, 智慧物聯網, Next-generation Communication, Edge Computing, Edge Intelligence/AI, Federated Learning, AIoT
briefs.desc: 邊緣智慧 (Edge Intelligence/AI) 是基於邊緣運算 (Edge Computing) 以及人工智慧 (AI) 應運而生的次世代網路框架，除了 繼承邊緣運算之分散式架構特性，能將應用程式、數據資料與服務的運算，由雲端伺服器中心，搬移至貼近使用者端的霧端邊緣節點來處理 以大幅降低服務延遲時間。考量到智慧物聯網 (AIoT) 服務將產生多元大數據以滿足各式應用情境，邊緣智慧將關注如何在確保使用者隱 私前提下，讓這些數據能夠透過人工智慧訓練模型淬鍊出有用之資訊。本課程將以研究最新的邊緣智慧技術為主，探討跟B5G/6G的銜接 性、如何基於Edge Computing架構整合AI、如何實現AIoT各式應用等。特別會關注Google 提出之聯邦式學習架構 (Federated Learning) 以實現具隱私考量之邊緣智慧學習策略，並進一步聚焦相關之資安議題目標使邊緣智慧服務順利實現。

briefs.name: 資料庫系統專題二
briefs.nameEn: Special Topics in Data Base Management Systems(II)
briefs.tags: 研究方法, 簡報技巧, 論文寫作, academic writing, research presentation
briefs.desc: This course is designed for graduate students who are interested in knowing state- of-the arts and applications of the information technology. The objective of this course is: 1) guide students to recognize the current state of the art of information technology and emerging killing applications; 2) identify their research topics; and 3) write a research proposal in the related fields. Students will learn how to find an interesting IT application problem by surveying a specific application domain, understand the current information techniques available to solve the problem, assess the applicability and weakness of the current IT technology to the problem, narrow down specific aims as research goal for writing a research problem.

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文, Thesis
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: 電晶體技術, 半導體製程技術, 半導體製造, 半導體設備, 專家、就業
briefs.desc: 本課程主要是邀請半導體公司主管或專家探討新的半導體技術未來發展，並了解其應用趨勢，讓學生更清楚未來就業方向。內容 更包括一些技術原理和流程，使學生在學習專業知識之外，更能理解半導體生態和未來職場上的運作機制。

briefs.name: 業界實習
briefs.tags: 業界實習
briefs.desc: 學生經指導教授同意至合適的半導體相關產業或研究單位進行實習，拓展學習視野並習得學以致用之實務經驗。

briefs.name: 半導體元件導論
briefs.tags: 半導體, 元件, 電晶體，二極體，雷射，光感測器 (Semiconductor, Device, Transistor, Diode, Laser, Photodetector)
briefs.desc: Students will gain a comprehensive introductory account of essential semiconductor device physics and operational principles.

briefs.name: 三維及次世代記憶體
briefs.tags: Semiconductor memory, Flash memory, DRAM, 3 dimensional memory cell, In memory computing
briefs.desc: Semiconductor memories have mainly two uses. One is for the calculation by exchanging data with CPU, MPU, etc. The other is for the mass data storage. Demands for these two applications are following; 1. Low cost and high density, 2. High speed operation, 3. Low power consumption. Therefore, memory technologies have been evolved more than 30 years to satisfy these demands. Moreover, new application has been noticed for the calculation of AI which is called in memory computing. Furthermore, memory device and CPU/MPU are connected chip-to-chip and can get quite high speed and low power operation. I will introduce these new technologies. Following are the outline of the course. Part1: Basic concept of memories: 1. DRAM & SARM 2.NOR-Flash 3. NAND-Flash Part2: 1. 3D NAND, In-memory computing for AI calculation.

briefs.name: 奈米級CMOS技術發展與領導力
briefs.nameEn: Nanoscale CMOS Technology Development and Leadership
briefs.tags: Leadership, Nanoscale CMOS Technology, Phoenix and Unicorn, Innovation with Uncertainty,Semiconductor Ecosystem
briefs.desc: At nanoscale nodes, physics creates constraints, system architecture sets objectives, and leadership determines who captures value. Students learn how DTCO evolved into STCO and why different companies won (or lost) across mobile → AI training → edge AI inflections.

briefs.name: 半導體材料導論
briefs.tags: 半導體材料semiconductor materials,能帶理論band theory,光電性質optoelectrical property,半導體元件semiconductor device,分析技術characterization techniques
briefs.desc: The purpose of this course is to provide students of engineering discipline an overview of the basic properties, applications, and major types of semiconductors, as well as characterization techniques employed in the analysis of semiconductor materials.

briefs.name: 半導體記憶體導論
briefs.tags: semiconductor memory, Static random access memory, dynamic random access memory, ferroelectric memory, Flash memory, resistive memory
briefs.desc: This course provides an in-depth understanding of semiconductor memory technologies, focusing on current industry scaling trends and state-of-the-art technologies. The topics covered include SRAM, DRAM, and Flash bit-cell architectures, along with memory array design. The first section of the course delves into the common semiconductor memory technologies, while the second section explores innovative memory technology applications for machine/deep learning and upcoming memory candidates that have the potential to reshape the memory hierarchy. The course is designed for graduate students in electrical and computer engineering programs, as well as professionals and researchers in the semiconductor and microelectronics industries. 本課程提供對半導體儲存技術的深入了解，重點關注當前的行業擴展趨勢和最先進的技術。涵蓋的主題包括 SRAM、DRAM 和快閃記憶體 單 元 架構以及記憶體陣列設計。課程的第一部分深入研究常見的半導體記憶體技術，而第二部分則探討機器/深度學習的創新記憶體技術

briefs.name: 半導體設計導論
briefs.tags: VLSI, circuit design, logic design, HDL, computer architecture, electronic design automation, 超大型積體電路, 電路設計, 邏輯設計, 硬體設計語言, 計算機結構, 電子設計自動化
briefs.desc: The objective of this course is to provide students an overview of VLSI designs, particularly about how we manage to integrate billions of transistors to perform complex functions. This course focuses on three major topics: logic design, electronic design automation, and computer architecture. Students will learn the layered abstraction of design technology from the ground up, including combinational/sequential circuits, gate-level design, physical layout, micro-architecture, and processor cores.

briefs.name: 設計自動化二
briefs.tags: EDA tools for custom design, DRC, LVS, 3DIC, RC extraction, spice simulator, OPC
briefs.desc: In this DA(2), we will cover the practical aspects in EDA tool development for DRC (design rule checking), LVS (layout-versus-schematic), custom design, RC extraction, 3DIC layout. On top of them, we are lucky to have experts coming in to teach how to develop spice simulator, waveform viewing and OPC (litho optical proximity correction)

briefs.name: 全流程智慧系統設計基礎二
briefs.nameEn: Essentials of Intelligent System Design Flow Ⅱ
briefs.tags: 晶片設計流程, 晶片簽核流程, 客制化IC設計流程, 數位IC設計流程, Chip design flow, Chip signoff flow, Full-Custom IC design flow, Cell-based digital IC design flow
briefs.desc: In this course, entitled “Essentials of Intelligent System Design Flow II”, we would focus on IC/Chip(let)-level design methodology including Full-Custom IC design flow such as analog and RF ICs design and Cell-based digital IC design flow such as physical synthesis, physical implementation, and multi-core silicon sign-off etc. Students can get the essential components of the challenges of latest IC/Chip(let)-level circuit design, advanced layout, simulation, synthesis, and silicon signoff. In addition, HLS (high-level synthesis) design flow based on generative artificial intelligence, which converts specifications into RTL, will also be included in this course.

briefs.name: 超大型積體電路測試與診斷
briefs.tags: Test Automation 測試自動化, Diagnosis 診斷,Design for test 可測試性設計 , Fault simulation 故障模擬, Automatic test pattern generation 測試自動產生,Test compression 測試壓縮,Built in self test 內建自我測試,Delay test 延遲測試
briefs.desc: This course is devoted to the fundamental knowledge of Very Large-Scale Integration (VLSI) circuits testing and diagnosis. The emphasis has two parts: 1. on investigating various technically feasible test solutions and design-for-test hardware to ensure the overall testability and quality of manufactured ICs. 2. on investigating various diagnosis solutions and design-for-diagnosis hardware to ensure the overall diagnosis quality. It begins with fault modeling and fault simulation, followed by algorithms for Automatic Test Pattern Generation (ATPG). Then, widely adopted design-for-test techniques. At the final stage, diagnosis and design-for-diagnosis for failing dies will be discussed.

briefs.name: 半導體製程導論
briefs.tags: CMOS, Lithography, Thin Film, Etching, Plasma, FEOL, BEOL, Integration
briefs.desc: This course is designed to teach the core technologies and theories of semiconductor process integration, with a strong focus on three fundamental manufacturing processes: photolithography, thin- film deposition, and etching. Utilizing CMOS process technology as the primary framework, the course systematically covers the complete manufacturing flow, starting from front-end-of-line (FEOL) processes, such as silicon wafer cleaning, through to back-end-of-line (BEOL) metal interconnect integration. Through this course, students will build a solid foundation in industry-standard semiconductor manufacturing processes and acquire the practical skills necessary for future advanced academic research and development.

briefs.name: 半導體微影、RET、Immersion、EUV
briefs.tags: Nanolithography theory and practice 奈米微影理論和應用，Nanolithography materials 奈米微影材料，Nonolithography equipment 奈米微影機台，EM wave diffraction 光波繞射
briefs.desc: This course covers the key aspects of nanolithography in theory, practice, and innovations on diffraction-based imaging as well as materials, equipment, and processing in nanolithography. There is also coverage on well-proven as well as exploratory systems to expose students to many different situations, providing opportunities to train students in creativity, logical thinking, and problem solving, as well as equipping them for R&D and production engineering work in semiconductor companies. 這門課包含光波繞射、奈米微影材料、奈米微影機台、和奈米微影製程的理論、應用、和創新的基本觀念；也包括各種成熟 和尚在開發中的奈米微影系統給學生們機會考量各種不同的情況，來促進他們創新、邏輯思考、和解決問題的能力，裝備學 生們在半導體公司研發和生產的能力。

briefs.name: 鰭式場效電晶體實作課程
briefs.nameEn: Practical course of FinFET Process Fabrication
briefs.tags: 半導體技術 (semiconductor technology), 鰭式場效電晶體技術 (FINFET transistor technology), 半導體製程技術 (Semiconductor Process Technology), 半導體製造 (Semiconductor Manufacturing), 半導體設備 (Semiconductor Equipmant)
briefs.desc: 本課程為因應次世代半導體元件發展趨勢所設計之高階半導體製程技術課程。課程核心聚焦於鰭式電晶體（FinFET）之先進製 程整合技術及其可靠度分析。內容全面接軌國際頂尖半導體指標會議（如 IEDM、VLSI Symposia）之精選教材，兼具前瞻理論 深度與產業實務前沿。 為落實「理論、實務、前瞻視野」三位一體之教學目標，本課程特別導入雙軌實務訓練：學生將於國立清華大學奈米微系統與奈 米材料技術中心（奈材中心）進行核心半導體製程之實作操作，並安排至台灣半導體研究中心（TSRI）進行實地技術參訪，深入 對接業界現役最先進之半導體製程與分析檢測設備。本課程旨在培育具備獨立元件分析能力、熟悉次世代先進製程整合之高階半 導體研發人才。

briefs.name: 半導體化學品材料與製程應用
briefs.nameEn: Chemical Material and Process Application in Semiconductor
briefs.tags: Chemical material, CMP, etch, litho, semiconductor process, resist, semiconductor fab, clean room, EUV
briefs.desc: 本課程極適合想從事於製程整合和各模組的工程師，內容的重點，並不是在化學反應，而是在學生邏輯的思考，所以課程內容重 在邏輯思考並在授課過程中講解很多在半導體製程上所遇到的實際例子。最基本的半導體廠內所用化學品介紹起並敘述工廠內如何 做好污染防治，接下來介紹各模組所用的化學品及其相關製程如蝕刻，再介紹化學機械平坦製程上有關的化學反應。至於在黃光製 程方面，從g/i-line一直講到EUV光阻在二奈米以下應用。另外還有特殊處理劑如降低LER, 增加選擇比等的和雙層/三層黃光製 程。

briefs.name: 電漿製程元件損害
briefs.tags: Plasma process damage, Plasma charging, Wafer arcing, Antenna charge collection design rule, Device damage mechanism, Diagnostic technique
briefs.desc: Introductory course for semiconductor plasma process induced damage to device including physical damage, electrical damage, contamination and their recovery and prevention strategy.

briefs.name: 2.5D與3DIC先進半導體封裝
briefs.tags: 2.5D/3D integration, Through-silicon vias (TSV), advanced semiconductor packaging, tsmc CoWoS, Intel EMIB, 3DIC Cu-Cu hybrid bonding, Thermal management, Co-Packaged Optics (CPO)
briefs.desc: 一、開課目的(Course purpose)： A comprehensive guide to 2.5D and 3DIC advanced semiconductor packaging technology

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文, Thesis
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 微影光罩
briefs.tags: 微影技術，光罩，半導體，曝光機，解析度增進技術，lithography technology, mask, semiconductor, scanner, resolution enhancement technology
briefs.desc: 本課程為教導學生半導體之光罩技術及知識，具理工科背景之大學或研究生均可修習。先進之光罩技術為半導體技術中之重要一 環，舉凡三奈米或二奈米世代及其他先進半導體世代，製程中皆含有一百片以上之先進光罩，光罩品質之精良與否或好壞會直接 影響產品之良率，並且光罩中之CD或overlay控制更直接影響製程之精良與否。並課程會以深入淺出之講授，教導學生了解光罩 之製作流程、品質控制及最前瞻之光罩技術，並從而具有光罩研究之基本能力，而能從事光罩之相關工作。

briefs.name: 專題討論
briefs.tags: Academic, Oral, Slide design, Presentation Techniques, Public Speaking, English comprehension, Spoken English
briefs.desc: In the pursuit of academic research, excellence involves more than just conducting high-quality studies or writing outstanding papers; the ability to articulate ideas clearly and fluently during presentations is equally vital. An effective presentation not only conveys core findings and concepts in a concise and powerful manner but also helps researchers organize their thoughts and refine the logic behind their topic. This course covers essential public speaking techniques and slide design methods. Finally, through practical exercises and constructive feedback, we aim to elevate every student’s presentation capabilities. This course will be conducted in English mainly.

briefs.name: 企業領導
briefs.tags: negotiation, ESG, financial reports, supply chain, leadership, business decision
briefs.desc: In this Executive Leadership course for PhD students, we will cover how to negotiate, what ESG trends are, patent, lawsuits, IP protection, how to read financial reports, what business decision is about, management/leadership experience sharing. Bottom line is to equip students to have a good business sense.

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文研究, Thesis
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行深入研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之創新性成果。

briefs.name: E-News自媒體的多重宇宙課程
briefs.nameEn: Journalism Multi-Media Program on E-News Practices
briefs.tags: 大眾媒體mass media, 自媒體self-media, 新聞news, 編輯editing, 危機處理crisis management, 企劃project planning, 媒體經營media management, 採訪interviewing, 寫作writing, 主持hosting, 電子報newsletter, 出版publishing, 著作authorship
briefs.desc: 為提供跨領域學習，增進科管院學生遊刃於科技、財經專業知識與大眾傳媒之能力，將透過本X-Class課程培養新聞編輯採訪技 能，以科管院所發行之E-news線上刊物為實作媒體，提升學生媒體素養及培養新聞報導之文字採訪撰寫編輯與視覺設計企劃編 排能力。本課程由科管院兼任講師周岐原擔任 E-news編輯團隊指導老師。課程安排將在本學期利用16小時上課時數，進行實體 與線上課程；本課程為一學分選修之X-Class，全程錄製影音檔案供衝堂學生課後自主學習，衝堂學生課堂中若需與教師討論， 則另行安排時段線上進行。為便利學生選課，本課程將於上下學期重複開課，同樣以E-News為實作刊物，課程教學內容則將有 所不同；歡迎有志學習大眾傳播新聞編採之同學上下學期均來選修，單獨選修亦可。

briefs.name: 企業導師與職涯發展(一)
briefs.tags: 職涯發展 career development,企業導師 mentor,就業 jobs,競爭力 competency,校友alumni
briefs.desc: 以科技管理學院「企業導師領航計畫」為主軸， 藉由本課程 推動 「企業導師領航計畫」，讓 本院學生提早認知 職涯發展， 此課程中 由本院及本校傑出企業家校友擔任導師，提供經驗交流及傳承 ，引領本院大二以上學生 了解產業趨勢及就業市場，培養未來競爭力。 具體而言，本課程的導師來自高科技、金融、證券、投資、生 物科技、製造、文創、法律各領域，藉由導師們豐富實務經歷、產業專業、職場生存法則，讓參與課程的同 學不斷檢視自己的職涯規劃並調整學習方向。

briefs.name: 跨境科技創業實作
briefs.tags: Entrepreneurship, Lean Startup, Business Model, Design Thinking, Cross-cultural Teams, 創業, 精實創業, 商業模式, 設計思考, 跨文化團隊
briefs.desc: 本課程配合亞洲商業計劃競賽，旨在培訓具潛力學生的創業管理知能 。透過跨國團隊移地實作，指導學生完成商業分析、模式 設計、原型驗證至投資人簡報的完整流程，體驗跨境創業 。

briefs.name: ESG永續投資與綠色金融創新
briefs.nameEn: ESG Sustainable Investment and Financial Innovation
briefs.tags: ESG永續投資 ESG Investing, 永續金融 Sustainable Finance, 綠色金融 Green Finance, 金融科技 FinTech, 永續投資策略 Sustainable Investment Strategies, 金融創新Financial Innovation
briefs.desc: 1.培養學生了解國內外ESG永續投資與金融創新之發展趨勢。 2.使學生掌握當前ESG相關議題及企業在永續投資與金融創新領域之現況。 3.透過議題討論與分組報告，培養學生理論分析與實務應用能力，提升學習成效。

briefs.name: 醫學科學導論
briefs.tags: Biology, Medicine, Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical company, Laboratory, Introduction
briefs.desc: This is an introductory course aiming to provide basic concepts about topics in medical sciences. There will be invited speakers to share the current trends and development in their field of expertise and to describe how researchers tackle particular issues in their laboratories. Students will learn the current advancement in biomedical sciences and acquire critical thinking, presentation, and writing skills that are invaluable and transportable for future career and personal development.

briefs.name: 癌症十六問
briefs.nameEn: Sixteen Questions to Ask about Cancer
briefs.tags: 癌症, 治療, 精準醫療, 癌症轉移, 健康檢查
briefs.desc: 癌症是現代社會裡最致命的疾病，大部分的人碰到癌症時，總是聞之色變，將之視為絕症。但並不是每種癌症都這麼可怕，也有 許多診斷與治療的方法，因此本課程希望能夠讓學生具備有更多與癌症相關的正確知識，同時，也可增進跨領域的交流，讓更多 不同專長的學生投入癌症研究的相關新藥、診斷技術、與醫材的開發。

briefs.name: 跨領域學術英文分析與學習
briefs.nameEn: Interdisciplinary Academic English Analysis and Learning
briefs.tags: Academic English, interdisciplinary learning, academic writing, research paper analysis, and scientific communication.
briefs.desc: 「跨領域學術英文分析與學習」為協助大學部學生銜接研究所學習而設計，適合大二至大四、已開始接觸專題研究或對未來研 究發展有興趣之學生修習。隨著研究歷程的推進，學生在學術文獻閱讀、研究理解與學術寫作表達方面，對英文能力的需求日 益提升。本課程旨在系統性地培養學生之學術英文閱讀與分析能力，協助其建立紮實基礎，以利未來研究所階段之學習與研究 發展。 本課程選用教材涵蓋多元學術領域，透過跨領域學術文本的閱讀、解析與比較，引導學生理解不同學科之研究取向、論證邏輯 與共通的學術論述結構。藉由此一學習歷程，學生不僅能有效提升學術英文理解與表達能力，亦能在語文學習的同時，逐步拓 展其跨領域學術視野，培養理解不同研究文化與思維方式的能力。 在全球化與跨國科研合作日益頻繁的趨勢下，具備良好的學術英文閱讀、分析與溝通能力，已成為清華大學學生及臺灣未來科 研人才不可或缺的核心素養。本課程期望協助學生及早建立跨領域學術英文能力，使其在未來參與國際學術交流、研究合作與 科學溝通時，能清楚表達研究理念、理解多元學術觀點，並在國際舞台上展現清華大學與臺灣科研社群的學術實力與影響力。

This course is also a useful introduction to cancer biology for undergraduate students from diverse backgrounds. Some biology knowledge will be helpful but not required. briefs.name: 人體生理與解剖學
briefs.teacher: 李佳霖,彭明德,莊永仁,張壯榮
briefs.tags: Anatomy (解剖學), Physiology (生理學), Homeostasis (體內平衡 / 恆定性), Organ Systems (器官系統), Cellular Function (細胞功能)
briefs.desc: Human Anatomy and Physiology is designed for majors in the Department of Medical Science. This course covers both the anatomy and physiology of the human body, including cell structure and function as well as fundamental concepts of A&P. Emphasis is placed on the cellular level and the following systems: integumentary, muscular, nervous, endocrine, cardiovascular, lymphatic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, and reproductive.

briefs.name: 醫學遺傳學
briefs.tags: genetic testing, screening, approaches to therapy, personalized medicine, disease models, comparative genomics, model organisms, epigenetics
briefs.desc: In addition to the basic introduction of human genetics, the most updated scientific and technical advance in human genetics will be included. The class will cover the basic genetic rules with emphasis on medical applications. The lectures will include genetic testing, screening, approaches to therapy, personalized medicine, disease models, comparative genomics, model organisms, and epigenetics.

briefs.name: 藥理學
briefs.tags: 藥理學(pharmacology), 藥物動力學(pharmacokinetics), 藥物代謝 (drug metabolism), 藥物作用機制 (drug-receptor interactions), 藥物副作用 (toxicology and adverse effects), 藥效動力學 (pharmacodynamics)
briefs.desc: A course provides basic concepts in pharmacology in which pharmacokinetics, biotransformation and drug metabolism, drug-receptor interactions, pharmacodynamics, toxicology and adverse effects are introduced. The underlying mechanisms of action and therapeutic effects of selective clinically used drug classes are described. In addition, a lecture is designated to note the processes of new drug discovery and development.

briefs.name: 生理量測與音樂健康照護
briefs.nameEn: Medical Measurement in the Application of Music Healthcare
briefs.tags: 音樂與健康 Music and Health, 智慧照護 Smart Care, 表演藝術醫學 Performing Arts Medicine, 生理量測 Physiological Assessment, AI健康應用 AI Health Application
briefs.desc: 本課程以「音樂、健康科技與表演藝術醫學」為核心，帶領學生從實證醫學基礎出發，學習如何將音樂介入、健康照護與生理量 測應用於高齡者照護與表演藝術健康促進。課程前半部介紹實證醫學、學術海報製作、音樂健康照護、音樂介入成效評估，以及 表演藝術醫學的基本概念與研究典範；後半部則進一步探討常用生理量測技術，包括IMU、關節活動度、姿勢動作分析、表面肌電 圖與肌肉負荷分析，並延伸至智慧健康照護系統、生理訊號資料應用、多模態資料與AI輔助照護系統設計。課程採講授、案例討 論、分組主題分享與期末海報競賽並行，培養學生跨領域整合、實證分析、研究表達與健康科技應用能力，期望學生能以音樂與 科技為媒介，提出具創新性與實務價值的健康促進方案。

briefs.name: 精準醫療與基因檢測概論
briefs.nameEn: Introduction of Precision Medicine and Genetic Testing
briefs.tags: 精準醫療、基因檢測、高通量定序、細胞治療、外泌體、Precision Medicine、Genetic testing、Next generation sequencing、Cell Therapy、Exosome
briefs.desc: 精準醫療(Precision Medicine)的概念已從研究的範疇進入臨床實務中，從細胞治療、個人的健康狀況風險分析、疾病早 期偵測與診斷、癌症存活率評估、到複雜疾病的個人化治療計畫、都開始進入目前的醫療體系中。目前在衛服部也已開始給 付高通量定序的基因檢測，醫院端也開始提供相關的基因檢測或治療策略，但對大多數的人，甚至是生命科學的相關研究人 員對大部分基因檢測的內涵與應用也並不是很清楚。在細胞治療的領域，隨著再生醫療法案的建立與執行，幹細胞的回輸漸 漸普及，如NK細胞、CIK細胞、DC細胞、關節幹細胞治療等，已有相當多的實例證實其功效性。另外外泌體在化妝品產業的應 用，或將來回輸人體的治療策略，也正蓬勃發展，這些新的技術與策略都是現今學生必要了解的新知。所以本課程將介紹基 因檢測與細胞治療在精準醫療時代的重要性及應用範圍，熟悉基因檢測與細胞治療的原理與將來的應用，提供學生了解精準 醫療的發展方向。

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: 書報討論Seminar，期刊文章journal article ，報告Presentation，討論Discussion
briefs.desc: 課程目標是學習科學論文架構、邏輯思考與論述表達能力。經由學習具高影響力的新發表文獻，使學生具有閱讀、口語表達、討 論與分析科學文章的能力。

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: 書報討論Seminar，科學論文Scientific publication，文獻探討Literature search，口頭報告Oral presentation
briefs.desc: 本課程將讓學生了解基本的科學論文架構、文獻蒐集以及閱讀科學論文的技巧，包含教師授課以及學生的口頭報告，讓學生 練習整理以及利用口頭報告呈現科學論文和雙向的互動討論，藉此增加學生對科學的思考能力及口頭報告的能力。 This course will provide students with an understanding of basic scientific paper structure, literature databases, and reading skills for scientific papers. Includes teacher lectures and student oral reports for students to practice. The organization uses oral reports to reflect interactive discussions of scientific papers and subjects, promote students' scientific thinking abilities, and improve oral reporting skills.

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: Seminar, Molecular Biology, Virology, Cell Biology, Structural Biology, General Life Science
briefs.desc: This is the seminar course aiming at training Ph.D. students for scientific talk and discussion.

briefs.name: 基因諮詢概論
briefs.tags: 基因諮詢、精準醫療、基因檢測、高通量定序、遺傳流行病學, genetic counseling, precision medicine, genetic testing, high-throughput sequencing, genetic epidemiology
briefs.desc: 隨著高通量定序技術在臨床的應用，透過基因數據資料來了解疾病發生風險、發展與治療策略選擇的應用也越來廣泛。如何正確 的解讀基因數據的結果並對病人及家屬有詳細的說明也越顯重要。然而，目前具備基因諮詢能力的人才非常缺乏。本課程主要是 在介紹基因諮詢之基本概念與應用，目標在於培育能理解並正確解讀基因數據資料及正確說明的基因諮詢人才。面對將來基因醫 學的快速發展，本課程可訓練學生具備基本的基因數據解讀和基因諮詢相關能力，並可在將來取得基因諮詢師的專業認證，提升 其就業的能力。本課程是與國家衛生研究院師資共同開設，會邀請相關領域的專家參與授課。

briefs.desc: In addition to knowledge and technical acumen, effective communication is crucial in the engineering fields. To improve their communicative abilities, students practice essential language skills to enhance their academic performance in their fields. The course consists of three dimensions: English for meetings, classroom discussions, and presentations. Through role-play speaking activities, group discussions, poster presentations, students develop as much confidence as fluency and competence in using English in academic contexts.

This course is designed to provide students with ideas and thoughts on diverse cutting edge research. This course aims to help students develop their own strategic thinking, explore and expand their research interests.

briefs.name: 臺灣海洋史專題
briefs.tags: 海洋史 Maritime History, 冷戰 Cold War, 社會經濟 Social Economy, 國家治理 Governance, 宗教文化 Religious Culture
briefs.desc: 臺灣是一個海島，由海洋展開的內外連結應是社會經濟發展根基。本課程的安排是按照主題區分，從臺灣的海洋環境結構、國家 與海岸治理、漁業發展、漁村共同體、商業網絡、宗教信仰、飲食文化、洋行、商人、米糖經濟、帝國學知、對外貿易、冷戰與 工業發展等十五個課題，進行緣起或貫時性討論。本課程的主要教學目標是透過臺灣海洋史相關研究和史料的閱讀和分析，引起 同學對海洋史保持關懷與興趣，並能理解臺灣以海洋為中心之發展歷程，而能進一步作過去與現在的對話。其次，透過對於過去 歷史現象的理解，培養分析、判斷能力，啟迪智慧。第三，透過專題論文的閱讀和相關史料的解析，以及共同討論，培養獨立研 究的能力。

briefs.name: 人工智慧運算架構與系統一
briefs.tags: computer architecture, high performance computing, AI accelerator, CPU design, Artificial Intelligence
briefs.desc: High-Performance Computing (HPC) 產業因為半導體產業的相關先進技術進步，所設計的晶片越來越複雜，對於一個想跨入這個產 業的學習者，會面臨很多的困難，台灣由於半導體產業蓬勃發展，在晶片設計的後段設計生產製造方面，多年來培育了非常多不同領域的人才，但是 在前段晶片設計與軟硬體系統整合發展上，一直比較受限，台灣產業的屬性與學校教育的環境在HPC這個領域並未開展開來，而HPC 晶片的開發 因為複雜度相對於Edge Computing 晶片的複雜度高，需要很多新的設計概念與方法，以及具備更多垂直整合系統設計的要求，為了因應在人 才培育上，HPC 的發展需要新的課程與方法，ACAL 準備了一系列的課程，希望能協助想進入HPC 前段設計的學習者，了解這個領域的基本技能 需求，並建立一個共學的環境，讓對這個領域有熱情的同好，能有一個共同學習與做研究的平台。 這門課每個階段的教學會有一個主題，可能是該主題的入門概論，可能是理論基礎課程，也可能是從實作面出發的主題討論課程，在期末專 題提案之前，每一個探討的主題，都是為了協助同學了解人工智慧晶片設計的流程與基礎。

briefs.name: 經濟學原理一
briefs.tags: 經濟學, 個體經濟, 國際貿易, 比較利益, 市場均衡
briefs.desc: 本門課程簡介經濟學的基本原理。經濟學不是一門教人自私的社會科學，而是研究個人、廠商和組織如何做選擇的社會科學。 本課程主要介紹理性消費者和廠商決策的最適化，以及市場如何運作和達成均衡的原理。本課程也將介紹在不同市場結構下，廠商的訂價和合作競爭等決策行為。最後，本課程將分析政府在經濟社會運作中可以和應該扮演的角色（或者不扮演）。鑑於近年來各國對公平、正義的呼聲日益高漲，本課程也將針對部分大眾對於經濟學的迷思進行答辯和剖析。

briefs.name: 經濟學原理一
briefs.tags: Microeconomics, Market, Demand and Supply, Consumer Choices, Producer Theory
briefs.desc: This course offers an introduction to microeconomic theories and applications. We will discuss the basic economic concepts and theories concerning market functions and the choices of individual decision makers, including people and firms. This course is offered in English. After successful completion of this course, students will be able to (1) define and discuss the key economic concepts including the basic principles of rational choices, (2) identify and analyze the fundamental microeconomic issues using verbal, graphical and simple mathematical techniques, and (3) apply economic thinking to daily decisions and events.

briefs.name: 經濟學原理一
briefs.tags: 市場均衡，資源配置，消費理論，生產理論，政府角色
briefs.desc: 經濟學是研究理性個人如何做選擇的社會科學。本課程主要介紹消費者與廠商如何做決策。在消費者理論方面，本課程將探討影 響消費者購買行為之因素與其決策準則。在生產者理論方面，將介紹在不同市場結構下，廠商的生產與定價決策行為。此外，也 將分析政府在經濟社會裡所扮演之角色。

briefs.name: 經濟學原理一
briefs.tags: demand and supply , market failure, pricing, efficiency
briefs.desc: 此科目欲培養之核心能力為: 具備基本經濟學知識，瞭解經濟學範疇，與運用經濟思維解釋經濟議題。 授課以教師講解為主, 歡迎同學隨時發問並提出意見。

briefs.name: 經濟學原理一
briefs.tags: Economic model, Demand and Supply, elasticity, cost function, monopoly, oligopoly, game theory, price discrimination; 經濟模型, 需求與供給, 彈性, 成本函數, 獨佔, 寡占, 賽局理論, 差別取價
briefs.desc: 本課程為經濟學原理的第一部分，主要介紹個體經濟學的基礎知識與應用。在這門課程中，我們將會介紹一些最核心 的經濟概念，並介紹經濟學中最重要的模型-需求與供給模型。另外，我們將介紹經濟體中不同參與者，如消費者、生產者、 與政府的各項決定之形成與背後的原因。最後，一些個體經濟學的應用例子，如外部性，賽局理論，公共財等問題也會被討論。

briefs.name: 經濟學原理一
briefs.tags: 供給, 需求, 市場均衡, 消費者行為, 生產者行為, Demand, Supply, Market Equilibrium, Consumption, Production
briefs.desc: 本課程目的在介紹經濟學的基本分析工具與核心議題。內容以市場機制之運作為主軸， 包括經濟學的基本概念，如機會成本、比較利益、專業分工，以及個體經濟學的議題，如 供給與需求、市場均衡、消費者行為、生產者行為、和產業組織等。

briefs.name: 經濟學原理一
briefs.tags: Microeconomics, Incentive, Scarcity, Market, Efficinecy
briefs.desc: This course intorduce basic concepts in Microeconomics.

briefs.name: 經濟學原理一
briefs.tags: Demand and Supply, Elasticity, Utility, Perfect Competition, Monopoly, Oligopoly, Monopolistic Competition
briefs.desc: Introduction to the functions of individual decision makers, both consumers and producers, within our economic system. The course will focus on the nature and functions of product markets, the theory of the firm under varying market structures, and the role of government in prompting efficiency and equity in the economy.

briefs.name: 會計學一
briefs.tags: 會計學(Accounting), 財務會計(Financial Accounting), 國際會計準則(IFRSs), 美國會計準則(US GAAP)
briefs.desc: The role of accounting is to provide information to investors, policy-makers, regulators, and other decision-makers to facilitate the allocation of resources in society. The purpose of this course is to understand the accounting process and to develop skills necessary to evaluate an enterprise’s financial position and its operating, investing and financing activities.

briefs.name: 會計學一
briefs.tags: IFRS, Financial Statement, Accounting Information System, Internal Control, Forensic Accounting, Cybersecurity
briefs.desc: This course aims to make students familiar financial reporting procedures and assist them in reading financial statements.

briefs.name: 個體經濟學一
briefs.tags: Demand, Supply, Consumer welfare, Cost, Competitive Market
briefs.desc: This course is an advanced undergraduate course that teaches the fundamentals of microeconomics. The course begins with an overview of how a market economy works, introducing demand and supply analysis and elasticity concepts. Next, we study the decision-making process by consumers and producers. The last part of the course introduces different market structures, focusing on perfect competition.

briefs.name: 個體經濟學一
briefs.tags: 效用最大化,消費者理論,市場失靈,政府干預,外部性,利潤最大化,生產者理論; utility maximization, consumer theory, market failure, government intervention, externality, profit maximization, producer theory
briefs.desc: This course is offered in English and is the first part of a one-year Microeconomics sequence required for students in the Economics program. Knowledge of calculus is expected, as it will be used frequently to solve economic problems. The course begins with an introduction to supply and demand and then examines how consumers make choices among different goods. After developing the basic framework of consumer theory, we analyze the demand curve and its properties in a more rigorous manner. We also discuss how consumer welfare can be measured and explore the implications for public policy. In the second half of the course, we turn to the behavior of firms and study how firms make production decisions in both the short run and the long run. Similar to the consumer’s problem of maximizing utility, firms seek to minimize their costs, and we examine the properties of cost functions in detail. We then introduce one of the most important models of market struc

briefs.name: 個體經濟學一
briefs.tags: consumer choice, production, competitive market, general equilibrium, Pareto efficiency, 消費者選擇, 廠商生產, 競爭市場, 一般均衡, 柏拉圖效率
briefs.desc: This course is the first part of Microeconomics. This course intends to apply more advanced tools, including algebra and calculus, to analyze various microeconomic issues. In this semester, we will mainly study consumers’ constrained choice, demand and welfare. We will also examine firms, their production and costs, and the market supply. Given both the market demand and supply, we can then discuss the competitive market equilibrium and evaluate the property and the social welfare in the competitive equilibrium.

briefs.name: 個體經濟學一
briefs.tags: demand; supply; utility maximization; consumption; price
briefs.desc: Economics is the study of human behavior. To understand how people can cooperate in social orders, and why they often cannot, we need to have a framework for understanding human action and its consequences. Economics provides one such framework. Microeconomics has been applied to issues ranging from those expected in economics, such as what determines the price of consumer goods, to such things as how people vote, how much education they acquire, and how many children they have. This course offers an introduction to the theory and methods of microeconomics. In the first semester, we will cover topics include the simple demand and supply framework, consumer choice and demand under constrained maximization; price and output determination of the firm, and the perfect competition model.

briefs.name: 貨幣銀行學一
briefs.tags: 貨幣, 金融體系, 金融工具, 金融市場, 金融機構, 金融中介, 商業銀行
briefs.desc: 本課程主要介紹在現代自由市場經濟體系下，與交易及資金供需間流通相關的貨幣與金融重要觀念如下： (1)貨幣的定義與功能 (2)金融體系 (3)金融市場與金融工具 (4)金融機構與金融中介理論

briefs.name: 貨幣銀行學一
briefs.tags: Money (貨幣), Bank (銀行) , Financial Markets (金融巿場), Central Bank (中央銀行), Exchange Rates (匯率), Monetary Policy (貨幣政策)
briefs.desc: This course, offered in the fall semester, is the first one of two consecutive courses about money and banking. This course helps students understand the basic principles of money and banking by providing an introduction of financial markets and related institutional arrangement. And we also discuss some real world applications of these principles. After taking this course, students are expected to obtain knowledge and skills of analyzing many economic events about interest rates, foreign exchange rates, stock markets, and bond markets. With the knowledge from this first course, we will continue to discuss the role of central banks around the world and how they conducts monetary policy in the next course, to be offered in the spring semester.

briefs.name: 統計學一
briefs.tags: 統計, 機率, 資料分析, statistics, probability, data analysis
briefs.desc: This course is the first part of a two-semester sequence. The purpose of Statistics I is building the mathematical foundation for understanding statistical concepts and methods. We will focus on topics including data, probability distributions, sampling, estimation, and conclude with hypothesis testing. We will also start familiarizing ourselves with basic programming as we use visualization and simulations to introduce statistical concepts.

briefs.name: 統計學一
briefs.tags: 統計、機率、機率與統計、統計學、計量
briefs.desc: 本課程為統計學的入門課程，適合商學院學生修習，旨在建立學生分析資料與解讀數據的基礎能力。內容涵蓋統計的核心理論與 基本應用方法，從資料的整理與視覺化、敘述統計（如集中趨勢與離散程度指標），到機率理論、常見機率分配（如二項分配與 常態分配）、抽樣理論、信賴區間估計與假設檢定等。本課程重視資料素養的培養，並會在課程中透過軟體進行實作，使學生能 從資料中萃取關鍵資訊，做出有根據的統計推論與判斷。課程結合理論、操作與應用，為學生未來深入學習計量經濟學、商業資 料分析或從事實證研究提供必要的理論基礎與分析能力。

briefs.name: 成本與管理會計一
briefs.tags: Managerial Accounting, Planning, Performance Evaluation, Pricing, Cost Accounting
briefs.desc: The goal of cost and managerial accounting is to acquaint students of management with the fundamental tools of management accounting, but also to promote their understanding of the dramatic ways in which the field is changing. The emphasis throughout the course is on using accounting information in managing an organization. In this course, the traditional tools of managerial accounting, like product costing, budgeting, and performance evaluation, will be augmented and updated with contemporary approaches such as activity-based costing, customer profitability analysis, value-chain analysis, target costing, balanced scorecard, and strategic cost management.

briefs.name: 財務報導與實務
briefs.tags: Financial Reporting,Financial Accounting, business Analysis, Enterprise Valuation, Earning Forecast
briefs.desc: This course is designed to provide a strong conceptual, analytical and procedural foundation for the study of financial reporting and practice. The historical development of accounting thought and the role of financial accounting in today’s economy are investigated. Socioeconomic, political, legal, and ethical influences on financial reporting are considered. Discussions include procedures to record, summarize, and report results of business events; content and presentation of financial statements and specific reporting issues related to cash and receivable. An overview of financial statement analysis is also presented. International issues are addressed as appropriate.

briefs.name: 計量經濟學一
briefs.tags: 計量經濟學Econometrics; Statistics; 數量方法Quantitative Methods; 數據分析 Data Analysis; 統計學 Statistics; 經濟學 Economics
briefs.desc: The purpose of this course is to provide an introduction to the application of statistical methods to analyze economic relations. It is part of a two-semester sequence. In the fall semester, we will focus on basic econometric theories including a review of probability and statistics, linear regression with one regressor, linear regressions with multiple regressors and non-linear regressions. In the course, students will learn to develop skills for estimating relationships as a means to testing economic theories. Students will learn to identify testable predictions drawing from economic theories, data requirements for testing these predictions, and carry out empirical tests for such predictions.

briefs.name: 經濟數據分析與預測
briefs.tags: 數據分析, 機器學習, 貝氏統計, AI數理基礎, Python程式設計
briefs.desc: This course surveys basic concepts and technical tools required for proceeding the Bayesian data analysis. The goal of this course targets to equip students with the understandings of how to interpret and what are the limits of common data analytical results. In addition to introducing theoretically analytical models, proper programming skills are covered in this course. Note: This course requires learning Python programming skills for verifying theoretical methods and practicing analytical applications.

briefs.name: 總體經濟學一
briefs.tags: 總體經濟學，國民所得帳、投資與儲蓄、經濟成長、貨幣市場
briefs.desc: 基本總體經濟學概述、勞動與就業、儲蓄與投資、經濟成長、貨幣市場 **科管院大3,4 以上未選上者,請第 1 次上課前線上申請加簽 （加簽規則於第一次上課公布），不用來信詢問**

briefs.name: 總體經濟學一
briefs.tags: 總體經濟學,國民所得衡量,競爭均衡,跨期選擇,實質景氣循環,經濟成長,動態規劃,資產定價,Macroeconomics,National Income Accounting,Competitive Equilibrium,Intertemporal Choice,Real Business Cycles,Economic Growth,Dynamic Programming,Asset Pricing
briefs.desc: 本課程介紹現代總體經濟學的微觀基礎與核心模型。內容涵蓋國民所得衡量、消費者與廠商最適化、競爭均衡與社會規劃者問題、扭曲性租稅、跨期選擇、實質景氣循環模型、Solow 經濟成長模型、動態規劃及資產定價。課程強調運用數學模型建立經濟直覺，並分析總體經濟波動、資源配置與政策效果。 This course introduces the microeconomic foundations and core models of modern macroeconomics. Topics include national income accounting; household and firm optimization; competitive equilibrium and the social planner’s problem; distortionary taxation; intertemporal choice; real business cycle models; the Solow growth model; dynamic programming; and asset pricing. The course emphasizes mathematical modeling, economic intuition, and applications to macroeconomic fluctuations, resource allocation, and policy analysis.

briefs.name: 總體經濟學一
briefs.tags: Macroeconomics, Growth, 總體，經濟學，成長
briefs.desc: In this course, we will cover theories and empirical findings about macroeconomics. The topics include consumption, saving and investment, economic growth, and business cycles. This is the first part of the Macroeconomic sequence.

briefs.name: 期貨市場
briefs.tags: 期貨 (Futures),期貨市場(Futures Market),選擇權(Options),衍生性商品(Derivative Products ), 衍生性商品市場(Derivative Products Market)
briefs.desc: 介紹期貨市場之運作方式及各期貨交易所之 商品內容 , 除深入淺出說明期貨與選擇權 的理論定價模式外, 將充分探討實 務上的策略應用。整個課程設計兼顧理論與 實務，搭配介紹其他衍生性金融商品之操 作，期使同學們能完全領會期貨市 場的奧妙與威力! The operation mechanism of futures market and the products in major Futures Exchanges will be introduced in this course. By taking the course, students will learn the futures trading both from pricing theory and practical transactions. Additional material about other derivative products is also provided to let students understand the most delicate knowledge in futures market.

briefs.name: 貨幣經濟學
briefs.tags: central banking，monetary policy, interest rate, exchange rate
briefs.desc: 本課程旨在介紹貨幣政策相關議題。希望學生能運用經濟思維解釋經濟議題，以及能將經濟理論與實務結合，提升就業競爭力。

briefs.name: 財政學一
briefs.tags: Public Finance, Public Economics, Public Policy, Public Sector, Government Expenditure
briefs.desc: This is the first course in the two-semester undergraduate sequence of Public Finance. Public Finance is the branch of economics that studies the role of the public sector in the economy, and the approach is primarily based on microeconomics. In this semester, we will have a focus on the expenditure side of public finance. The course will begin with an introduction to the public sector and basic economic tools, followed by the economic reasons and outcomes of government interventions. We will then look at what the public sector actually does using examples from the expenditure policies in the United States and in Taiwan, and how it affects individual decision-making and welfare. This course is offered in English.

briefs.name: 中級會計一
briefs.tags: Intermediate Accounting I
briefs.desc: To introduce to the students the conceptual structure of accounting. This course is designed to develop an in-depth understanding of the concepts, principles, and practices of financial accounting under IFRS. The emphasis is on understanding and applying basic accounting principles and other concepts that guide the reporting of the effect of transactions and other economic events on the financial condition and operating results of a business. To provide an opportunity to apply theoretical solutions to practical problems. Since this course is offered to students with non-accounting major and that the number of participants is expected to be manageable, the detailed contents of the course may be adjusted and tailored, during the semester, to the needs of the class and in accordance with the different backgrounds of the participants.

briefs.name: 審計學一
briefs.tags: 審計, 查核, 內部控制, 舞弊, audit
briefs.desc: 說明審計理論及查核實務，主要以講義授課彙整重點，輔以補充審計公報內容補充。

briefs.name: 數理經濟學一
briefs.tags: 微積分, 靜態優化, 線性代數, 多變數微積分, 凸性規劃, Calculus, Static Optimization, Linear Algebra, Multivariable Calculus, Convex Optimization
briefs.desc: 數理經濟學是一門經濟學的分支，其目的在為經濟分析提供嚴謹的架構，尤其當經濟理論過於複雜而超過口語或圖形的表達範圍時，數理經濟學提供分析的工具。除了在經濟理論的發展中發揮了關鍵的作用，數理經濟學也普遍應用於經濟學的各個領域，提供數學工具對經濟現象進行建模及分析，進而發展出明確且可檢驗的理論假說。 經濟系的同學在大二的個體經濟學都上過微積分和個經，對微積分、靜態優化等應該都不陌生。本門課將建立在這個基礎上，介紹經濟學常用的數學工具，如線性代數、多變數微積分、凸性規劃等，及其在個體經濟學的應用。

briefs.name: 應用個體計量與資料分析
briefs.tags: 個體計量,資料分析,Applied Microeconometrics, Data Analysis,應用個體計量
briefs.desc: This course introduces some of the most widely used econometric methods in the economics literature, including linear and nonlinear models, multinomial choice models, semiparametric methods, and simulation-based methods. You will learn to apply these techniques using R, a free and open-source statistical programming language, working with real-world economic data.

briefs.name: 個體經濟專題一
briefs.tags: 賽局理論 (Game Theory)，不對稱訊息理論 (Information Asymmetry)，外部性與公共財 (Externalities and Public Good)，非合作賽局 (Noncooperative Game)，內許均衡 (Nash equilibrium)，市場失靈 (Market Failure)
briefs.desc: 本課程將介紹1960年代後受經濟學界重視的重要課題及應用，包括：賽局理論 (Game Theory)，不對稱訊息理論 (Information Asymmetry)，外 部性與公共財 (Externalities and Public Good)。後兩者為造成市場失靈的重要原因，為近代經濟學家重視的重要課題。賽局理論中我們將著重 探討非合作賽局，以 Nash 均衡為基本架構，進一步介紹 Nash 均衡的精煉 (refinement) 及混合策略的均衡。

briefs.name: 專題：總體經濟
briefs.tags: Macroeconomics, Empirics, 總體，經濟, 實證
briefs.desc: In this course, we will discuss several recent Macroeconomic issues and learn how to apply what you learned in Intermediate Macroeconomics to tackle real world Macroeconomic issues, e.g., wage stagnation, growth, inflation, among others. Accordingly, we will have lectures quickly reviewing Macroeconomic concepts and demonstrating presentation skills. Then, presentations and a term paper are required for each student to demonstrate their ability in critical thinking about current Macroeconomic issues as well as in providing clear and well-organized presentations.

briefs.name: 國際經濟學一
briefs.tags: 國際貿易、貿易政策, international trade, trade policy
briefs.desc: 在全球化的潮流下，近30年來世界各國紛紛降低貿易障礙，加速商品貿易的流量。此外，國際間生產分工的方式，已從過去 產品之間的分工，逐漸轉為生產同一種商品在不同製程上的分工。在貿易自由化與國際分工的趨勢下，加速商品、人才與資 金的跨國移動，提升國家與國家間生產活動的關聯性。透過國際貿易，各國可專注於本國較具生產優勢的商品，在國際市場 換取本國生產成本較高的商品，進而提升本國的生產效率與福利。雖然自由貿易可提升一國福利，但同時也可能對一國所得 分配造成不均度惡化。因此，各國政府在制定貿易相關政策時多受到許多爭議。 本課程主要介紹當前國際貿易理論模型，分析國家間為何會進行貿易，以及自由貿易與貿易政策(如:關稅)下對一國福利的影 響，期望學生未來能對國貿相關議題有初步認識及相關分析能力。

briefs.name: 國際貿易與金融專題
briefs.nameEn: Topics on International Trade and Finance
briefs.tags: 國際金融，匯率，國際貿易，international finance, international Trade, exchange rate regimes
briefs.desc: The objective of this course is to familiarize undergraduate students with some modern topics in international trade and finance, connecting theory to empirical evidence and demonstrating the relevance of theory to real-world economic issues and policy questions.

briefs.name: 專業經理人職能培養
briefs.tags: Resume and interview techniques, written skills, career advancement, personal promotion, effective presentation, teamwork, leadership 簡歷和面試技巧、商業溝通寫作、職業發展、個人行銷、有效的簡報、團隊合作、領導力
briefs.desc: The ability to advance in the corporate world depends not only on the professional discipline for which a person is hired but also on softer skills seldom taught in schools. The course covers the concepts and skills needed to promote or market oneself within an organization, such as motivation, relationship building, effective self-presentation, teamwork, and leadership. Finally, the course will provide students with a series of discussions and role plays that will increase the students’ sensitivity to group behavior, awareness, and skill in dealing with group dynamics.

briefs.name: 跨文化創造力與創業家精神
briefs.tags: Entrepreneurship,Cross-Cultural Creativity,Creative Industries, Social Business,跨文化創造力,創業家精神,社會企業, 創意產業
briefs.desc: This course is specifically designed for our Taiwanese and International students who have the heart of passion and willingness to become great leaders after graduation for their future career. Through dynamic brain-power training, knowledge learning and intelligence advancement, case study and international simulations, we will activate the creative genes in each one of our students. We will build their creative thinking, analytical reasoning, and problem solving abilities. In the spirit of inspirational leadership, we will develop their creative marketing, managerial and organizational skills in the process of entrepreneurial case study and simulations. Students will be able to draw upon their cross-cultural understanding and practice how to apply what they have learnt in our business schools. The main topics to be covered include cross-cultural business etiquette, creative designing, innovative marketing, cross-cultural communication, analytical planning, creative te

briefs.name: 經濟計量方法一
briefs.tags: Statistics, econometrics, causal effect 統計、計量、因果效果
briefs.desc: This course is designed for rst-year Economics graduate students. The basic methods, modern econometric methods and theory are covered. The intention is that the material will provide a foundation for applied research in economics. It will provide an initial opportunity for you to develop the skills to conduct and understand empirical work. The coursework will be theoretical in nature, but students will also be required to use the methods to estimate certain models and test certain hypotheses

briefs.name: 機器學習與經濟計量
briefs.tags: Decision tree; K-means; Q-learning; Regularization and optimization; Convolutional neural networks; Transformer network
briefs.desc: Since the publication of Varian (2014), people have been believing that machine learning uses data to predict some variable as a function of other variables, while econometrics use statistical methods for prediction, inference, and causal modeling of economic relationships. However, nowadays some tend to believe that machine learning is the new generation nonparametric statistical and econometric methods, branded as machine learning (Chernozhukov et al. 2017). While academically rigorous theorems are much appreciated, they are not the focus of this course. Instead, this course starts with basic concepts of machine learning and econometrics; and ends with procedural computer codes. Students are required to be familiar with at least one software such as Python, R or C++.

briefs.name: 個體經濟分析一
briefs.tags: microeconomics, Firm Theory, 個體經濟學，廠商理論，消費者理論
briefs.desc: This course covers some fundamental theories in microeconomics, such as the decision making of consumers and firms. We first introduce some basic mathematical tools for solving optimization. We next study the behavior of individual consumers and firms. Finally, we explore the partial equilibrium and general equilibrium theorem. The goal of this course is to provide some basic tools for you to develop a formal treatment of these subjects and apply them to relevant issues.

briefs.name: 家庭經濟學
briefs.tags: family, divorce, marriage, household bargaining, children
briefs.desc: This course focuses on research on family and demographic economics. Students will be introduced to a wide range of research topics related to family and demographic economics and learn to develop the ability to conduct research in this field. The study of families and households is an important research area given the increasingly complex organization of families, which have produced substantial effects on behavior of households and welfare of children as well as spouses. We will focus on the theoretical modeling and empirical investigation of how individuals sort into families (cohabitation, marriage and divorce) and of the major economic outcomes determined in a family context (such as spousal time allocation, labor supply (particularly the changing role of women in the labor force), fertility, consumption, investments in children and intergenerational transfers. Of particular importance are the various classes of household models and their testable implications on family decis

briefs.name: 總體經濟分析一
briefs.tags: 總體經濟學, 經濟成長, 實質景氣循環模型, Macroeconomics, Growth, RBC model
briefs.desc: The objective of this course is to familiarize graduate students with quantitative methods in advanced macroeconomics and introduce some fundamental workhorse models and methods of formal macroeconomics analysis. The main difference between undergraduate and graduate macroeconomics is the use of models that are explicitly dynamic and stochastic. Dynamic general equilibrium (DGE) macroeconomics by providing microeconomic foundation for macroeconomics has emerged in recent years and been adopted by most modern research in macroeconomics as a leading approach.

briefs.name: 政治經濟理論與應用
briefs.tags: voting, rent seeking, institution, political incentive, bureaucracy
briefs.desc: This course introduces students to major themes in political economy, with a focus on how political institutions, market mechanisms, state capacity, interest groups, public values, and distributional conflicts influence economic policy and development outcomes. Rather than treating policies as purely technical solutions, the course asks why certain policies are adopted, who benefits from them, who bears their costs, and why seemingly efficient or fair policies often fail in practice. The first half of the course introduces core analytical tools in political economy, including institutions, collective action, voting, redistribution, political incentives, and state capacity. The second half applies these tools to contemporary debates on market society, inequality, meritocracy, populism, and AI governance.

briefs.name: 環境經濟理論
briefs.tags: Externality, Pigouvian Tax, Coase Theorem, Tradable Permit, Command and Control Policy, Public Goods
briefs.desc: This course will familiarize students with the theory and application of economics to environmental problems and prepare them for analyzing issues in environmental economics and policy.
