briefs.name: 健康、教育與勞動：理論與實證
briefs.nameEn: Health, Education, Labor: Theory and Empirics
briefs.tags: Healthcare, health policy, labor 醫療、健康政策、勞動
briefs.desc: This doctoral-level course examines the interactions between health, education, and labor market outcomes from both theoretical and empirical perspectives. The course integrates insights from health economics, labor economics, and the economics of education to analyze how human capital investments in schooling and health jointly shape productivity, labor supply, earnings, and inequality across the life cycle.

briefs.name: 偏微分方程與複變函數
briefs.nameEn: Partial Differential Equations and Complex Variables
briefs.tags: Partial differential equations; complex variables;
briefs.desc: The course consists of Part A - partial differential equations and Part B - complex variables. Part A discusses how to solve partial differential equations e,g., wave equation, heat equation and etc. frequently encountered in engineering and physics. Part B discusses the theory of complex variables covering analytic functions, differentiation, contour integrals and etc., useful to engineering and physics.

briefs.name: 偏微分方程與複變函數
briefs.nameEn: Partial Differential Equations and Complex Variables
briefs.tags: 偏微分方程, 複變函數
briefs.desc: 本課程銜接常微分方程，涵蓋偏微分方程及 複變數函數兩者，提供修習其他工程或物 理學科所需之數學基礎。修完本科目 可對偏微分方程之物理意義、基本解法與複變函 數之理論、應用等有一概括性 之認識，有助於修習電磁學、近代物理、控制系統、電力工程等課程。本科目 需具有大一微積分、常微分方程(OrdinaryDifferentialEquations) 及傅氏/拉氏 (Fourier/Laplace)變換之基礎。

briefs.name: 線性代數
briefs.tags: 線性代數, 工程數學, Linear Algebra, Engineering Mathematics,
briefs.desc: Linear algebra is a branch of mathematics that studies systems of linear equations and the properties of matrices. The concepts of linear algebra are extremely useful in engineering, physics, economics and social sciences, and natural sciences. In this class, the foundation of elementary linear algebra is illustrated for students. Various applications of linear algebra in different areas will also be addressed.

briefs.name: 線性代數
briefs.tags: 向量空間, 正交基底, 線性轉換, 內積, 矩陣運算, vector space, prthogonal bases, linear transformation, inner product, matrix operation
briefs.desc: This course offers a rigorous and foundational journey through one of the most elegant and widely applied branches of mathematics. We will explore the theory and applications of vector spaces, linear transformations, matrices, and inner product spaces with a level of depth suited for serious study in mathematics, physics, computer science, and engineering.

briefs.name: 電磁學
briefs.tags: 靜電, 靜磁, 向量分析, 馬克士威爾方程式, 波動方程式
briefs.desc: 本課程為電磁波、光電工程、固態電子元件以及光電領域各項研究所課程的基礎，課程內容將帶學生了解電磁學理論基礎與應 用，搭配數學公式和物理圖像幫助學生理解靜電場、靜磁場、電磁交互作用以及傳輸線理論等物理現象，最後將推廣至馬克士威 爾方程式以及時變電磁場。

briefs.name: 電路學
briefs.tags: Electric circuit電路, resistive circuit電阻電路, circuit theorem電路理論, first order circuit一階電路, second order circuit二階電路, ac power analysis交流電路功率分析, OP amplifier運算放大器
briefs.desc: This is one of the mandatory courses for the EE Department. This course introduces the basic theory of linear circuit analysis, which helps students for solving realistic problems involving these circuits and further being able to design complex electronic, communication, computer, power, and control systems.

briefs.name: 電路學
briefs.tags: Circuit, KVL, KCL, Thevenin, Norton
briefs.desc: This is one of the mandatory courses for the EE Department. This course introduces the basic theory of linear circuit analysis, which is essential for designing complex electronic, communication, computer, and control systems.

briefs.name: 電子電路實驗
briefs.tags: 電晶體、運算放大器、被動元件、濾波電路、振盪電路、transistor, operational amplifier, passive devices, filters, oscilators
briefs.desc: This course is intended for EE students at the junior level who have already taken the basic circuit theory and micrelectronics. Students will get hands-on experiences through experiments to complement the learning of microelectronics and circuit theories. Op-amps, passive elements (e.g. R, L, and C), and transistors will be used extensively to implement various circuits.

briefs.name: 電子電路實驗
briefs.tags: 電晶體、運算放大器、被動元件、濾波電路、振盪電路、transistor, operational amplifier, passive devices, filters, oscilators
briefs.desc: This course is intended for EE students at the junior level who have already taken the basic circuit theory and micrelectronics. Students will get hands-on experiences through experiments to complement the learning of microelectronics and circuit theories. Op-amps, passive elements (e.g. R, L, and C), and transistors will be used extensively to implement various circuits.

briefs.name: 電子學一
briefs.tags: microelectronics, semiconductor devices, IC, device physics, circuit design, CMOS, BJT
briefs.desc: This course is an introductory course of microelectronics. We will focus on the fundamental knowledge of microelectronic circuits and emphasize the design-oriented approach. This course introduces the most important concepts for design of analog circuits such as characteristics of semiconductors, operating principles of diodes and transistors, and various amplifier configurations for both BJTs and MOSFETS. By developing solid understanding of basic knowledge, learning microelectronics could be enjoyable.

briefs.name: 電子學二
briefs.tags: Analog Integrated Circuit, Integrated Circuit, Linear Circuit, Operational Amplifier Circuit.
briefs.desc: This is a consecutive course after EE2255 Electronics. It covers quantitative analyses, design considerations and system applications for linear circuits, especially for operational amplifiers in feedback systems.

briefs.name: 電子學二
briefs.tags: Microelectronic II, Analog IC design, 類比積體電路設計, CMOS, 互補式金氧半元件
briefs.desc: This is a fundamental course for analysis and design of analog integrated circuits. It covers quantitative analyses, design considerations and system applications from circuit and physical viewpoints. Most material is for CMOS technology. BJT will be introduced briefly.

briefs.name: 計算機程式設計
briefs.tags: C++ programming, array, pointer, file, dynamic memory management, AI for coding
briefs.desc: Introduction to Programming provides a rigorous foundation in C++ programming and computational problem-solving for engineering students. Starting from the basics, students will learn programming syntax, algorithmic thinking, debugging techniques, and software development practices through hands- on assignments and real-world examples. In the era of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and smart system design, programming has become a fundamental skill for engineers. Whether developing AI models, analyzing large-scale data, designing intelligent systems, or creating electronic design automation (EDA) tools for integrated circuits, the ability to translate ideas into efficient code is increasingly essential. This course emphasizes not only how to write programs, but also how to think systematically and solve complex problems. By the end of the course, students will be able to design algorithms, implement solutions in C++, and build a strong foundation for future studies.

briefs.name: 計算機程式設計
briefs.tags: Computer programming, declarations, statements, efficiency, legibility, structure programming, object oriented programming; 電腦程式，宣告，執行動作，效率，可讀 性，結構型程式，物件導向程式
briefs.desc: The main objective of this introductory course is to help students develop programming skills to solve problems. As computers are becoming more powerful and ubiquitous, proper use of computers can increase productivity significantly. Thus, the ability to write efficient programs to solve problems improves one’s core competence and can be an important differentiator for one’s career. Among today’s popular programming languages, C is found to have the biggest impacts. Many modern computer languages borrowed heavily from C. Thus, proficiency in C language would pave ways to good programming in other languages. In this course, we will devote most of the time in C programming. object-oriented programming and classes, however, will also be briefly introduced.

briefs.name: 微處理機系統
briefs.tags: 微處理機、微控制器、組合語言、8051、ARC
briefs.desc: 講授微處理機系統基本概念。學習與編寫微處理機的組合語言及 C 語言程式。透過 8 位元微控制器 (8051) 及 32 位元 (Synopsys ARC EM)處理器範例學習微處理器的結構、指令集、記憶體定址、中斷控制以及週邊介面設計。

briefs.name: 微控器搭配可程式邏輯閘陣列之介紹與實作
briefs.nameEn: Hands-on Introduction to Microcontroller Operated with FPGA
briefs.tags: 微控制器,可程式化邏輯閘陣列,輸入輸出,聲音控制,通訊,馬達控制,Microcontroller, FPGA, Input/Output, Audio Control, Communication, Motor Control
briefs.desc: This course will introduce the architecture and design process of microcontroller with FPGA systems. We will introduce the operation software such as C language, VHDL, and Verilog. The experiments are utilized to study input/output, audio control, communication, and motor control. Furthermore, students will be guided to apply microcontroller with FPGA board for projects.

briefs.name: 代理型人工智慧基礎與應用實作
briefs.tags: 大語言模型 Large language model, 人工智慧 Artificial Intelligence, 代理人 Agentic AI, 圖形處理器 GPU, 生成式AI Generative AI
briefs.desc: 近年來大型語言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）快速發展，使人工智慧系統從過去以模型預測為主的模式，逐漸轉 向能夠進行推理、工具使用與任務規劃的 Agentic AI（代理型人工智慧）系統。此類系統結合大型語言模型、工具調用 （tool use）、記憶模組以及多代理協作等機制，使人工智慧能夠完成較為複雜的任務流程，並逐漸成為產業與學術界的 重要研究方向。另一方面，人工智慧模型的運算需求高度仰賴 GPU 等加速硬體。隨著開源大型模型與 GPU 計算環境逐漸普 及，讓學生更早接觸在本地端運行模型並進行系統開發，已成為人工智慧教育的重要趨勢。 本課程規劃為 1 學分短學期課程，主要提供電機資訊相關科系大二學生一個入門且具實作性的 AI 系統體驗。透過簡介 Agentic AI 的核心概念，並結合GPU 平台上的開源模型實作與簡易代理系統開發，讓學生能在短時間內理解現代AI 系統架 構，並透過實驗與專題專案培養實務能力。

briefs.name: 機率
briefs.tags: Probability, conditional probability, statistical independence, random variables, cumulative distribution function, conditional distribution, expectation, conditional expectation, laws of large numbers, central limit theorem
briefs.desc: This course discusses the basic mathematical models for physical phenomena which possess random features or for problems which can be solved by randomization methods. The aim of this course is to consolidate students' way of thinking from intuitive reasoning to rigorous reasoning with a logical framework. This course requires knowledge on calculus, both single and multiple variables.

briefs.name: 電磁波
briefs.tags: Maxwell's equation, plane electromagnetic waves, transmission lines, waveguides, antenna
briefs.desc: This class covers the following topics: Maxwell’s equations, plane electromagnetic waves, wave-guiding structures: transmission lines and waveguides, antenna and applications

briefs.name: 積體電路設計導論
briefs.tags: IC designs, VLSI designs, Circuit designs, Chip designs, Semiconductor
briefs.desc: In this course, students will learn the fundamentals of IC design, with a focus on transistor-level circuits and chip-level design methodologies. You will also become familiar with transistor-level IC design CAD tools, including circuit design, simulation, layout, and RC extraction, through the completion of all assigned homework and the course project. This course emphasizes both knowledge acquisition (知識學習) and hands-on practice (動手做).

briefs.name: 類比及射頻設計實務
briefs.nameEn: Case Study for Analog and RF Designs
briefs.tags: Analog IC, Radio-Frequency IC, System Integration
briefs.desc: 由聯發科技業界講師, 從產品應用、技術開發、與系統整合等實際案例，使大學部預計從事IC設計學生能從實際產品開發, 認識類比及射 頻設計領域，並促進研究動機。

briefs.name: 固態電子元件導論
briefs.tags: semiconductor physics, semiconductor Material & Energy States , Diodes , MOS Capacitor, Field Effect Transistors, Bipolar Junction Transistors
briefs.desc: In order to understand the properties of these devices, one needs to understand 1. electronic properties of the semiconductor materials 2. affected by impurities (intentional and unintentional) and applied voltages 3. temperature and geometric effects 4. device structures and optical radiation Pseudo-Classical Mechanism Instead of Quantum Mechanism 1. classical formulas such as Newton's laws & Lorentz equation can be used 2. effective mass replacing true electron mass 3. infinite periodic structure instead of finite periodic structure with boundaries 4. 1-D simple structure to fit 3-D complicate structure

briefs.name: 計算機結構
briefs.tags: computer architecture, organization, computer design, instruction set architecture, computer arithmetic, pipelining, cache, virtual memory.
briefs.desc: This course will discuss the basic architecture, organization, and design of a modern computer system. The contents cover instruction sets, computer arithmetic, processor core and pipelining, and caches. Students are assumed to have taken courses on logic design and programming in C/C++.

briefs.name: 通訊系統一
briefs.tags: Communication systems (通訊系統), Fourier analysis (傅立葉分析), amplitude modulation (調幅), frequency modulation (調頻), noise (雜訊).
briefs.desc: This is the first course in communications, which provides an introduction to basic communication concepts, analog communication systems, and digital baseband transmission.

briefs.name: 數位訊號處理實驗
briefs.tags: 訊號處理 (signal processing), 聲音處理 (audio processing), 影像處理 (video processing), 生醫訊號 (biomedical signal processing, 實作 (hands-on experiment)
briefs.desc: 從應用出發，培養訊號處理實際解決問題的設計與經驗。修課條件: 必需修過至少訊號與系統以上以及會 C/C++/Python程式 設計建議修過數位訊號處理概論為佳。本課程採音訊、影像、生醫三個大的單元，每個單元 4 週，由負責之教師負責實際授課 與帶實驗。期末則留有一些時間進行自訂專題.

briefs.name: 影像與視訊處理概論
briefs.nameEn: Introduction to Image and Video Signal Processing
briefs.tags: 影像處理(Image processing)、電腦視覺(Computer vision)、影像強化(Image enhancement)、彩色影像(Color image)、數位影像(Digital image)
briefs.desc: 本課程介紹影像處理之基本觀念及演算法，課程內容包括影像處理基礎及電腦視覺簡介、影像強化(對比加強、柔化影像)、及 彩色影像處理等。

briefs.name: 機器學習導論
briefs.tags: 機器學習 (Machine Learning), 統計學錫 (Statistical Learning), 集成學習 (Ensemble Learning), 強化學習 (Reinforcement Learning), 分類 (Classification), 迴歸 (Regression)
briefs.desc: 機器學習是一個重要的研究領域，有許多成功的應用，尤其近幾年在電腦視覺、人機介面及社群網路之資料探勘等領域之技術 發展，機器學習皆扮演相當重要之角色。基於機器學習所發展的方法已被應用於多媒體信號處理、電腦視覺、語音和手寫識 別、生物特徵識別、資料探勘、搜索引擎、醫學診斷、證券市場分析、戰略遊戲和機器人運用，乃至於生物資訊等新興產業。 機器學習結合了統計、數學與資訊科學等學門。廣義來說，機器學習研究如何讓電腦具有學習的能力，從以往的經驗及數據中 學習到知識，以增進電腦本身的效能，因此機器學習也可解釋為利用資料來建立一些模擬真實世界的模式（Model），利用這 些模式來描述資料中的特徵（Patterns）以及關係（Relations）。這些模式有兩種用處，第一，瞭解資料的特徵與關係可以 提供決策所需要的資訊。第二，資料的特徵可以幫助進行預測。 本課程介紹機器學習之基本數學理論基礎及其在不同領域(如樣型識別、信號處理及資料分析及統計)之實際應用。本課程將 要求修課同學以電腦程式作業及修課專題的方式實作機器學習演算法，以深入了解機器學習理論及演算法特性。

briefs.name: 深度學習實作
briefs.tags: 深度學習(Deep Learning)、機器學習(Machine Learning)、人工智慧(Artificial Intelligence)、類神經網路(Artificial Neural Network)、智慧運算(Intelligent Computing)
briefs.desc: 本課程透過深度學習題目之實作，在以各種深度學習網路架構解決各種人工智慧問題，讓學生除了在課程中理解及深化深度學 習之原理及技術，並具備親自解決實務問題之經驗與能力。希望學生藉由此課程提升創新及實作能力。

briefs.name: 電動機械
briefs.tags: 磁路分析 Magnetic circuit analysis, 變壓器 Transformers, 步進馬達 Stepping motors, 直流馬達及發電機 DC motors and generators, 同步馬達及發電機 Synchronous motors and generators, 感應馬達及發電機 Induction motors and generators
briefs.desc: 介紹機電能量轉換原理、各式電機之結構、操作原理、運轉特性以及固態控制。另外，亦介紹電力系統之組成、輸配、應 用、用電安全、電源品質、備用電源及一些特殊設備之電源系統等。供同學通盤了解電力工程之有關事務 (與電動機械實 驗配合進行，欲修電動機械實驗者請修電動機械課程)。 This course introduces the following topics for various electric machines: electro-mechanical energy conversion principle; structures, operation principle, running characteristics, power electronic control, etc. In addition, some basic power engineering concepts are also introduced, such as power system configuration, transmission and distribution, electricity applications, electric safety, power quality, standby power and some special electric power systems. From this course the students can generally understand the basic electric power engineering affairs. The students are suggested to take this course if they want to participate the course of “Electric machinery laboratory” offered in the followed semeste

briefs.name: 實作專題一
briefs.desc: This course will train the students to have hands-on experience on a specific project under the guidance of a professor. The fields of research project range from microelectronics, nanotechnology, VLSI design, to biomedical engineering.

briefs.name: 實作專題二
briefs.desc: This course will train the students to have hands-on experience on a specific project under the guidance of a professor. The fields of reseach project range from microelectronics, nanotechnology, VLSI design, to biomedical engineering.

briefs.name: 固態物理導論
briefs.tags: solid-state physics, chemistry and crystal, fundamental properties and their elements, quantum physics and statistical mechanics
briefs.desc: Welcome to solid-state physics! This lecture will build the basic understanding of physics at the undergraduate level of students from various background. In order to prepare everyone for this topic, the lecture will cover the following elements in solid-state. 1. Chemistry (needed in this lecture) 2. Quantum physics (needed in this lecture) 3. Statistical mechanics (needed in this lecture) 4. Electrical properties – Electron in solid 5. Heat properties – Phonons in solid 6. Optical properties – band structures and excitons 7. Crystal structures 8. Semiconductor devices 9. Magnetic properties of atoms Three textbooks are recommended for this lecture. I will opt a modern aspect and interpretation of solid-state physics, The Oxford solid state basics, as the main materials. Simon, Steven H. The Oxford solid state basics. OUP Oxford, 2013. Kittel, Charles. Introduction to solid state physics. Ashcroft, N. W., and N. D. Mermin. "Solid State Physics"

briefs.name: 光電實驗
briefs.tags: 幾何光學(Geometrical optics)、繞射及干涉(Diffraction and interference)、電光及光學調制技術(Light modulators)、基礎雷射原理（Laser fundamentals）、全像術（holography）
briefs.desc: 本課程教授光電基礎知識，讓學生執行十個光電實驗：1. 幾何光學、2. 繞射及干涉、3. 干涉儀、4. 光的極化、5. 光學成像、6. 光 纖波導實驗、7. 基礎雷射原理、8. 雷射二極體與發光二極體特性實驗、9. 二倍頻實驗、10. 全像術。透過實作，學生將建立光的傳 播、波動、干涉、偏振、成像及雷射等核心概念，並培養光學量測與實驗操作能力。

briefs.name: 化合半導體電晶體設計與晶圓製程實驗
briefs.nameEn: Design and Fabrication Laboratory of Compound Semiconductor Transistors
briefs.tags: GaN HEMT元件設計,TCAD模擬與分析,Layout設計優化,半導體製程實作,電性量測與特性分析,化合物半導體元件,元件技術,元件物理與操作原理
briefs.desc: Through this course, students will experience the complete device development cycle of gallium nitride (GaN) high-electron-mobility transistors (HEMTs), from design and simulation to fabrication and electrical characterization. Students will use TCAD tools to analyze and optimize transistor structures, develop device layouts, participate in fabrication processes, and perform electrical measurements and data analysis. Under the guidance of the instructor, teaching assistants, and technical staff, students will gain hands-on exposure to semiconductor process flows, fabrication equipment, and characterization techniques. Students will be expected to independently refine and optimize their device designs through iterative simulation and layout development. By designing, fabricating, and evaluating compound semiconductor devices, students will develop a deeper understanding of the relationships among material properties, device architecture, fabrication processes, and el

briefs.name: 積體電路設計實驗
briefs.tags: 數位電路設計、硬體描述語言、邏輯合成、晶片自動佈局繞線；Digital circuit design, hardware description language, logic synthesis, layout APR
briefs.desc: 本課程依數位電路設計的標準元件設計流程分為三單元：Verilog硬體描述語言、邏輯合成、自動佈局繞線。 除了講堂上的授課以外，每週皆有上機實驗課程，預計有三次數位電路設計作業、一次期中考、期末專題。。本課程強調深入的 Verilog語言撰寫以及EDA工具的操作，以實際體驗與了解數位電路設計的趣味與精髓。

briefs.name: 硬體安全導論
briefs.tags: cryptography, security, hardware security, anti-tampering, PUF, root of trust, 密碼學, 硬體安全, 抗攻擊設計, 不可複製功能, 信任根
briefs.desc: 本課程旨在探討各項與硬體相關的資安議題，核心內容包括密碼學演算法、物理攻擊與抗攻擊設計、信任根與安全操作，此外也 將介紹較為進階的演算法和硬體模組設計。本課程主要分為三大部分，第一部分講述密碼學與安全硬體設計所需的知識基礎，會 針對常用的密碼學算法以及相關數學原理做概要性的介紹。第二部份講述在硬體上常見的攻擊以及相對應的防禦方式，涵蓋物理 攻擊簡介、旁通道攻擊理論與實作以及抗攻擊設計。第三部分將針對晶片底層的信任根作介紹，涵蓋隨機數產生器、系統單晶片 內的安全操作以及物理不可複製函數。在核心內容之外，也會針對越趨重要的後量子密碼學以及其基礎做初步介紹。

briefs.name: 固態電子實驗--半導體製程與實驗
briefs.tags: 半導體製造Semiconductor manufacturing, 場效電晶體 Field-effect transistors, 微影 Optical lithography, 鍍膜 Deposition, 濕式蝕刻 Wet Etching
briefs.desc: The silicon integrated circuit is surely one of the wonders of our age. The ability to fabricate tens of millions of individual components on a chip with an area of a few centimeter square has enabled the information age. This course attempts to describe not only the manufacturing practice associated with the technologies used in silicon chip fabrication, but also the underlying scientific basis for those technologies. This course will show the students how silicon field-effect transistors are made using the knowledge learned in the ULSI technologies. However, due to the limited implementation hours, students can only fabricate p-type or n-type MOSFET with characteristics measured and simulated.

briefs.name: 固態電子實驗--半導體製程與實驗
briefs.tags: 半導體製造Semiconductor manufacturing, 場效電晶體 Field-effect transistors, 微影 Optical lithography, 鍍膜 Deposition, 濕式蝕刻 Wet Etching
briefs.desc: The silicon integrated circuit is surely one of the wonders of our age. The ability to fabricate tens of millions of individual components on a chip with an area of a few centimeter square has enabled the information age. This course attempts to describe not only the manufacturing practice associated with the technologies used in silicon chip fabrication, but also the underlying scientific basis for those technologies. This course will show the students how silicon field-effect transistors are made using the knowledge learned in the ULSI technologies. However, due to the limited implementation hours, students can only fabricate p-type or n-type MOSFET with characteristics measured and simulated.

briefs.name: 生醫影像導論
briefs.tags: Biomedical Imaging, Signals and Systems, Ultrasound, Magnetic Resonance Imaging, X-ray, Computed Tomography, Nuclear Medicine
briefs.desc: This is an introductory course of biomedical “imaging” (i.e., designing a camera which is capable of seeing through human body and small animals) with emphasis on the signals and systems aspects. It will cover the most important imaging modalities - projection radiography, X- ray computed tomography, nuclear medicine imaging, ultrasound imaging, and magnetic resonance imaging. Basic principles, instrumentation, image characteristics, clinical applications, and recent progress of these imaging modalities will be discussed. In this course, the students will learn how to apply the knowledge learned in the course "Signals and Systems" to biomedical imaging.

briefs.name: 通訊系統二
briefs.tags: Communication system, modulation, demodulation, information theory
briefs.desc: This is a core course for students who would like to understand or enter the field of digital communications engineering. As analog communication has been covered in the course "Communication System I", "Communication System II" introduces Digital Communication. This course covers Digital Transmissions, Spread-Spectrum Modulation, Multiuser Communications and Information Theory. This course is designed in parallel with "Communication System I". For students taking this course, the background of "Communication System I" is preferred. For the practicing engineer in the communications industry and those who (such as the senior/beginning graduate student) plan to have communications as major area,this course is necessary to build solid background on digital communications. For those who are to engage in signal processing and IC design for communications, this is also a course worth taking.

briefs.name: 通訊系統實驗
briefs.tags: 通訊系統(Communication Systems), 軟體定義無線電(Software-Defined Radio), 圖像化程式語言程式(LabView), 數位調變(Digital Modulation), 實作課程(Hands-on Course)
briefs.desc: 本課程專注於提升學生的通訊系統實作能力，透過模組化設計將複雜的通訊系統分解成易於理解的部分。課程包含理論講解與 實作練習，每週一小時的理論講解與兩到三小時的實驗課程。學生將使用軟體定義無線電硬體設備及圖像化程式語言Labview來 進 行實驗，並在期末完成綜合專題。

briefs.name: 電力系統一
briefs.tags: 電力系統,再生能源,智慧電網,發電機,傳輸線,電力電子轉換器 ,Power System, Renewable energy, Smart Grid, Generator, Transmission Line, Power Electronics Converter
briefs.desc: This course will introduce the basic principles, methods, technologies, and applications of power systems, renewable energy, and smart grids. Understand the operation of generators, transmission lines, and loads in power systems. Furthermore, introduce the solar power and wind turbine generators in renewable energy systems and the operation of power electronics converters.

briefs.name: 電力電子
briefs.tags: 電力電子 Power Electronics, DC-DC 轉換器 DC-DC Converters, 功率半導體 Power Semiconductor Devices, GaN / SiC, Wide-Bandgap Devices, 電源管理 IC Power Management IC, 高頻電力轉換 High-Frequency Power Conversion
briefs.desc: 本課程介紹電力電子之基礎與進階概念，內容涵蓋電力轉換原理、常見轉換器拓樸、控制方法與功率半導體元件。課程進一步延伸 至現代電力應用，包括高頻電力轉換、電源管理 IC 概念，以及氮化鎵（GaN）與碳化矽（SiC）等寬能隙功率元件。課程將結合 理論推導、設計實務與產業應用案例，協助學生建立電力電子系統分析與設計的完整基礎，並銜接後續於電力、系統與積體電路相 關領域之進階學習。 This course introduces fundamental and advanced concepts of power electronics, including power conversion principles, converter topologies, control techniques, and power semiconductor devices. The course further extends to modern applications such as high-frequency power conversion, power management IC concepts, and wide-bandgap devices including GaN and SiC. Practical design considerations and industrial case studies are emphasized to help students build a solid foundation for advanced studies in power, system, and IC-related fields.

briefs.name: 專題研究
briefs.desc: 由教授與學生擬定研究題目，以進行專題研究，培養解決問題的能力。

briefs.name: 類比與數位濾波器設計
briefs.tags: Analog, mixed-signal, integrated circuits, filters, switched-cap.
briefs.desc: This course covers an overview of continuous-time and discrete-time signal processing techniques, and the analysis and design of the analog and mixed-signal circuit building blocks which are used to implement them in modern electronic systems.

briefs.name: 影像感測器積體電路設計
briefs.tags: CMOS image sensor, Anaog to digital converter, SAR, 影像感測器, 類比數位轉換器, 類比電路設計
briefs.desc: This course is organized on selected topics in the design and analysis of mixed-signal IC design for CMOS image sensor. It covers quantitative analyses, design considerations and system applications from circuit and architecture viewpoints. Starting with an introduction of fundamentals of CIS, a variety of smart CMOS imagers with different operations and structures will be discussed. For application-wise design, sensor technologies like high dynamic range, low power, low noise, and depth sensing etc. will be included. The mixed-signal IC design and implementation of selected key blocks in CIS including analog- font-end (AFE) and analog-to-digital converter are covered.

briefs.name: 時序電路設計及應用
briefs.nameEn: Timing Circuit Designs and Their Applications
briefs.tags: Timing Circuit, Delay-Locked Loop (DLL), Phase-Locked Loop (PLL), Time-to-Digital Converter (TDC), Speed Grading, Interconnect Delay Testing and Monitoring
briefs.desc: 晶片內部的執行有一定的時序，就像人的脈搏一樣。因此，每一個晶片內部都有時序相關的控制電路，譬如鎖向迴路 (Phase-Locked Loop)、鎖延遲迴路 (Delay-Locked Loop)、時間量化器 (Time-to-Digital Converter)、數位轉時 間之轉換器 (Digital-to-Time Converter)等，這些電路在晶片設計、設計自動化與測試等領域都有廣泛的應用 (如全 晶片高速時脈之控制，異質整合晶片時脈訊號同步、電路速度測試與分級、晶片線上健康狀況監控等)。過去十幾年，有許 多全數化的時序相關電路之設計理念的發展，因此希望透過此門課程，提供有志於電路設計領域發展的同學相關的札實訓 練，並建立相關的研發能力。

briefs.name: 鎖相迴路之設計與應用
briefs.nameEn: Design and Application of Phase-Locked Loop
briefs.tags: oscillator, frequency divider, phase-locked loop, clock and data recovery, jitter tolerance
briefs.desc: This course introduces the design and analysis of the phase-locked loop (PLL). It covers the phase domain analysis and modeling of the loop, building blocks, phase noise evaluation of the PLL. It also includes the applications of the PLL, especially the clock and data recovery (CDR) design for the wireline receiver.

briefs.name: 類比電路設計
briefs.tags: 類比積體電路, Analog IC, 超大型積體電路, VLSI, 線性電路, Linear Circuits, 金氧半導體, CMOS.
briefs.desc: This is an advanced course for analysis and design analog integrated circuits. It covers quantitative analyses, design considerations and system applications for linear circuits, especially for operational amplifiers.

briefs.name: 射頻積體電路設計
briefs.tags: radio frequency, RFIC, amplifiers, transceivers, mixers, oscillators
briefs.desc: This course introduces the fundamentals and the design of RF and millimeter-wave circuits based on CMOS technology.

briefs.name: 計算機算術
briefs.tags: 1補數, 2補數, 正負數, 餘數, IEEE標準浮點表示, 加, 減, 乘, 除, Carry look-ahead adder, carry select adder, carry skip adder,
briefs.desc: 本課程教導現有計算機中基本表示方法 及其算術運算(加, 減, 乘, 除)之硬體電路設計與其速度和面積的取捨.

briefs.name: 系統理論
briefs.tags: 最佳控制, 穩定度, Bellman Optimality Principle, Dynamical Programming, 資料驅動, 強化學習,RLHF
briefs.desc: 本課程首先探討最佳控制. 之後以Bellman Optimality Principle與動態規劃, 研究有模型系統之最佳控制策略. 最後 將有模型之最佳控制, 拓展至無模型下, 資料驅動之各種強化學習策略與RLHF. 先修科目：控制系統。線性代數。機率。 同修科目：機器學習。演算法。

briefs.name: 高等電力網路分析
briefs.tags: 電力系統，運轉與調度，電力潮流，故障電流，穩定度
briefs.desc: To let the students have a clear knowledge about how a power system is configured and operated to meet the basic steady state and transient requirements based on the pre-analyses of power flow, short- circuit, steady state stability and transient stability.

briefs.name: 固態能量轉換
briefs.tags: Pulse-width modulation, current control, voltage control, inverter
briefs.desc: The civilization of electricity is going through a paradigm shift at this moment. The semiconductor pioneered by John Bardeen, William Shockley and Walter Brattain in the 1950s leads to the revolution of information technology, and the way we share and exchange information is forever changed. In the next decades, this paradigm shift will revolutionize the way we share and exchange energy. Power electronics technologies will shape the internet of electric power as more and more renewables and distributed energy resources are developed to reduce CO2 and prevent global warming. This course focuses on the fundamentals of DC/AC power converters the technologies of their applications in the smart grid.

briefs.name: 切換式電源供應器
briefs.tags: Power Converter, Graft technique, layer technique , Small-signal modeling, Peak-current control, Change-mode control, average current control
briefs.desc: 1. Introduction：電力電子技術和應用介紹與學習範疇。 2. Basic DC to DC converters：電力轉換器之組成基本元件、轉換器應用介紹。 3. Graft & layer techniques：電源轉換器拓樸結構、工作與組成原理。 4. Dynamic modeling of DC converters：動態時域/頻域分析、升降壓轉換器建模。 5. Closed loop control of DC converters：電壓電流控制。 6. Soft switching techniques：切換分析與組合、緩衝器介紹。 7. Quasi resonant & resonant converters：準諧振與諧振轉換器。 8. Switched capacitor converters：昇壓型轉換器。

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: Seminar, DSP, AI, Circuit Design, EDA
briefs.desc: Seminar talks will be arranged and offered to EE students to cover related areas in industry and academia.

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: 專題演講,邀請演講,Keynote speech, invited talk
briefs.desc: 書報討論課程每週邀請演講者進行專題演講，演講主題以電力組相關領域為主，由電力組老師邀請演講者，演講時間約 1~1.5小時，同學在演講結束後可與演講者互動。

briefs.name: 研究方法
briefs.tags: 研究生(Graduate student), 指導教授(Advisor), 研究工作(Research work), 期末報告(Final report), 指導教授評分(Advisor's Grade)
briefs.desc: 研究生於選修學期需跟著指導教授做研究，期末繳交成績報告，指導教授將依學生的表現與報告進行評分。

briefs.name: 系統生物學
briefs.tags: Modeling(建模),Bioinformatics(生物資訊),Synthetic biology design(合成生物學設計),Gene regulation network(基因調控網路),protein-protein interaction network(蛋白質網路)
briefs.desc: Systems biology is a discipline that integrates biochemistry, cell biology, computer science, and systems engineering to provide a holistic view on biological functions and structures. The genomic revolution of high- throughput techniques has opened up systematic investigations and engineering designs for various life forms. System biology entails synthetic biology and creates many emerging applications in energy, pharmaceuticals, bio-materials, foods, ecosystem protection, etc. through engineering principles. This course will discuss the system-level models of various basic biological process, analysis of experimental and literature data, and deduce interesting theoretical insight. Students will need basic understanding of linear algebra, probability, and control theory. No prerequisite of biology courses is essential to take this course.

briefs.name: 高等計算機結構
briefs.tags: Computer Architecture, Memory Hierarchy, Cache Coherence, Instruction-Level Parallelism, Data-Level Parallelism, Thread-Level Parallelism, Domain-Specific Architectures
briefs.desc: We will discuss several advanced concepts of computer architecture for modern machines. Topics include memory hierarchy, DRAM, ILP, dynamic scheduling, SIMD, vector, GPU and DSA accelerators. It is highly recommended that students have already taken undergraduate computer architecture course. It's essential to have prior knowledge about ISA, arithmetic operations, pipeline, and cache.

briefs.name: 數位聲訊分析與合成
briefs.nameEn: Analysis and synthesis of digital audio signals
briefs.tags: omega, 2pi, e, j, n
briefs.desc: 介紹信號處理在音樂、語音、或其他日常生活中聽得到的聲訊中的應用：包含分析與合成兩大部分。學生修完本課程, 應能對這個領域的核心技術、背景觀念有充分理解，並對本領域新研究課題有所接觸，以期激發創造力，針對有興趣 的課題作更深入的實作研究。

briefs.name: 錯誤更正碼二
briefs.tags: Coding, capacity
briefs.desc: This course covers the most important developments in recent years in the area of error-correcting codes to complement the contents of its predecessor Error-Correcting Codes.

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文, Thesis
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文研究, Thesis
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行深入研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之創新性成果。

briefs.name: 跨域探索課程：電資院學士班
briefs.tags: 自我探索, 設計人生, 學習規劃, 學術倫理, 探索校園, 時間管理, 睡眠管理, 壓力調適, 人際互動, 多元文化, 溝通表達, 履歷撰寫
briefs.desc: 本課程目的是幫助電資班大一新生在學業和個人方面順利從高中過渡到大學，藉由參與課程及團體活動，建立對學校及學系的 歸屬感、培養批判思考能力、了解電資領域，同時順利適應大學生活、找尋人生目的、意義與方向。

briefs.name: 邏輯設計
briefs.tags: logic design, digital circuit, logic optimization, sequential circuit, boolean algebra
briefs.desc: This course introduces the basic theories and the implementations of logic circuits and digital systems. We will start with the topics of number systems and Boolean algebra, which are fundamental to all digital systems, followed by the optimization, storage elements such as flip flops, and sequential circuits. With both combinational logic and sequential circuits, we will discuss the design of registers, counters, memory as well as programmable devices.

briefs.name: 邏輯設計
briefs.tags: Logic Design, Logic Optimization, Combinational Logics, Sequential Logics
briefs.desc: 本課程將介紹邏輯電路的設計與實作理論，包含了二進位、布林代數、組合電路設計，儲存單元正反器、記憶體。並將介紹同步序列邏輯 電路與有限狀態器之設計以及暫存器轉移階層設計方法。

briefs.name: 開口就像專家：簡報表達技巧(磨課師)
briefs.nameEn: Talk Like a Pro: Effective Presentation Skills(MOOC)
briefs.tags: Scientific communication, presentation skills, audience analysis, critical thinking, communicative moves
briefs.desc: Talk Like a Pro: Effective Presentation Skills is an interactive online course hosted on Future Learn that develops strategic presentation and public speaking skills for academic and professional contexts. The course adopts a step-based microlearning design integrating short video lectures, guided reflection, embedded quizzes, and discussion-based activities. Learners explore how to analyze audience and purpose, structure compelling content, enhance delivery techniques, manage Q&A sessions, and build a confident speaker mindset. Through task-based assignments and peer interaction, participants apply key concepts to their own presentation topics, progressively refining both content and delivery. By the end of the course, learners will have developed practical tools to design, deliver, and evaluate presentations with clarity, engagement, and professional impact.

briefs.name: Python語言程式入門
briefs.tags: introduction to programming, Python language, computer science, structured language, modules
briefs.desc: This course introduces fundamental programming concepts in the Python language and related environment. Fundamental concepts include overview of computer systems, python environment setup, Python language overview, command line interface, numbers, string formatting, sequences, dictionaries and sets, control flow, exception, file, function, recursion, object orientation, inheritance, polymorphism, and modules.

briefs.name: 訊號與系統
briefs.tags: Linear Time-Invariant (LTI) Systems, Convolution, Fourier Analysis (Fourier Series and Fourier Transform), Laplace Transform, z-Transform, Sampling
briefs.desc: This mandatory course provides a comprehensive foundation for the mathematical analysis of signals and systems, which is essential for fields such as signal processing, communications, optics, and control. The curriculum focuses on the properties and interactions of continuous-time and discrete-time signals within linear time-invariant (LTI) systems. Students will master fundamental mathematical operations and transforms used to characterize deterministic signals and system behavior. Key topics include: Convolution; Fourier Series and Fourier Transforms (Continuous and Discrete); Sampling Theory; Laplace Transforms and z-Transforms. By combining theoretical rigor with practical examples, the course aims to consolidate the analytical skills necessary to solve complex engineering problems in both the time and frequency domains.

briefs.name: 常微分方程
briefs.tags: Ordinary differential equations, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Modeling
briefs.desc: This course aims to provide sufficient mathematical training for students majoring in engineering and physics. This course provides the mathematical foundation for electromagnetics, modern physics, solid-state physics, and related fields. We value the connection with problems in physics and engineering, showing examples. The contents include: 1. Introduction 2. First-order ODEs 3. Second-order ODEs 4. Operator methods 5. Power series and special functions 6. Laplace transforms 7. Fourier series and transforms … etc. * The course is offered in English.

briefs.name: 常微分方程
briefs.tags: Engineering problems, Differential equations, Laplace transform, Series solutions, Fourier series
briefs.desc: Ordinary Differential Equations class is to teach how to solve differential equations, which are models in many engineering problems. This post-calculus mathematics is needed and used by today's scientists and engineers. It will cover the following topics: 1. First order differential equations 2. Second order differential equations 3. Laplace transform 4. Series solutions for differential equations 5. Systems of differential equations 6. Fourier series

briefs.name: 計算機網路概論
briefs.tags: 電腦網路, 網際網路, 應用層, 傳輸層, 網路層, 資料連結層, Computer Networks, Internet, Application layer, Transport layer, Network layer, Data link layer
briefs.desc: This course introduces the fundamental design principles of computer networks and the Internet. We will explore the layered architecture of the network protocol stack, including the Application, Transport, Network, and Data link layers. Beyond theoretical concepts, the course emphasizes practical skills, training students to design and implement networked applications through hands-on programming assignments.

briefs.name: 實作專題一
briefs.desc: 實作專題為本班必修課程，所有學生必須修滿2學期。課程由選修學生跟隨實作的老師，透過「從做中學」（learning by doing）的方式，學習到學術研究的精神、方法、與實作過程。

briefs.name: 實作專題二
briefs.desc: 課程說明： 實作專題為本班必修課程， 所有學生必須修滿2學期。 課程由選修學生跟隨實作的老師， 透過「從做中學」（learning by doing）的方式， 學習到學術研究的精神、方法、與實作過程。 教學方式、成績考核： 修課學生於修課期間需跟隨專題指導教授進行相關專題研究進度，指導教授將依學生的表現來評分。 電資院學士班實作專題課程相關規定請見以下連結： https://u-eecs.site.nthu.edu.tw/p/404-1176-171054.php?Lang=zh-tw

briefs.name: 論文
briefs.tags: 論文, Thesis
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 全球經濟
briefs.tags: international trade, international finance, globalization, new challenge of central banking, WTO
briefs.desc: Course objective: This course is intended to have students understand the current important issues about global economy. The regular lectures are organized under the framework of Trade and Development, with topics cover theory, history, institution, and policy. In addition, selective lectures will explore recent hot issues of globalization – cultural diversity and creative industries, and new challenge of central banking. These lectures are given by the professors from the Department of Economics.

briefs.name: 科技與產業
briefs.tags: 科技與產業, 科技與產業發展概念, 通訊, 大數據, 人工智慧, 無人科技, 生醫, 材料與化工, 綠能, 數位轉型, 跨領域及價值創新
briefs.desc: 近年來全球資通訊與網路及AI等科技快速發展，以及自2020年起Covid-19新冠疫情席捲全球，加上中美科技與貿易戰、俄烏戰爭 以及美伊戰爭等地緣政治劇烈變動與2050淨零碳排等多重因素之衝擊，世界經濟與產業進入高速蛻變的時代。這不僅影響人類的生 活型態與消費者行為，科技產業的發展生態體系及地緣政治下的市場遊戲規則也產生革命性的劇烈變化，例如：5G、人工智慧、 ChatGPT、DeepSeek、大數據、數位轉型、生醫、長照、材料、綠能、無人載具及智慧型機器人等各領域皆創造出很多嶄新的產 品、服務與商業模式等。本課程特別邀請國內各科技與產業領域頂尖專家，以講座方式介紹最新各領域發展趨勢及台灣產業發展的 機會，期望同學瞭解與掌握這些領域的發展趨勢，以利同學掌握台灣產業法展的機遇並有所貢獻。

briefs.name: 行銷管理
briefs.tags: 行銷管理,市場,消費者,品牌,行銷組合
briefs.desc: This course focuses on the application of marketing concepts and theories to high technology-based and traditional products/services.

briefs.name: 創新與創業
briefs.tags: innovation 5.0, innovation planning, business models, innovation policy, industrial transformation, entrepreneurship
briefs.desc: 1.介紹創業管理的基礎知識與技能，使學生能瞭解創業精神與經濟發展、企業管理之間的關係及 實務創業家所關心主要問題。 2.開拓學生的視野，瞭解專業經理人除了要為股東善盡效率管理人之責任外，發揮創業精神才是 創造企業成長及獲得超額利潤的來源。有助於培養MBA學生以創新思維，處理既有企業的新事業 發展管理、創投事業經營與自行創業的能力。 3.使學生瞭解新創事業的特性與其所面臨的相關管理問題，如分析創業商機、撰寫創業計畫書、 籌募資金、管理成長與經營團隊管理。

briefs.name: 服務科學
briefs.tags: 服務主導邏輯, 服務系統, 價值共創, 服務設計, 城鄉創生, Service-Dominant Logic, service system, value co-creation, service design, urban-rural revitalization
briefs.desc: 眾所週知，世界已經邁向了服務經濟的時代。「服務」存在人類社會遠在所謂的「服務業」的產業 分類。但究竟「服務」是什麼？而當IBM於2004年倡導所謂的「服務科學」，或者後來加上工程與 管理，統稱「服務科學工程與管理」(Service Science, Management, and Engineering, SSME)。近年來，在原有的SSME外加上Design，成為現在一般談及服務科學時，以SSMED來描述 它。究竟其內涵與實質內容為何？究竟服務科學的範圍與議題為何？服務科學與現有的學術與實務 領域有何關聯？如何將服務科學的理論應用於實務上？實務上的議題與需求如何來成為服務科學的 研究內容與貢獻？本課程的課程內容規劃即在滿足大家對服務科學的好奇心。同時也希望學生能勇 敢地探索此一新的領域，成為服務科學發展學術與實務社群的生力軍。 本課程的目標簡述如下： 1. 學生能完整定義服務科學的內涵與範疇。 2. 學生能應用服務體驗設計，進行服務設計。 3. 學生能分析與規劃服務價值網絡以提供服務價值。 4. 學生能針對不同的產業提出創新的服務模式。 5. 學生能指出重要的服務科學相關的重要議題，進行研究。 本課程的內容與教學具有以下的特色： 1. 理論與實務並重； 2. 講授與個案教學

briefs.name: 企業及管理論壇
briefs.tags: 科技管理、科技治理、產業發展、企業經營、孫運璿科技講座
briefs.desc: 本課程之主旨在透過專題演講的方式，讓同學對於全球趨勢、政經環境、社會文化、法規政策、產業發展與企業經營管理等不同 面向有更為深入的認識與瞭解。專題演講擬邀請的對象包括各領域的專家學者、孫運璿科技講座主講者與不同產業之企業家和專 業經理人等。學期成績將由課堂參與、期末心得書面報告等成績計算。

briefs.name: 組織權力與領導
briefs.tags: 組織權力與領導 (AI世代應有的提升)
briefs.desc: 本課程旨在培養和提升EMBA/MBA學生的領導力，重點在於實用性，探討如何在瞬息萬變的數位化AI商業環境中，將領導力、 權力與政治技巧有效應用於各類組織中 （特別是受傳統文化影響而又急需創新和創業的企業）促進企業成長，個人事業成功 和生活美滿。 在任何組織中，不論其規模或性質，都存在領導力實踐與權力運用的交互作用。隨著外界環境變化，這種互動/博弈過程也在 變化，其結果直接影響組織績效與個人職涯發展。而當前快速變動的數位化商業環境中，人工智慧（AI）提升了資訊透明 度、資料可得性與決策速度。本課程不以AI為主軸，而是適度結合 AI 所帶來的「眼光延伸」與「策略敏捷化」，協助學生理 解在領導力實踐，權力運用在公司政治要素中，哪些能力將因數位工具被放大，哪些則更加依賴領導者的人格、價值與判 斷。 AI 時代的領導者最重要的能力仍然是願景、策略判斷、贏得人心、文化建設與執行力。科技提高效率，但無法取代領導 者的洞察力、勇氣、道德框架與激勵人心的力量。因此，本課程將在原有領導力實踐，權力運用在公司政治的基礎上，加入 「AI 帶來的環境變化」作為參考視角，使學生更能以現代化的方式理解傳統領導力的深度意義。 本課程強調組&

briefs.desc: 本課程主要介紹公司治理相關的國內外議題以及台灣之公司法制。

briefs.name: 財務管理與數據治理
briefs.tags: Financial Management、Financial Statement Analysis、Capital、Valuation、Risk and Return Analysis, Data-Driven Economy, Data Governance, Big Data, Data Protection, Legal Compliance
briefs.desc: The goal of this course is to introduce the fundamental principles of corporate finance to students. An emphasis will be placed upon on (1) Introduction to Corporate Finance and Financial Statement Analysis, (2) Value and Capital Budgeting, (3) Risk and Return Analysis, (4) Capital Structure and Dividend Decision, and (5) Other related Financial Topics. In today’s data-driven economy, data governance has become a critical component of business strategy and corporate decision-making. AI and emerging technologies are transforming how organizations innovate, compete, and create value. At the same time, governments are introducing new policies and regulations to address concerns relating to privacy, cybersecurity, consumer protection, and fair competition. This course explores how firms can leverage big data as a strategic asset while managing the risks and responsibilities associated with data collection, analytics, algorithmic decision- making, profiling, and use

briefs.name: 數據經營管理與AI
briefs.nameEn: Critical Numbers for Decision-Making and AI Integration
briefs.tags: Big Data, Economic Analysis, Financial Decision, Social Network Analysis, AI
briefs.desc: This course is designed to help managers identify the numbers and information that truly matter and turn them into better business decisions. The course integrates Social Network Analysis, AI for Deep Research, economic and financial thinking, and corporate governance, using case discussions, practical examples, and group activities to connect analytical concepts with real-world management challenges.

briefs.name: 商業決策測量與分析
briefs.nameEn: Measurement and Analysis for Business Decision Making
briefs.tags: Business Decision Making, Management Accounting
briefs.desc: This course provides students with a comprehensive overview of financial reporting, analysis and measurement issues in the context of business decision making. Student will gain an understanding of financial statements and their underlying measurements. They will then use this understanding to conduct analyses using financial ratios. Students will then explore the role of cost measurements, allocations, etc. in determining the performance measures of parts of the organization and their inter-relationship with both choosing and evaluating strategies in various business contexts. They will cover issues such as matching strategies to performance measures, choosing and evaluating key performance indicators and balanced scorecards, etc.

briefs.name: 專案管理
briefs.tags: project selection, project planning, resource allocation
briefs.desc: Topics include project selection, project planning, negotiation, budgeting, scheduling, resource allocation, project control, project auditing, and project termination. Topics are viewed from a managerial perspective.

briefs.name: 策略與決策
briefs.tags: Decisions, Strategy
briefs.desc: Understanding markets and industries: shifts in demand; shifts in supply; predicting and explaining shifts in demand and/or supply Market structures and structural changes: perfect competition; monopolistic competition and product differentiation; bundles of attributes; oligopoly; protected and entrepreneurial monopolies

briefs.name: 公司法與公司治理
briefs.tags: Corporate Law, Corporate Governance, Business Sustainability, ESG
briefs.desc: As an introductory course of corporate governance, we will explore contemporary issues pertinent to corporate law and finance. In addition, this course will improve students’ knowledge on traditional corporate governance issues (e.g., corporate fraud; agency conflicts) and discuss the cutting-edge issue of sustainable corporate governance.

briefs.name: 策略性人力資源管理
briefs.tags: human resource management, Strategic
briefs.desc: This is an applied course that examines how modern corporations use human resource management (HRM) to enhance organizational capabilities and achieve strategic objectives. Through the assigned readings, case discussion and various class exercises we will examine how the acquisition, deployment, assessment and retention of an organization’s workforce impacts productivity and firm performance in various contexts. Readings will cover the theory and research on strategic HRM as well as the various parts of a typical HR system. Some of the topics we will discuss include HR planning, recruitment, methods of selection, job design, and implementation of performance management processes. Cases will then be used to focus on specific strategic issues faced by companies including talent management, selecting for cultural fit, incentive pay, and organizational culture. briefs.name: 人工智慧與大數據技術概論
briefs.nameEn: Introduction to AI and Big Data
briefs.teacher: 周志遠,丁川康,許嘉裕,王宏鍇
briefs.tags: 巨量資料(Big Data),公有雲平台做實務,人工智慧概念,演算法,資料處理工具
briefs.desc: ※簡介巨量資料(Big Data)的概念以及資料處理工具(如Hadoop、Spark、NoSQL DB)，並利用公有雲平台做實務的應用操作。 ※介紹人工智慧概念與演算法，輔以應用案例與作業練習。

briefs.name: 大數據與決策分析
briefs.tags: big data, decision analysis, operations research, management science, mathematical programming
briefs.desc: 學習有系統地分析策略決策問題、架構目標、評估方案的預期結果和可能的風險、探討決策方案的執行，並應用數位決策與大數 據分析技術並結合模擬分析，從巨量資訊找出問題，並提出解決方案，透過大數據輔助決策，從問題架構、資料收集、資訊整 理、決策分析乃至決策輔助的完整思維過程，提供系統化、數位化之決策依據與實行策略。除介紹大數據、作業研究與決策分析 方法和工具外，並利用演講、個案討論、上機實做和實證案例研究，培養策略性決策思維及應用資料挖礦解決相關問題，進而提 升大數據分析和數位決策能力。

briefs.name: 工業統計與資料科學
briefs.tags: 實驗設計(Design of Experiments), 田口方法(Taguchi Methods), 信號雜音比(Signal-to-Noise Ratio), 直交表(Orthogonal Arrays), 資料科學(Data Science), 多變量分析(Multivariable Analysis)
briefs.desc: 本課程簡介工業資料分析常用的統計方法，第一部分的課程介紹實驗設計方法，能有效率地收集資訊，進一步改善品質。第二部 分的課程著重於資料分析，包含重要變數選取與特徵萃取、主成分分析、迴歸分析與分類等。透過這些分析手法，能解析資料的 特性與變數間的關聯性，以進行預測與分類。

briefs.name: 先進製造技術
briefs.tags: Advanced manufacturing technology, 先進製造技術
briefs.desc: This course aims to teach the working principles and applications in advanced manufacturing technology. The course is mainly divided into two parts, thermofluids for advanced manufacturing and industrial laser machining. In the first part of the course, an introduction and review to the physics of thermodynamics, fluid mechanics and heat transfer will be provided to build the background on these subjects. To illustrate their applications in advanced manufacturing technologies, three specific topics encompassing manufacturing systems to manufacturing processes will be discussed: optimal design of semiconductor manufacturing systems, active thermal management for high precision machining center, and low temperature laser microfabrication processes. In the second part of the course, the course will start from introducing miscellaneous applications of industrial machining with various types of lasers which are different in wavelengths, pulse duration, and pulse

briefs.name: 跨領域研究方法
briefs.tags: 研究方法, 跨領域合作, 研究設計, 研究溝通, 研究成果展示, Research Methods, Cross-disciplinary Collaboration, Research Design, Research Communication, Research Presentation
briefs.desc: 本課程旨在引導學生掌握進行跨領域研究所需的核心方法與學術寫作能力，涵蓋從研究設計、資料蒐集到成果撰寫的完整研究流程，並透過 實作經驗逐步深化理解與應用。學生將學習如何依據具體問題與情境背景，選擇與整合適切的研究策略，提出具備實證基礎的創新解方。課 程前半段聚焦於研究設計與方法論建構，內容涵蓋研究問題的界定、資料蒐集與分析策略、跨領域合作的實務挑戰，以及研究倫理與學術責 任。透過案例分析與小組討論，學生將培養實務敏感度，並強化與異質專業背景研究者協作的能力。後半段則專注於科技論文撰寫技巧，依 序涵蓋文獻綜述撰寫、研究方法與結果呈現、討論與結論發展，進一步延伸至標題設計與摘要撰寫。課程將寫作視為研究思維發展與深化的 關鍵歷程，透過書寫的過程，學生將學習如何釐清問題意識、反思研究決策、修正論述方向，進而強化其跨領域整合與溝通能力。學生將透 過漸進式的寫作演練與回饋修正，有系統地提升論文的結構邏輯、語言表達與學術溝通力，最終能完整表達其研究成果，並與相關領域進行 有效交流。

briefs.name: 智慧型製造系統
briefs.tags: 製造系統 Manufacturing system, 排程系統scheduling system, 萬用啟發式演算法metaheuristic algorithm, 庫存管理 Inventory Management, 供應鏈管理 Supply Chain Management
briefs.desc: 本課程將使學生了解如何應用人工智慧與數據科學的技術，改善製造系統的作業效率。包含工廠產能規劃、存貨與供應鏈管理、 排程系統、啟發式演算法、賽局理論、決策分析、系統模擬、人工智慧模型如關聯規則、決策樹、集群分析、集成方法等，透過 閱讀研究文獻深入瞭解方法與實際問題解決的落差與連結，課程結合資訊與工程領域的相關知識，並藉由演算法的設計及統計的 方法有系統地建模以解決實務問題。

briefs.name: 財經個案研究
briefs.tags: 市場假說,因子模式,股票評價, 事件研究法, 行為財務學,資本預算,投資與併購
briefs.desc: 針對企業個案進行分析討論，協助同學了解企業個案分析之方法。 進行方式,模擬練習、評論與企業個案分析。學生有機會深入研究實際企業個案，應用經濟學工具進行深度分析，了解商業決 策的複雜性。 透過對實例的討論，學生將學會如何從經濟學角度全面評估企業策略。 這門課程旨在培養學生在實際商業環 境中運用經濟學原理進行深度分析的能力，使他們能夠更全面、更深入地理解並應對現代企業面臨的各種挑戰。 以資本預算、投資與購併、企業價值評估與公司治理三個範疇，思考如何創造公司價值並顧及利害關係人的權益。本課程將以 課堂討?809;及個案教學方式，幫助學生將財務決策觀?907;導入於實際企業經營中，達到學以致用，提升自身價值與企業價值。包含 三部分： 一、回顧與建立財管知識，並運用這些知識進行公司理財決策。（投資決策、融資決策與股利決策） 二、運用財管與公司理財的知識，分析解讀財務個案。 三、提升計算能力，解決財務問題。計算IRR、NPV、Beta與進行資本預算等。上課方式先導讀個案，介紹財務觀念與解決方 法，最後討論個案與制訂決策。

briefs.name: 領導力
briefs.tags: Leadership, Coaching, Ethics, Motivation, Culture
briefs.desc: 本課程介紹領導力相關的理論和應用，旨在幫助學生透過學習與課堂實作培養技能和知識，能夠： R26; 了解個人領導因素（動機、特質、技能、風格）和組織因素（策略、挑戰、機會等）與績效的關係。 R26; 在不同的領導情況下應用批判性思維技能和道德判斷。 R26; 將不同的領導理論和理念應用於不同世代、不同文化的領導者。 R26; 評估在不同情況下，不同領導行為的有效性。 R26; 確定優勢、發展需求和發展計劃來塑造個人領導品牌。

briefs.tags: 論文, Thesis
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 高科技產業分析
briefs.tags: 高科技產業,high-tech industries,技術創新,technological innovation,半導體,semiconductor industry,生物科技產業,bio-tech industry,人工智慧,AI
briefs.desc: 許多研究都指出技術已經成為國家創造財富以及企業營造競爭優勢的主要來源。在此同時，技術也變得愈來愈複雜、不確定、以及 昂貴。面對快速的技術變革，為了在日益國際化的市場下生存及競爭，如何以主動及整合的方式來管理技術變成為企業的當務之 急。本課程即針對科技產業的管理，結合理論概念及實務案例，提供一個完整的介紹，包括巨觀層次(產業及政策)及微觀層次(技 術及企業)。同時，也會針對半導體、資通訊產業、生物技術產業、以及AI等新興科技產業加以著墨。

briefs.name: 研究方法
briefs.tags: 量化分析, 敘述統計，相關係數，假設檢定，ANOVA分析,迴歸分析
briefs.desc: 課程主要在訓練同學如何寫好MBA及EMBA學位論文，在學位論文中的研究方 法。研究方法大致分為質性分析及量化分析。介紹量 化分析用統計方法或迴歸分析，主要是探討相關性及因果關係。

briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 神經網路和學習系統
briefs.tags: neural network; artificial intelligence; dynamic system; liquid state machine; Hopfield model; statistical mechanics
briefs.desc: 本課程旨在給學生對於人工神經網路的理論基礎和應用已經在軟硬體上的實現有概略的介紹，它將討論典型的主題，包括從統計學習理論 (statistical learning theory)的觀點，嚴謹的討論學習的統計基礎，例如神經網絡的訓練(training)和測試(testing)、VC 維度(VC dimension)和模 型複雜性 (model complexity)、正則化(regularization)作為過度擬合(overfitting)的補救措施。此外，我們還想介紹許多特定的神經網絡模型，包 括基於動態系統 以及其他植根於統計物理學或生物學的模型。例如 Hopfield 模型、玻爾茲曼機(Boltzmann machine)、脈衝神經網絡(spiking neural network)， 液態神經網路等等

briefs.name: 微電子工程
briefs.tags: Solid-state devices (固態元件), Silicon processing technology (矽製程技術), VLSI (超大型積體電路), Etching (蝕刻), Thin film deposition (薄膜沉積), Lithography (微影)
briefs.desc: This course aims to introduce the advancement and detailed investigations of the fundamental principles used in the design and fabrication processes of silicon-based electronics for solid- state devices, integrated circuits, and beyond. The audience will gain a solid understanding of vital techniques such as lithography, film deposition, wet etching, anisotropic dry etching, crystal growth, ion implantation, and chemical vapor deposition of metals and insulators. In addition, this course offers valuable insights into modern electronics and provides comprehensive training in FinFET design and CMOS logic layout leveraging TCAD/EDA tools, equipping you with the knowledge to take this semiconductor journey moving forward. (Recommended preliminary knowledge: "Semiconductor and Device Physics" and "Solid-State Physics")

briefs.name: 積體電路元件
briefs.tags: Semiconductor Device, Electron, Hole, PN, BJT, MOSFET
briefs.desc: This course aims to provide entry level graduate students with basic knowledge and training in the field of semiconductor devices that are mostly used in integrated circuits. The course content covers basic semiconductor physics, PN junctions, bipolar junction transistors, metal-oxide- semiconductor field effect transistors, and some advanced devices. The students will learn physics, design principles, and circuit models of these devices.

briefs.name: 微機電系統設計
briefs.tags: 微機電系統、微感測器、微致動器、感測電路、MEMS, microsensors, microactuators, sensing circuits.
briefs.desc: The promise of better performance, lower cost, and miniaturization of sensor and actuator systems has motivated growth in the field of MicroElectroMechanical Systems (MEMS). MEMS technology has found broad applications in inertial sensing, data storage, micromanipulation, optical communication, biochemical analysis, and microfluidic systems. This course will initially focus on fundamental MEMS topics, including microfabrication, micromechanical/bio/chemical sensors, and actuators. Additionally, I will introduce concepts in mechanics of materials, structural dynamics, and noise, all of which are crucial for understanding and implementing micromechanical sensors. More advanced subjects, such as MEMS system-level design methodology and MEMS control, may be introduced towards the end of the semester.

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: Seminar, STEM, Electronics, Semiconductor, AI, Technology
briefs.desc: This seminar is designed for the graduate students with STEM majors. Most of speakers are invited from the experts of important industrial companies and research institutes. Deep bilateral exchange and discussion is encouraged in and after the professional speech.

briefs.name: 半導體微波元件
briefs.tags: MMIC, Microwave, S Parameters, Devices, Active Devices
briefs.desc: This course introduces the properties of the semiconductor devices used in microwave circuits. Both active devices and passive devices are addressed. The concept and language used in microwave circuit analysis will be introduced. The equivalent circuit models of the devices for circuit design will also be discussed.

briefs.name: 半導體記憶體
briefs.tags: Semiconductor, VLSI, Memory, Flash, DRAM, SRAM
briefs.desc: This course provides an in-depth study of semiconductor memory technologies and VLSI memory cell design. Through lectures, homework assignments, and design-oriented projects, students will learn the operating principles, cell structures, fabrication processes, layout considerations, and integration technologies of major semiconductor memories, including DRAM, SRAM, and Flash memory. The course emphasizes both device-level and circuit-level understanding of memory cells and arrays. Topics include charge-storage mechanisms, read/write operations, cell layout, process integration, sense- amplifier concepts, memory architecture, and reliability considerations. Students may also practice cell design, simulation, characterization, and optimization using TCAD or SPICE based approaches.

briefs.name: 半導體雷射
briefs.tags: Laser Diode, Light-Emitting Diode, Semiconductor Device Processing
briefs.desc: 本課程授課內容從半導體物理到發光機制，發光二極體到半導體雷射，都將有極為詳細的介紹。前三者約需7週的上課時間，半 導體雷射也需可以7週的上課時間。本課程將有一次期中及一次期末考，期間也會有作業。半導體雷射則含括基本的寬面積、氧 化層條狀、脊狀型的增益型雷射，以及掩埋型、橫接面、表面發光雷射，我們將從原理機制、製作技術、介紹到雷射的特性及應 用。

briefs.tags: 化學，原子科學，分子科學，系統工程，能源科技，奈米科技; Chemistry, Atomic Science, Molecular Science, System Engineering, Energy Technology, Nanotechnology
briefs.desc: 本課程介紹關鍵化學原理，以利學生奠定未來在工程系統領域中深入修習與整合材料、熱流、物理及電子系統科技所需之跨領域 化學知識。

briefs.name: 工程圖學
briefs.tags: 工程圖學 Engineering Graphics、電腦輔助設計 Computer-Aided Design、三維建模 3D Modeling、工程製圖 Engineering Drawing、PTC Creo、機械設計 Mechanical Design
briefs.desc: 本課程介紹「工程圖學（Engineering Graphics）」之基本理論與實務應用，培養學生工程圖識讀、製圖及空間思考能力。內 容涵蓋製圖基本規範、投影原理、視圖、剖視圖、尺寸標註、公差與配合、零件圖及組合圖等。課程搭配「PTC Creo」電腦輔 助設計軟體進行實作，學習草繪、三維零件建模、組立及工程圖建立，使學生能將工程圖學理論與數位建模相互結合，建立機械 設計、產品開發及後續專業課程所需之基礎工程能力。

briefs.name: 核工原理
briefs.tags: Atomic and Nuclear Physics, Interaction of Radiation with Matter, Nuclear Reactors and Nuclear Power, Neutron Diffusion and Moderation, Nuclear Reactor Theory, The Time-Dependent Reactor
briefs.desc: With this class you start a systematic sequence of courses that are going to present subjects which distinguish a nuclear engineer from other engineering fields. On a simple minded level, the differences between the various engineering disciplines can be readily described. Thus, as you know, chemical engineers deal with chemical process, electrical engineers with electricity, civil engineers with structures and so on. In this simple classification scheme, the domain of nuclear engineers encompasses neutrons, nuclear reactors and radiation processes. However, reality is in fact quite a bit more complicated. You will find that a nuclear engineer you will have to learn not just about neutron interactions with matter, but also about hear transfer, fluid flow, chemical processes and even a little about metrologhy. In practice, the differences between the engineering disciplines turn out to be differences of emphasis rather than substance.

briefs.name: 程式語言
briefs.tags: 電腦(Computer)、程式(Programming)、計算(Computation)、邏輯(Logic)、解題方案(Algorithm)
briefs.desc: 學習「程式語言」的主要目的在於如何利用這個功能強大且具有彈性的工具來協助你解決問題，特別是一些重複性高或牽涉複雜計算的工作。我們可以利用程式語言來控制電腦的運作，達到自動化的處理以大幅增加工作效率，這也是本課程的目標。了解電腦工作的原理與如何建立有效的演算法/解題方案(Algorithm)是程式設計最重要的核心，打好基礎以利未來持續自我學習相關的新技術。

briefs.name: 工程數學一
briefs.tags: ODE, Power Series, Laplace transform
briefs.desc: This is a mandatory mathematics course for students of the second year of study in the ESS department.The topics of this course include: (1) Ordinary differential equations: 1st order ODEs, 2nd order ODEs, higher order ODEs, and systems of ODEs. (2) Special functions and power series method. (3) Laplace transform.

briefs.name: 工程數學一
briefs.tags: Engineering, Mathematics, Ordinary Differential Equations, the Laplace transform, 工程, 數學, 常微分方程
briefs.desc: Engineering Mathematics I covers computations and applications of ODEs and the Laplace transform.

briefs.name: 電路學
briefs.tags: 電路分析, 一階電路, 二階電路, 穩態分析, 頻率響應, circuit analysis, 1st order circuit, 2nd order circuit, steady-state analysis, frequency response
briefs.desc: This is an introductory course in circuit analysis for undergraduate students. The course aims to develop a fundamental understanding of the analytical techniques used to analyze and predict circuit behavior.

briefs.name: 電子學一
briefs.tags: Operational Amplifier, Diode, MOSFETs and BJTs
briefs.desc: The objective of this course is to develop in the students the ability to analyze and design electronic circuits, both analog and digital, discrete and integrated.

briefs.name: 電子學實驗一
briefs.tags: Operational Amplifier, Diode, MOSFETs and BJTs
briefs.desc: In this course, you will learn about the basic principles of circuit operation in a practical, real-world laboratory setting. You will work both with discrete components such as resistors, capacitors, diodes, and transistors as well as with integrated components such as operational amplifiers. In addition, you will become familiar with the operation of basic electronic test equipment (oscilloscopes, function generators, curve tracers, etc.). In addition, you will further understand the characteristics of transistors through the semiconductor analyzer which is very important for device development. There are 12 experiments this semester. Each class will be proceeded by 1-hour principle introduction (at 13:30 in R304) followed by practical experiment.

briefs.name: 電子學實驗一
briefs.tags: Operational Amplifier, Diode, MOSFETs and BJTs
briefs.desc: In this course, you will learn about the basic principles of circuit operation in a practical, real-world laboratory setting. You will work both with discrete components such as resistors, capacitors, diodes, and transistors as well as with integrated components such as operational amplifiers. In addition, you will become familiar with the operation of basic electronic test equipment (oscilloscopes, function generators, curve tracers, etc.). In addition, you will further understand the characteristics of transistors through the semiconductor analyzer which is very important for device development. There are 12 experiments this semester. Each class will be proceeded by 1-hour principle introduction (at 13:30 in R304) followed by practical experiment.

briefs.name: 電磁學二
briefs.tags: electrodynamics, electromagnetic waves, potential and fields, radiations
briefs.desc: 本課程是電磁學一的後續課程，強調電磁學基本原理及在物理、電機、工程領域的運用。

briefs.name: 熱力學
briefs.tags: Energy system, efficiency, heat, work, cycles
briefs.desc: The objectives of this course are to (1) provide fundamental background of mass conservation , the first and second laws of thermodynamics, and the engineering approach to problem solving, and (2) to develop analytic ability in real-world engineering applications using work and heat transfer.

briefs.name: 熱力學
briefs.tags: thermodynamics, 熱力學
briefs.desc: 熱力學為探討能量的入門科目，探討熱與功之間的轉換. 本科目的重點在於介紹能量的觀念, 說明熱力學第零,第一,第二,第三定律與其應 用; 如何決定物質的狀態(state) 以及所具有的能量, 用於熱力學第一與第二定律的分析; 以及推導Thermodynamic Relations,以 及如何利用 Thermodynamic Relation 決定物質的 Property.並會介紹如何應用熱力學定理分析常見循環。

briefs.name: 材料科學導論二
briefs.tags: 金屬材料, 陶瓷材料, 高分子材料, 光電磁熱性質; metals, Ceramic, Polymer, Properties of electrical, thermal, magnetic, and optical materials
briefs.desc: 工程材料性質簡介、本課程著重於基礎材料科學觀念之建立與工程材料原理之定性描述、金屬材料、陶瓷材料、高分子材料、光 電磁熱性質

briefs.name: 偏微與複變
briefs.nameEn: Partial Differential Equations and Complex Analysis
briefs.tags: Partial Differential Equations, Separation of Variables, Eigenfunction Expansion, Complex Variables, Cauchy’s Integral Theorem, Residue Theorem.
briefs.desc: This course is structured into two primary sections. Part A focuses on Partial Differential Equations (PDEs), emphasizing methods for solving equations frequently encountered in engineering and physics, including the wave equation, diffusion equation, and Laplace equation. Part B delves into Complex Analysis, offering a comprehensive understanding of analytic functions, differentiation, contour integrals, and other critical topics essential for various applications in engineering and physics.

briefs.name: 數值分析一
briefs.tags: Solutions of Equations of One Variable, Interpolation and Polynomial Approximation, Numerical Integration and Differentiation, Numerical Solution of Initial-Value Problems; Numerical Solution of Boundary-Value Problems, Direct Methods for Solving Linear Systems, Indirect Methods for Solving Linear Systems, Approximation Theory
briefs.desc: 該課程的設計，乃旨於訓練學生利用數值方法來解決工程問題的能力，以助益於其在進入職場或繼續深造時，更上層樓的使用與 發揮。特別的是，該課程係源於學生本身擁有的微積分、工程數學、以及程式語言等基礎上，再進階而成。深具按部就班、平穩 學習、步步高升的特色。是工程專業的學生，不可或缺的基本課程。本課程無涉及AI使用。

briefs.name: 數值分析一
briefs.tags: 單變數方程解Solutions of Equations of One Variable, 內差與多項式近似Interpolation and Polynomial Approximation, 數值積分與微分Numerical Integration and Differentiation, 初值問題的數值解Numerical Solution of Initial-Value Problems; 邊值問題的數值解Numerical Solution of Boundary-Value Problems, 線性系統求解的直接方法Direct Methods for Solving Linear Systems, 線性系統求解的間接方法Indirect Method
briefs.desc: 本課授課內容針對具工程背景與具有微積分、工程數學以及基本程式語言基礎的大學部高年學生。學生可經由本課程學習 利用數值方法解決工程問題之能力同時認識本系多領域整合應用的獨特性，對於未來從事進階研究或是進入職場頗有裨 益，是值得工程專業的學生深入學習的基礎課程。

briefs.tags: CMOS Digital Circuits, CMOS數位電路, Memory Circuits, 記憶體電路, Oscillator Circuits, 振盪電路
briefs.desc: This course introduces the fundamental principles and analysis of CMOS electronic circuits, including digital circuits, memory circuits, output stages, power amplifiers, and oscillator circuits.

briefs.desc: This is the first course of a two-semester sequence treating metallurgical phenomena and their utilization in engineering materials and processes. The contents in the first semester are mainly focused on the fundamentals of materials science, including (1) crystal structure, (2) defects in crystals, (3) diffusion in solid solutions, (4) phase diagrams, and (5) plastic deformation.

briefs.name: 書報討論一
briefs.tags: 文獻搜尋，溝通技巧，專題報告，公開討論，專業互動；Literature Search, Communication Skill, Topical Presentation, Open Discussion, Professional Interaction

briefs.name: 輻射安全
briefs.tags: 輻射(Radiation)、核反應(Nuclear Reaction)、輻射劑量(Radiation Dose)、防護與屏蔽(Protection and Shielding)
briefs.desc: 游離輻射在現代社會有各式各樣不可或缺的應用，使我們不知不覺間享受多種輻射應用所帶來的好處，包括核能發電、醫學診斷與放射治 療、機場安全檢查、工業非破壞性檢測、農產品照射滅菌、考古與探礦的應用等等。另外，輻射更是現代科學探測不可或缺的利器。輻射與 今日人類社會的運作息息相關且不可避免，我們生活環境中亦存在著各種天然輻射於空氣、土壤、建築物、水與食物中，因此值得正確地認 識輻射的特性，了解輻射與物質的作用，以利充分發揮輻射的應用、防止輻射可能引發的傷害、並減少社會大眾對於輻射的誤解。

briefs.tags: Nuclear Power System, Rankine Cycle, Reactor Engineering, Reactor Safety, Boiling Water Reactors, Pressurized Water Reactors
