briefs.name: 核電廠儀控系統之理論與實務
briefs.nameEn: Nuclear Power Plant Instrumentation and Control Systems: Theory and Practice
briefs.tags: Nuclear Power Plants,核電廠,Digital Instrumentation and Control Systems,儀控系統,核反應動力學
briefs.desc: 本課程旨在引導學生了解核電廠儀控系統、常見感測器之原理、控制器控制基礎、驅動器運作。課程將從日常生活中簡易的控制概念切入， 逐步引導至複雜的核電廠儀控系統及專家系統。內容涵蓋類比控制與數位控制技術、人機介面與警報系統、人因工程、核反應動力學與控制 要素，並從核二廠模擬器及全迴路控制系統的現場參訪，讓學生獲得儀控系統之具體瞭解。

briefs.name: 積體電路設計導論
briefs.tags: IC Design, Digital Circuit, Analog Circuit, Circuit Simulation, Circuit Layout 積體電路設計、數位電路、類比電路、電路模擬、電路布局。
briefs.desc: 本課程為積體電路設計之入門課，學習積體電路設計之基本概念及如何使用電腦輔助設計軟體，包括簡單的數位與類比積體電 路設計，由製程、元件、模擬、佈局、至一個完整電路與系統之設計，每位學生必須完成一個完整電路之設計、模擬與佈局。

briefs.name: 量子力學導論
briefs.tags: 半導體，薛丁格方程式，量子力學應用，波粒二象性，原子模型
briefs.desc: 自半導體元件發明，量子力學之應用充斥在我們的生活。近幾年來，由於奈米科技快速發展，物質奈米微小 化，更顯出量子力學常識之重要。藉由此門課,了解量子物理如何成功闡述古典物理無法解釋之現象，如：普朗克常 數、光電效應、電磁輻射之粒子性、物質的粒子性、物質之波性、海森堡測不準原理、薛丁格方程式、原子結構等。

briefs.name: 太陽能電池原理
briefs.tags: 太陽能電池；能源工程；再生能源；綠色能源；光電科學；Solar Cell; Energy Engineering; Renewable Energy; Green Energy; Photoelectronic Science
briefs.desc: 適合大學部三四年級學生與碩士班了解太陽能電池領域的基礎理論課程 授課內容 1. 緒論 2. 光電與半導體物理 3. 太陽能 轉換發電原理 4. 太陽能電池的基本結構 5. 太陽能電池的轉換效率 6. 提昇太陽能電池效率的方法 7. 前瞻太陽能電池簡介 教學進度

briefs.name: 腐蝕工程
briefs.tags: 電化學, 電極, 鈍化, 陰極防蝕, 被覆, Electrochemistry, Electrode, Passivity, Cathodic Protection, Coating
briefs.desc: 本課程涵蓋腐蝕工程中有關腐蝕的類型、基本電化學原理與電極電位、腐蝕動力學、鈍化現象、腐蝕量測技術、陰極防 蝕、被覆與抑制劑防蝕、環境與防蝕、材料選擇與設計等主題，自淺而深提供學生腐與腐蝕防制工程技術的基礎知識、進 階理論與應用領域，使學生具備完整的腐蝕工程知識，並能於未來的進修或工作中加以應用。

briefs.name: 薄膜工程導論
briefs.tags: 真空技術(vacuum technology),表面動力學(surface kinetics),物理氣相沉積(physical vapor deposition),化學氣相沉積(chemical vapor deposition),薄膜成長機制與結構分析(thin film formation mechanism and structure characterization)
briefs.desc: This course firstly introduces vacuum technology and kinetics of surface processes. The major content includes the vapor deposition processes, PVD and CVD, and film formation and structure. The methods of characterization of thin film will be briefly introduced. To take this course, students are required to have some background on Materials Science (ESS2500 Introduction to Materials Science or ESS 3510 and 3520 Physical metallurgy I,II) and on Thermodynamics of Materials (ESS2510 or equivalent).

briefs.name: 電化學原理
briefs.tags: 電化學理論、熱力學、動力學、電解質行為、電極反應、綠能、半導體應用
briefs.desc: 本課程介紹電化學的基礎理論、熱力學、動力學、電解質行為、電極反應等，並進一步結合能源與半導體應用案例，讓學生能將 電化學原理應用於能源與先進製程。

briefs.name: 太陽光電創意專題實作
briefs.nameEn: Solar Cell Laboratory and Project Study
briefs.tags: Semiconductor process, ultra-large-scale-integration (ULSI), CMOS devices, nanoelectronic, FinFET, GAAFET
briefs.desc: The advances in ultra-large-scale-integration (ULSI) technology course based on aggressive scaling of CMOS devices provide enormous opportunities for high-performance communication, and computing Systems. This course is designed to provide the current status of advanced ULSI technology process and CMOS integration projecting a road map for nanoelectronic devices for the current and next generation.

briefs.name: 真空技術
briefs.tags: 真空,真空計,幫浦,測漏,真空封合,濺鍍,蒸鍍
briefs.desc: 真空技術是現代科技的基石，本課程主要探討真空技術的理論及真空元組件等，內容包括真空技術的基礎理論、各式真空 幫浦的介紹、各類真空元件及材料、真空系統的設計組裝、真空測漏，以及真空度量與檢校。從民生相關的食品包裝、眼 鏡鍍膜、電視映像管，到高科技產業中的光電元件與半導體製程、尖端的材料分析儀器，甚至龐大的同步輻射加速器，真 空技術都扮演著重要的核心角色。沒有真空技術就無法享受高品質的現代生活，也不足以從事高科技的研究。真空技術的 進步，不僅可精進儀器設備的性能，並能提升各種產業製程效能及產率，進而實現許多技術的創新。

briefs.name: 奈微機電系統整合與實作專題
briefs.nameEn: Special Topic on Nano and Micro Systems Integration and Implementation
briefs.tags: 奈米科技(nanotechnology), 微系統(micro systems), 系統整合(system integration), 機電系統(electromechanical systems), 工程實作(engineering implementation)
briefs.desc: 本課程旨在介紹奈微米機電系統整合的基本原理與關鍵技術，並以工程應用為例說明跨領域整合與未來發展趨勢，同時透 過實作專題培養學生的專業實務能力。

briefs.name: 工程系統專題研究一
briefs.nameEn: Independent Study in Engineering & System Science I
briefs.tags: 專題研究
briefs.desc: 由學生與指導教授共同擬定研究課題，進行專題研究，讓學生獲得解決實際工程問題之訓練。

briefs.name: 工程系統專題研究二
briefs.nameEn: Independent Study in Engineering & System Science II
briefs.tags: 專題研究
briefs.desc: 由學生與指導教授共同擬定研究課題，進行專題研究，讓學生獲得解決實際工程問題之訓練。

briefs.name: 專題演講
briefs.tags: 學術演講,經驗分享,Seminar Talks, Experience Sharing
briefs.desc: 本課程將邀請電子、材料、機械、物理、能源工程、生物醫學、核子工程等相關領域的專家學者，於每周進行專題演講，並與參 與課程之碩博士研究生座談。 This course will invite experts from different fields, including but not limited to electrical engineering, materials science, mechanical engineering, physics, energy engineering, biomedical, nuclear engineering, to give seminar talks and experience sharing with enrolled graduate students on a weekly basis.

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: 文獻搜尋，溝通技巧，專題報告，公開討論，專業互動；Literature Search, Communication Skill, Topical Presentation, Open Discussion, Professional Interaction
briefs.desc: This course is designed to provide students with opportunity to practice their professional presentation skill, particularly in the scientific and technical areas. The students are expected to give a presentation on the topic related to their research.

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: Microfluidics Systems, BioMEMS, Bio sensors, Cell Chips, Hydrogen Energy, Fuel cells
briefs.desc: 由奈微米系統工程組參與學生輪流選擇2-3篇與奈微米系統工程相關之國際期刊或會議論文做口頭報告。原則上一學期輪到一 次。

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: Thesis writing, Oral presentation, Critical thinking, 論文撰寫, 口頭報告, 邏輯分析
briefs.desc: 培養學生閱讀英文期刊論文能力以及統整與分析數據能力。課堂中亦會讓學生有充足機會練習論文撰寫與口頭報告。

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: 文獻搜尋、學術閱讀、批判思考、論文撰寫、口頭報告; Literature Search, Academic Reading, Critical Thinking, Thesis Writing, Oral Presentation
briefs.desc: This course is designed to develop students' academic research and professional communication skills through literature searching, academic reading, oral presentations, written reports, and open discussions.

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: 系統分析, 元件製程, 電路設計, system analysis, device fabrication, circuit design
briefs.desc: 書報討論課程。與本組研究相關的各類文獻閱讀、整理與討論。研究進度報告。

briefs.name: 微電子工程
briefs.tags: Semiconductor process, ultra-large-scale-integration (ULSI), CMOS devices, nanoelectronic, FinFET, GAAFET
briefs.desc: The advances in ultra-large-scale-integration (ULSI) technology course based on aggressive scaling of CMOS devices provide enormous opportunities for high-performance communication, and computing Systems. This course is designed to provide the current status of advanced ULSI technology process and CMOS integration projecting a road map for nanoelectronic devices for the current and next generation.

briefs.name: 半導體元件設計與模擬
briefs.tags: 半導體元件設計與模擬 ; MOSFET & FinFET 電場，電位，電子濃度分佈等；以及電學特性如：電流，電壓，臨界電壓，操作頻率，反向器
briefs.desc: 教授半導體元件設計製程整合與電性及模擬，可以用來預測半導體元件 N16到 N1 的物理特性如：FinFET 電場，電位，電 子濃度分 佈等；以及電學特性如：電流，電壓，臨界電壓，操作頻率，反向器 (inverter)，靜態隨機讀取記憶體(SRAM)等。藉由設計不同結構的半導體元件，分析了解各個半 導體製程與元件的參數對元件特性的影響，並分析其優缺點，如短通道效應，臨界電壓，次臨界 斜率，飽和電流等等。本課程的目的在於使學員了解半導體元件的設計與模擬，擁有使用先進半 導體元件設的基礎理論知識，並結合軟體輔助設計半導體元件的能力，進而能夠模擬分析所設計 的半導體元件的電性特性。本課程主要著重在Silicon CMOS電性模擬，接著是設計2D以及3D的 Silicon CMOS FinFET, , GAAFET, JLFET, CFET, FeFET, INVERTER, SRAM元件，最後將所設計的CMOS元件， 做電性模擬以及解讀模擬的結果。 此課程所教授的設計與模擬技術，在學術研究半導體產業有重大的實用性，並可增進半導體元件物 理與微電子工程所學內容的實踐性。適合從事半導體奈米元件研究開發的碩博士生修習。

briefs.name: 混合訊號積體電路設計
briefs.tags: 類比電路，邏輯電路，數據轉換器，放大器，差分放大器。Analog Circuit, Logic Circuit, Data converter, Amplifier, Differential Amplifier
briefs.desc: This course deals with the analysis and design of analog/mixed-signal integrated circuits. The objective is to help students developing a solid foundation of analyzing and designing analog/mixed- signal integrated circuits. The students are asked to do homework to analyze circuits. Final project will be assigned to the students so that they can design a whole system circuit by using the analyzing skills. The lecture covers the following topics: fundamental CMOS device physics, device model, amplifier circuits, operational amplifiers, frequency response, stability, and data converter circuits.

briefs.name: 材料分析與檢測
briefs.tags: 材料分析背景知識, X光相關技術, 電子相關技術, 其他光源技術, 產業鏈結
briefs.desc: 介紹常見材料檢測與分析技術(包含一般材料與半導體材料)。藉由介紹量測方法的基本原理與儀器，使同學廣泛了解未來面對不同材料 如何找尋適當的檢測工具。前半學期課程將介紹儀器使用與技術本身深層的數學物理背景，進而認識到儀器的量測限制，提供未來可能 的研究相關檢測知識。後半學期將邀請三大檢測廠商、工研院量測中心、儀器商介紹量測實際案例與儀器發展趨勢。 由於教室空間有限，因應量測知識需要的急迫性，本課程改成研究所學生優先修習。

briefs.name: 材料動力學
briefs.tags: 擴散, 離子擴散, 化學反應, 氧化, 吸附與蒸發, Diffusion, Ionic Diffusion, Chemical Reactions, Oxidation, Adsorption and Evaporation
briefs.desc: This course covers the fundamental knowledge of kinetics in materials science and engineering, focusing on diffusion and chemical reaction.

briefs.name: 同調光及電子繞射顯微術
briefs.nameEn: Coherent X-ray and Electron Diffraction Microscopy
briefs.tags: coherent diffraction imaging/microscopy
briefs.desc: 本課程為專門為本實驗室研究生開設之專業研究課程。著重於光源與繞射現象的了解，並推展到多種光源與其應用。學期成績評量的 方式為：以Matlab撰寫相位回復演算法，將提供之繞射影像進行回復，學期成績之計算公式以回復影像之正確性來決定。非本實驗室 同學請慎重考慮，尤其是研究領域與本課程無關的同學。 This course is a specialized research course designed specifically for graduate students in my laboratory. It focuses on understanding light sources and diffraction phenomena, and further extends to various types of light sources and their applications. The semester grade will be evaluated as follows: students are required to write a phase retrieval algorithm in Matlab to reconstruct the provided diffraction images. The final grade will be determined based on the accuracy of the reconstructed images. Students who are not members of my laboratory should consider carefully before enrolling, especially those whose research fields are not related to this course.

briefs.name: 電子薄膜科技
briefs.tags: 薄膜,擴散,薄膜應力,可靠度,先進封裝
briefs.desc: It is well known that thin films are widely used in the electronic industry. Due to the trend on miniaturization of electronic devices, nanoscale electronic devices are needed and the technology and reliability of thin films have recently attracted increasing attention. This course will focus on the science and process of thin films, and reliability science for thin film application in the electronic industry. The topics will cover: - Fundamental topic in the thin-film process: deposition, surface energy and atomic diffusion - Theoretical and practical understanding of electronic thin-film reliability

briefs.name: 第一原理材料計算
briefs.tags: Ab initio calculations, DFT, electronic structure, quantum mechanics, modelling
briefs.desc: 奈米科技之快速發展促成新材料尺度不斷在縮減，故實驗未必能觀察到所有的微觀現象也未必能詳細了解其反應機制， 故理論計算能幫助解釋實驗數據甚至預測新材料特性，鑒於此，理論計算和實驗結合，是現今研究發展之趨勢，也說明了 理論計算的重要性與必要性。再者7-80%之理論計算採用第一原理（如，密度泛函理論），其應用也相當廣泛，從催化反應 （二氧化碳還原、一氧化碳氧化、水分解、儲氫等）、儲能材料、高熵材料、半導體材料設計等，故此課程為以 第一原理計算為主，重點在密度泛函基本理論與應用，希望學生對基礎相關理論能有概括的認識及了解DFT（VASP）軟體的基 本操作。 In this course, I will introduce the Density Functional Theory (DFT) and how to do first-principles simulations for materials by DFT tool（VASP）. I hope all students can apply DFT tools in their projects after attending this class.

briefs.name: 小角度中子散射
briefs.tags: Small-angle neutron scattering, quantum scattering, scattering length density distribution, microstructural analysis, intra-particle correlation, inter-particle interaction
briefs.desc: This course aims to give students fundamental understanding of small-angle neutron scattering (SANS) based on the applications of wave mechanics, quantum mechanics, and statistical mechanics as well as the microstructural analysis of materials using SANS techniques.

briefs.name: 同步加速器X光吸收光譜分析應用
briefs.nameEn: Applications of Synchrotron X-ray Absorption Spectroscopy
briefs.tags: X光, 原子結構, 奈米材料
briefs.desc: This lecture aims at establishing the student's analytic and practical experiment capabilities for materials science, physical chemistry, environment science, and surface science via the X-ray absorption spectroscopy techniques in advanced level. By learning this lecture, the students are expected to be able to conduct independent research in all kinds of materials sciences especially the structure analysis of nanoscaled energy materials and surface molecular sorption behaviors in ambient environments. 建立學生以X光吸收光譜分析技術對材料科學、物理化學、表面科學等各方面科學領域中的結構分析理論、分析能力與實務 操作。並以此基礎發展其在奈米科學與材料科學領域之獨立研究能力。

briefs.name: 高等微系統製造與實驗
briefs.nameEn: Advanced Micro System Fabrication and Lab
briefs.tags: Microfabrication, MEMS, Semiconductor manufacturing, MEMS lab
briefs.desc: Using micro fabrication technology to fabricate micro sensors, micro structures, and micro actuators. This course teaches 12 fundamental and advance MEMS fabrication techniques, including cleaning procedure, lithography, thermal oxidation, lift off process, e-beam evaporation, reactive ion etching, wet chemical etching, micro electroplating, thick PR lithography, anodic bonding, wafer dicing, wire bonding, and standard process parameter testing techniques. The final goal will use those techniques to fabricate 12 different micro structures, sensors, and actuators, including accelerometer, humidity sensor, temperature sensor, micro mirror, micro cantilever, thermal actuator, flow sensor, micro channel, micro mixer, micro filter, and bulk etching testing structures, etc. Students will be broken into 4 groups, and each group (~5 students) must finish the the fabrication process of 3 wafers. This course is offered in English.

briefs.name: 生化分析與實驗
briefs.nameEn: Bioanalytical Chemistry：Basic Principles and Lab Projects
briefs.tags: Biochemical analysis, Organic Materials, Molecular Engineering, Biochips, Bioconjugate Chemistry, 生化分析，有機材料，分子工程，生物晶片，生物偶合化學
briefs.desc: This course is offered for junior/senior undergraduate students and graduate students with physical science or engineering backgrounds who previously have no extensive exposure to biochemistry. This course consists of lecture series and hands-on experiments. The topics covered in this course. include: (1) Basic Organic Chemistry (2) Biomolecules (3) Modern Bioanalytical Techniques

briefs.name: 微系統設計
briefs.tags: Micro Electrical Mechanical Systems, MEMS Design, Microfabrication, IC Designs, Semiconductor devices
briefs.desc: Scope of the Micro System Design, the current status of Micro System Technology (9/11, Tseng) Brief Review of MEMS technology I - Scaling law (hw#1)(9/18, Tseng) Brief Review of MEMS technology III- lithography and IC process (9/25, Tseng) Brief Review of MEMS technology II- Bulk micromachining (hw#2) (10/2, Tseng) Brief Review of MEMS technology IV- Surface micromachining, and others. (10/16, Yao) Introduction and hand-on practice of MEMS design software-LEIDT (hw#3) (10/23, Wei, final project team formation)

briefs.name: 雙相流與沸騰熱傳
briefs.tags: two-phase flow, boiling heat transfer, boiling curve, CHF, nucleate boiling
briefs.desc: 教授同學雙相流與沸騰熱傳基本知識、流譜特 性、基礎物理模式以及能源方面的應用

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文, Thesis

briefs.name: 語言學概論
briefs.tags: morphology, syntax, phonetics, phonology
briefs.desc: Linguistics is the systematic and scientific inquiry into human language—into its structures and uses. Unlike language courses you have taken before, we will not concentrate on any specific language, but rather examine the general principles that underlie human languages, e.g., how sounds are combined into words; how words are formed and how they are combined into sentences, etc.

briefs.name: 西洋文學概論一
briefs.tags: Greek mythology, Homer
briefs.desc: This course introduces the first-year student of literature to some of the major concepts, themes, as well as some of the most famous narratives, characters, and literary forms of the western literary tradition. The aim of such a course is to provide students the basic tools, concepts, and reading knowledge for more advanced study of western literature in upper-level courses beyond their first year at the university. While such a course does not offer a comprehensive coverage of all the major texts of western literature, it conceptualizes the western literary tradition as a series of debates and issues for discussion. We will analyze the literary texts in their historical, cultural, and political contexts, and we will examine the significance of these texts for the western literary tradition.

briefs.name: 進階英文：閱讀與討論
briefs.tags: English Reading, Speaking, listening skills, impromptu speaking skills
briefs.desc: The aim of this course is to enhance students' critical English reading abilities and develop more formal discussion skills focusing on critical reading of and reference to source materials. In this class, students will read a variety of texts with enhanced fluency following coherent and effective use of reading strategies. Students will also build-up impromptu speaking skills to actively engage in leading a discussion with a critical perspective (e.g., distinguishing between fact and opinion, evaluating sources, and identifying points of view). Discussion skills will be practiced in a variety of formats including whole-class analysis of topical issues, problem-solving group work, or short individual oral presentations.

briefs.name: 進階英文：閱讀與討論
briefs.tags: This course aims to help students to become efficient and competent readers.
briefs.desc: This course aims to help students to become efficient and competent readers. Students will learn how to understand and analyze texts through asking questions, making predictions, drawing inferences, and identifying the main idea. Further, students are expected to read extensively outside of class time.

briefs.name: 進階英文：閱讀與討論
briefs.tags: English, reading, academic Englsih, technology, literature
briefs.desc: This course is to help students get familiar with different genres of reading material, and then get involved with in-depth processing of such reading material by rephrasing, reflecting, responding, and resonating with designated these material. The overall goal is to guide students through integrating language skills, i.e., reading, writing, listening and speaking, to develop their own English proficiency and to promote students' interaction and communication with peers via language competency.

briefs.name: 進階英文：閱讀與討論
briefs.tags: discussion, critical thinking, work analysis, skill implementation, life reflection
briefs.desc: The course is designed to provide a toolkit to develop fundamental skills and mindsets for 21st century success. The purpose of the compiled contents is to equip young adults to transit from the academic setting into the 21st century work field hoping to aim for a smoother transition in the near future. The course seeks to inspire, develop, guide and provide support for life-related issues. Students are required to read articles from major news agencies and professional development websites then come to class for topical discussion and skill-building tasks.

briefs.name: 進階英文：聽講
briefs.tags: This course is designed to develop students’ English listening and speaking competencies.
briefs.desc: This course is designed to develop students’ English listening and speaking competencies. Students will further develop listening skills (e.g. identifying main ideas and details, making inferences, and analyzing what you have heard) through listening to authentic materials related to culture, news, and current events. Students will also develop discussion skills through a variety of interactive activities. By the end of the course, students will learn to: 1. comprehend listening materials which cover more specialized or sophisticated topics, 2. identify and analyze points of view, arguments, or implicit information in the listening material, 3. lead and participate in effective group discussions and deliver oral presentations.

briefs.name: 進階英文：聽講
briefs.tags: 英語聽講, 聽力練習, 時事評論, 口語表達, 英語對話, listening and speaking in English, listening comprehension, news in English, oral presentation, English conversion
briefs.desc: This course is to help students develop oral language proficiency for academic purpose. Materials from authentic sources are chosen to enhance students' listening comprehension as well as critical commentaries and oral expression.

briefs.name: 進階英文：聽講
briefs.tags: Advanced English for Listening and discussion
briefs.desc: This course aims to advance students’ listening and speaking skills. Students will further develop listening skills such as identifying main ideas, details, making inferenced, and notetaking through less simplified and authentic listening materials. Through a variety of listening genres and systematic guidelines, students will build up strategies and critical thinking skills for academic achievement. By the end of the course, students will learn to :1. comprehend authentic listening materials which coverer more specialized and sophisticate topics, 2. Identify and analyze points of view, arguments, or implicit information in the listening materials, 3. Lead and active participate in effective group discussion and deliver oral presentations.

briefs.name: 進階英文：聽講
briefs.tags: 密集輕鬆英語會話, 演講, 討論, 英語求職 . English conversation, public speaking, discussion, job hunting, role play
briefs.desc: This course is similar to the idea of "Teaching English without Teaching English" (TED talk by Dr.Roberto Guzman) with emphasis on critical thinking as well as hands on language development skills. AI usage is allowed only for revision of your homework and needs to be specified. This course will focus on: 1.Enhancing students' speaking competence and confidence through intensive communicative activities. 2.Enabling students to use English for job hunting, public presentation and multi- role play through the modified International Toastmaster Program. 3.Broadening students' horizons and establishing students'critical thinking through international news report. Teaching material: handouts and video clips.

briefs.name: 文學作品讀法一
briefs.tags: literature, analysis, cultural studies, reading comprehension, writing skills
briefs.desc: This course aims to prepare students' ability of comprehension, appreciation and critical thinking on literature works. Students will achieve the goal through study of canonical works, presentation of historical and cultural backgrounds, and most likely their preparation for exams.

briefs.name: 英語聽講一
briefs.tags: English listening, English speaking, everyday conversation, describing people and places, understanding instructions, giving talks, expressing opinions
briefs.desc: This course is designed for first-year students majoring in Foreign Languages and Literature, aiming to strengthen students’ oral-aural skills and enable them to effectively comprehend and communicate ideas in an English-speaking context. Through active participation in class, students are expected to improve their accuracy, fluency, and overall communication skills. The course utilizes diverse listening materials such as sitcom excerpts and TED talks, and incorporates various speaking activities including pair work, oral presentations, and class discussions. Formative assessments such as listening exercises, tests, and assignments will be conducted throughout the semester to ensure continuous improvement and practical application of skills. At the end of the class, students are required to deliver a prepared talk and complete a final exam to demonstrate the progress they have made in listening and speaking English.

briefs.name: 英語聽講一
briefs.tags: English listening/speaking, 英語聽講
briefs.desc: This course aims to improve students’ listening and speaking abilities through participation in class discussion and class activities. The students will get to practice English listening and speaking under different contexts, and they will learn to use English comfortably to communicate their ideas with others. The first semester focuses on using idioms in conversations, impromptu speech, and doing interviews in English (Language exchange project). The second semester focuses on debates and negotiation/promotion in English and producing English videos (Youtuber project).

briefs.name: 閱讀與寫作一(上)
briefs.tags: L2 writing, artificial intelligence, L2 reading, expository writing, self-regulated learning
briefs.desc: This course equips students with the skills needed to write multi-paragraph compositions in academic settings. We will introduce and practice pre-writing techniques along with the fundamentals of essay writing. This will be achieved by involving students in various in-class and post-class activities and assignments. The course will place particular emphasis on planning body paragraphs, crafting compelling introductions and conclusions, making appropriate word choices, and constructing effective sentences. Additionally, the course will incorporate AI into various writing tasks to enhance students' writing development by allowing them to seek and utilize feedback from the AI, ensuring a more informed and refined writing process.

briefs.name: 閱讀與寫作一(上)
briefs.tags: essay, expository writing, academic writing, reading, thesis statement
briefs.desc: This is the first part of a year-long course designed to improve your English reading and writing skills. You will develop your ability to critically engage with assigned texts, participate in class discussions, and produce clear, coherent expository writing. Through a series of assignments, you will learn to explain ideas logically, organize information effectively, and support your points with relevant evidence. This semester, you will: R26; Respond to a variety of reading sources, connecting ideas from texts to your own experiences and knowledge. R26; Write multi-paragraph expository essays using strategies such as exemplification, extended definition, and classification. R26; Provide constructive, supportive feedback on your classmates’ writing. R26; Revise your own work based on feedback from your teacher, peers, and digital tools. R26; Interact with AI chatbots to support your writing process. You will be expected to critically evaluate the fe

briefs.name: 閱讀與寫作一(上)
briefs.tags: Course keywords: reading, writing
briefs.desc: This 16-week course is designed to develop students’ writing skills through the study of narrative craft, rhetorical techniques, and reflective writing. Students will read and analyze three texts— "The Strength in Our Scars" by Bianca Sparacino, "A Man Called Ove" by Fredrik Backman, and "The Cat Who Went to Heaven" by Elizabeth Coatsworth—to explore storytelling, emotional resonance, and persuasive techniques. The course emphasizes the writing process, as outlined by Purdue OWL’s Writing Process resources, with a focus on prewriting, drafting, revising, and editing. Through discussions, writing assignments, workshops, and a culminating term paper, students will refine their ability to craft compelling narratives and arguments.

briefs.name: 初級日語一
briefs.desc: 1. 教學目標：培養日語零基礎的學生具備日語基礎溝通與表達能力。透過討論、聽力練習與會話演練來培養溝通簡單的日語表 達能力。提升至日 語 JLPT N5實力。 2. 指定教科書：上學期與下學期《大家的日本語 初級I 改訂版》台北：大新書局 3. 教學進度：上學期為日語基礎發音、假名習字與《大家的日本語初級 I 改訂版》第1-5課。下學期為同一本課本的第6-12課。 4. 課程說明：本課程主要以日語零基礎學生為學習對象。 (1) 上學期是學習日語發音與日語平假名、片假名的書寫方式，並 學習核心詞彙、簡單日語會話與名詞、動詞基礎句型等。以期運用在自我介紹、 購物點 餐、介紹時間地點事物等簡單溝通能 力（五十音教學進度較快，建議在課外勤加練習）。下學期是著重在動詞、形容詞等詞尾變化與相關句型， 以期運用在表達個 人情感、動作授受表現、數量唸法等，達到適時適所的日語溝通能力並且了解日本文化。 (2) 利用書籍或網路視聽教材，輔 以平時作業來培養寫作與閱讀能力。課程中適時加入相關句型的日語會話、日語歌曲或新聞日文以期有效應用本 學期的學習內 容。 5. 成績考核：期中考（40%）、期末考（30%）、作業（10%）、小考（10%）、出席（10%） 備註：教學方法?入門初級日語

briefs.name: 初級日語一
briefs.tags: 初級日文一:本課程90%之內容為基礎語學訓練(包括發音技巧,文法解說與聽力應用……等) 餘10%之部份則為穿插於語學課程間的文化導引(包含日劇放映,日文情歌教唱,日本情勢民俗介紹…….等 )
briefs.desc: 課程目標: 1期讓學員在習得基礎語學之同時,能拓寬國際視野,培養包容異文化之胸襟。 2幫助學員日後赴日洽商修習或與日人共事時,能因掌握日語之措辭技巧與日人之行動邏輯,而知己知彼,創造全勝. 3從五十音起教授基礎日語之文法、語彙、句型、聽力等語學課程。課程內容主要著重於訓練學員之口說發展與聽解能 力。課中並以文化面穿插切入， 依教材內容穿插講授日本之氣候風土、文化民俗、語彙源流、史地國情…等，期讓學員能深刻感受，擁有外語才能，即如 握擁開啟世界視窗之鑰。 範圍: 150音(平假名與片假名教寫) 2大家的日本語(初級一)之L1~L5(P1~P79) 3補充教材如日語重音符號判讀.姓氏讀法.字源由來.以及相關實物圖片錄影帶……等 4數首現代經典日文情歌

briefs.name: 英語口語訓練一
briefs.tags: Presentation, 簡報, public speaking 公開演說, delivery techniques 表達技巧, structure 結構, presentation slides 簡報投影片
briefs.desc: The course aims to polish students’ delivery skills for public speaking and train students to master techniques for crafting and delivering compelling and impactful presentations. Students will learn how to speak in a memorable way, present with confidence, and use body language. Through assignments and classroom activities, students will practice shadowing, delivery techniques for voice, movement, and gesture that engage audiences, responding to questions, and creating expressive and descriptive qualities in their words.

briefs.name: 英語口語訓練一
briefs.tags: 新聞；政治；科學；文化；社會 news; politics; science; culture; society
briefs.desc: This course is designed to strengthen students’ English oral skills through critical thinking, media engagement, and academic expression. Students will develop fluency, pronunciation, confidence through in-depth discussions, multimedia materials, presentations, and collaborative projects. AI usage is permitted only during your mid-term and final exams. The course is divided into three units: Unit 1: (General Conversation Class): International news segments and advertisements are supplemented with video materials used for various interactive tasks — such as group discussions, public debates, and panel panels—to help broaden students’ perspectives. Unit 2: (Acedemic expression): Through reporters of VOA News. Discussion and analysis of news, social media, podcasts, interviews, and popular culture Unit 3: (Creative Ideas & Performance): Training in production of creative spoken and written content in English.

briefs.tags: artificial intelligence, embodiment, digital culture, ethics, subjectivity, care
briefs.desc: This course introduces students to the study of the novel, with particular emphasis on works that engage questions of artificial intelligence, digital culture, and embodiment. Through close reading and critical analysis, students will explore the literary, historical, cultural, and political dimensions of fiction while examining how narrative responds to and reshapes contemporary technological realities. The course situates the novel within broader debates about the nature of intelligence, creativity, and subjectivity in the age of computation. While dominant models of artificial intelligence often prioritize abstraction, quantification, and disembodied reasoning, the texts we study foreground the roles of embodiment, affect, and intuition. Fiction serves as a key medium for investigating these tensions, offering nuanced representations of how intelligence is shaped by sensory experience, emotion, and ethical context. briefs.name: 聖經與文學
briefs.tags: Bible, Literature, English, Historical Context, Western tradition
briefs.desc: This course is intended primarily for readers with little prior knowledge of the Bible. It introduces students to some of the most famous narratives, characters, literary forms, and teachings of the Bible in the context of their significance for literature and culture. We will read selections from the Hebrew Bible (also called the Tanakh, known to Christians as the Old Testament) and the New Testament, focusing on the best-known narratives in Genesis and Exodus, the story of David, samples of the prophetic and poetic books such as Isaiah, Job, Ecclesiastes, Psalms, Song of Solomon, and the life and teachings of Jesus. Besides selections from the Bible, we will discuss the significance of the particular language of the Bible and explore a selection of modern interpretations and commentaries on the Bible in literature and cinema.

briefs.name: 文學翻譯一
briefs.tags: translation, literary translation, 文學翻譯, 翻譯, 小說翻譯, 散文翻譯, 文學, 翻譯, fiction, prose
briefs.desc: 本課程為文學翻譯實作課程。從文本翻譯的「實作」過程中，探索翻譯活動的本質，從中觀察中英兩種語言的差異，並思考如何轉換。本課 程也培養對文本深入閱讀理解的能力，解決問題的能力，並激發遣詞用字的創意，期能同時提升中英兩種語言的語感與其轉換能力。 同學將透過不同類型文本的翻譯實作、包括嘗試與AI共作、分組討論實作等，掌握基礎到進階不等的文學翻譯方法，最終目標是翻譯出深入 原文旨趣，通順流暢，具文學性與情感共鳴的翻譯作品。 本課程在「忠於原文」的基礎上，鼓勵同學多多發揮靈感，個人文字風格，與感性創意。

With the help of the textbook, the course teaches students to understand human conversations as a coordination game where participants must navigate shifting contexts and diverse personal goals to build meaningful connections. briefs.name: 語言科系的Python入門
briefs.tags: language majors,python,NLP,interdisciplinary,programming
briefs.desc: Natural language processing (NLP) is a major discipline that researches how to make computers comprehend and generate human languages, and Python programming has been at the core since it is optimized for efficient computation of language input, such as text strings. While NLP is among the key domains that students majoring in (foreign) languages must become acquainted with, these students usually eschew computer programming since they find it too technical and challenging. This course is thus designed specifically for language major students with little experience in computer programming. In a semester, this course will introduce fundamental aspects of Python and Python- based NLP in simple language, with examples that language major students can understand and relate to. This course is for novices (like the instructor) with some fundamental knowledge of linguistics and literature, and will not accept students with advanced NLP programming skills.

briefs.desc: 課程概述 依照課本的進度，以口語方式說明韓文的基本文法與 句型， 並盡量與同學以互動之方式進行。此外，簡單介紹韓國文化及 韓國生活。 在練習聽力時，並輔以韓國童歌、民謠及當代流行歌曲等來補 充，提升同學的學習興趣。 這課程為了介紹當代韓國文化,將介紹當代韓國電影2-3片,如 同學不想欣賞韓片的話,請不要選這門課

briefs.name: 初級韓語一
briefs.tags: 韓語、初級韓語、句型解說、實用語彙、韓國文化
briefs.desc: 本課程由韓文字母開始，指導學生熟悉韓語發音及單字、句子之基本構造等，同時由淺入深地介紹文法關係，以及透過基本句型 的學習，期望學生能具有基本之讀、寫及翻譯的能力。同時亦將配以口語練習的互動方式，讓學生熟悉一般日常生活及各種場合 之對話用語。

briefs.name: 閱讀與寫作二(上)
briefs.tags: L2 writing, English academic writing, academic reading
briefs.desc: This course is designed to improve students’ writing ability through process writing and the learning of effective writing strategies. Emphasis will be placed on pre-writing activities, self-reflection, reader/audience expectations, topic development, text analysis, organization, argumentation, critical thinking, research, peer review, and revision. Although grammar will be addressed when needed, the focus of this course will be based on developing the content (ideas, structure, and logic) of student writing rather than mechanics (grammar). Students in this course will explore differences between personal and academic writing, develop written fluency, and improve command over textual, rhetorical, and discursive conventions common in academic writing.

briefs.name: 閱讀與寫作二(上)
briefs.tags: Writing, paragraph, coherency, word choice, research
briefs.desc: This is an advanced writing course that is devoted to training students to write better research papers. Therefore, students are expected to choose a research topic, conduct an elementary level of independent study, and write up their findings and arguments in the style of a formal research paper.

briefs.name: 閱讀與寫作二(上)
briefs.tags: 溝通,目的導向, 媒體寫作, 新聞,公關, communication, purpose-driven, media writing, news, public relations
briefs.desc: 以溝通傳播為導向的「媒體寫作」，培養學生對新聞與公關工作所需的寫作技巧，了解媒體與公關產業的運作與工作倫理，並學 習從「用戶」的角度來看待寫作。

briefs.name: 中級日語一
briefs.tags: 單字解說，重音，句型導入，文法解說，口頭練習、查詢資料}39;分析，自然對話（natural speed），聽力練習
briefs.desc: 該科目原則上實體教學，不過，有特別的需求時，用視訊方式上課。 加強詞彙及句型。重視自己積極學習的態度，鼓勵學生積極參與學習語。增加培養自學日語之基礎（聽說讀寫）。 另外學日語歌，看DVD，介紹日本文化，習俗等，接觸日本文化。

briefs.name: 中級日語一
briefs.tags: Intermediate Japanese,中級日語一,習得基礎句型,奠定基礎會話技巧,觀察日語表達的習慣與特色，體察日本文化
briefs.desc: <教學流程、特色、方法、教材、學習資源、各星期完整學習內容 詳見PDF檔「11510FL 300502」> 我們新學年也一同珍惜相聚時光、各盡誠意！P^O^q ＿＿ 一、學習目標： (1)認知：習得基礎句型；玩味日本文化。 (2)技能：奠定基礎會話技巧；培養基礎讀寫能力。 (3)情意：以日語與他人溝通，獲得成就感、增添學習興趣；觀察日語表達的習慣與特色，體察日本文化。 二、用書：『大家的日本語 初級Ⅱ 改訂版』大新書局 ●第13～19課（形） ◎根據本校公布之「大學教育場域AI協作、共學與素養培養指引」，本課程「AI使用規則」為 「鼓勵課餘時間自主複習時擴充語彙量及話題深度、廣度，但禁止使用於（短文寫作類型等）測驗及回家作業各題型」， 以 下為相關的監管機制： ●修讀本課程之學生應注意本門課不得繳交使用生成式人工智慧所產出的作業、報告或個人心得。 若經查核發現，教師、學校或相關單位有權重新針對作業或報告重新評分或不予計分。 ●修讀本課程之學生於選課時視為同意以上倫理聲明。

briefs.name: 中級日語一
briefs.tags: 日語 Japanese, 聽力 listening, 會話 conversation, 閱讀 reading, 寫作 writing
briefs.desc: 1. 教學目標：培養學生具有初中級程度以上的日語進階溝通與表達能力。透過討論、聽力練習與會話演練來培養溝通表達能力。提升至日語 JLPT N4-N5實力。 2. 指定教科書：上下學期《大家的日本語 初級II 改訂版》 3. 教學進度：視學習狀況與學校行事曆適時調整進度。上學期進度為《大家的日本語初級 II 改訂版》第13-18課。下學期進度第19-25課。 4. 課程說明：學習動詞活用變化以及動詞活用變化所連用的相關句型 (如 「V-形、V-形、Ⅴ-形、V-形、Ⅴ-形、Ⅴ-形」等)。 以其運用在「請求、動作進行貌、動作持續貌、動作樣貌、(請求)允許、否定、能力、興趣、事件、經驗、列舉、變化、口語表現、想法、說 法、動詞修飾名詞、條件句、授受表現、逆接表現」等各種日語溝通表達能力。透過教科書、老師的自製授課講義與各種網路教學平台等，鼓勵 學生模擬真實會話情境，熟練相關句型的口語表達與聽力內容。課程中適時加入相關日語句型的日語歌曲、日語新聞或日劇動漫台詞，以期有效 應用所學內容。 5. 成績考核：期中考（40%）、期末考（30%）、作業（10%）、小考（10%）、出席（10%） 註：教學方法、評量方式、參考書目、教學網頁、AI使用規則等請參考課

briefs.name: 中級日語一
briefs.tags: 初中級日語
briefs.desc: 對基礎的時態與形容詞,名詞有概念之後.再來需要學習日文動詞的變化形.尤其是學好動詞的「形」,「形」,「 形」,「形」之後,將更接近日文的自然會話,也更能運用日文說出較長較完整的句子.

briefs.name: 中級日語一
briefs.tags: 中級日語,句型解說,實用語彙,會話應用,聽力練習,文化介紹
briefs.desc: 接續「初級日語」所學基礎，隨課本進度，協助同學熟悉初級程度的主題句型，進一步奠定日語溝通能力。本學期進度預定 為 教科書13~19課前半內容。 教學目標： 1.學會聽、說、讀、寫日語初級語彙及句型。 2.能於生活中聽、說應用所學句型，具 初級 日語溝通能力。 3.了解日本文化，提升國際視野。 4.提升學生生活品質及未來發展潛力。

briefs.name: 中級日語一
briefs.tags: 初中級日語,文法句型演練,會話表現,文章閱讀,日本文化生活
briefs.desc: 本課程之學習目標為(1)習得初中級日語文法系統、(2)能運用初中級文型簡單會話溝通、(3)具備賞析與應用日本文化知識 的基礎能力

briefs.name: 中級日語一
briefs.tags: 單字解說，句型導入，文法解說，口頭演練，聽力練習
briefs.desc: 1.各課採用「單字解說，句型導入，文法解說，口頭演練，聽力練習」等方式進行，培養學習者閱讀能力以及口語 表達能 力。 2.以板書與補充教材等幫助學習者理解文法使用基礎概念，並搭配日常生活常用語彙練習，增加記憶力外，並達到 能夠簡單 運用日語會話溝通的能力。 3.適時以日語影片等輔助教學，藉由觀察日語表達的習慣與影片中使用的場景來體察日本文化，提升學習意願。

briefs.name: 中級日語一
briefs.tags: 中級
briefs.desc: 本課程以圖文並茂方式導入教學，並重複演練以助加深記憶。每課文法解說完畢後，指導同學短文創作、會話、發音(配合指定 教材CD) 聽力、閱讀等練習，並且每課舉行小考&不定期隨堂考，以深耕聽、說、讀、寫能力。調和課程氣氛，提升學習樂趣， 課程間隔時間開放點歌及影片欣賞，課程中安排，日語遊戲/競賽/桌遊/日本國情與文化相關介紹等活動，以認識與學習他國文 化並導入商業、科技與觀光日語會話教學，擴展學習領域，將本課程之所學適宜地應用於生活、職場，並透過日本語教育多元 思考與溝通合作之影響致力於終身學習。

briefs.desc: 在有日語基本句型概念下，開始加入動詞變化的教學，練習日語動詞語尾活用變化 (形}39;形}39;形}39;形) ，藉由 各種動詞變化的應用，增加日常用語的句型廣度，同時在授課內容中帶入日本文化，藉此 建立學生們對日本文化有更深入的認識。

briefs.name: 中級德語一
briefs.tags: Intermediate German II, 歐盟語言分級A1, Beruf, Essen und Trinken, Fit und gesund, Mode, Jahreszeiten und Feste
briefs.desc: 本學期進度第11至第16課。學習主題以及內容關於職業與教育訓練，工作內容和地點；購買生活食品，談關於最喜愛的食物與 飲 料；身體部位名稱，健康與疾病；談關於衣服、顏色和尺寸；節日描述和計畫，關於天氣詞彙與氣象報導；關於度假活動和旅遊 目的地等。文法學習進度有女性職業名稱，現在完成式可分離動詞和字尾 -ieren之過去分詞；疑問詞welch, zuerst, dann, danach; sein + PII; 形容詞前有定冠詞之字尾附加；形容詞比較級；形態助動詞wollen, 人稱代名詞受格變化等。

briefs.tags: Intermediate German II, 歐盟語言分級A1, Beruf, Essen und Trinken, Fit und gesund, Mode, Jahreszeiten und Feste
briefs.desc: 本學期進度第11至第16課。學習主題以及內容關於職業與教育訓練，工作內容和地點；購買生活食品，談關於最喜愛的食物與 飲 料；身體部位名稱，健康與疾病；談關於衣服、顏色和尺寸；節日描述和計畫，關於天氣詞彙與氣象報導；關於度假活動和旅遊 目的地等。文法學習進度有女性職業名稱，現在完成式可分離動詞和字尾 -ieren之過去分詞；疑問詞welch, zuerst, dann, danach; sein + PII; 形容詞前有定冠詞之字尾附加；形容詞比較級；形態助動詞wollen, 人稱代名詞受格變化等。

briefs.name: 社會語言學導論
briefs.tags: codes, varieties, politics, society, culture, identity
briefs.desc: This course provides a broad overview of basic concepts, tenets, and issues of general sociolinguistics. Throughout the semester, we will look at language variation at different levels and how such variation constructs and is constructed by its social, cultural, and political contexts. Key issues to be explored range from language use within multilingual speech communities, social reasons behind language variation, to how attitudes to language affect speech behaviors.

briefs.name: 言談分析
briefs.tags: Discourse analysis, genre, corpus linguistics, conversation analysis, critical discourse analysis, multimodal discourse analysis
briefs.desc: Life is made up by various types and forms of discourse, from daily conversation, short videos, and social media posts to textbooks, lectures and PowerPoint slides. The ability to comprehend and generate discourse appropriately has influence over our daily routines, academic studies, career development and even interpersonal relationships. Analyzing discourse thus allows us to delve into the essence of language, text, interaction and society. In this course, which will be conducted primarily in English, we will study the major principles, methods and applications of discourse analysis (DA) in linguistics and applied linguistics and explore basic concepts of DA, features of different types of discourse, tools for DA research, and links of DA to various other domains and disciplines. Throughout this course, we will learn how to collect data, observe patterns, and analyze phenomena like a discourse analyst.

briefs.name: 中英翻譯習作
briefs.tags: news translation
briefs.desc: This course aims to provide students with a practical foundation in English-Chinese translation. Through a combination of lectures, discussions, and translation exercises, students will acquire the knowledge and skills necessary to effectively convey meaning and style between the two languages. As an introductory course in translation, the focus will be on translating from English to Chinese. The course will cover a range of topics related to translation, including syntax, semantics, cultural references, and idiomatic expressions. The course content will encompass an overview of fundamental translation concepts, a comparative analysis of Chinese and English, and a methodology section that addresses linguistic and cultural factors involved in language transfer.

briefs.name: 職場英文
briefs.tags: Business English 商用英文, workplace English 職場英語, metaphors 隱喻, jargon 行話, personal growth 自我成長
briefs.desc: Integrating the four skills of the English language with professional language development and covering both spoken and written communication, the course is aimed at advancing students’ verbal and soft skills for workplace success and expanding their lexical repertoire in business jargon, idioms, metaphors, and workplace English. To help students cultivate self-development and personal growth at work, the course taps into advice from industry leaders, career coaches, self-help authors, management gurus, scholars, and psychologists. Harnessing expert insights from popular podcasts and the “Bartleby” column of The Economist, the course offers practical training in functional business skills, key business topics, and real-life business stories to help students navigate uncertainty and change in the workplace.

briefs.name: 第二語言習得
briefs.tags: second language acquisition, language learning,
briefs.desc: This introductory course provides students with a broad overview of theories and issues in the field of second language acquisition (SLA). Through lectures, discussions, activities, and projects, students will learn about theoretical issues and be familiar with research methods commonly used in SLA. Topics covered include (a) first language acquisition, (b) theories in SLA, (c) factors affecting SLA, (d) learner language, and (e) instructed SLA. Students are expected to critically draw on language learning theories and research to reflect on their own assumptions about language learning and teaching.

briefs.name: 語言與大腦
briefs.tags: Course keywords: language, brain, aphasia
briefs.desc: Aim of class: To introduce students to the important concepts of cognitive neuroscience, to be familiar with and to be able to practice contemporary analytical methods for studying neuroplasticity and brain changes. Course requirement: Students have to preview assigned materials in the textbook before coming to classes. Students will be randomly called to answer questions in class. Each student has to turn in assignments on time.

briefs.name: 日語會話一
briefs.tags: 日語 Japanese, 聽力 Listening, 會話 Conversation, 閱讀Reading, 寫作Writing
briefs.desc: 1. 教學目標：教授在日本可能遇到的各種情境，學習實際的日語使用情況。進一步理解日本文化、社會並提升學生的日語會話表達、聽解能力。 以期提升日語 JLPT N4~N2實力。 2. 指定教科書：上學期《會！日本語 進階1》、下學期《會！ 日本語進階2》 3. 課程說明：(1) 上學期進度為L1-L6課與相關主題會話; 下學期進度為L9-L14與相關主題會話。透過情境式生活會話及慣用表現的學習為主，日 本文化人文風俗的學習為輔。期盼透過大量口語練習，讓學習者有具備流利的日語表達能力。 (2) 由教師引導主題、句型說明、補充詞彙、播放CD音檔等。再透過分組上台發表、個人發表與平時對話練習，讓學生互相練習，加強口語會話 的熟練度。最後是增加關聯主題的介紹來深度認識日本。課程中適時加入相關日語主題或句型的影片、日語歌曲或新聞日文，以期有效應用本學 期所學習的內容。 4. 成績考核：期中考（35%）、期末考（35%）、分組報告（10%）、個人報告（10%）、出席上課表現（10%） 備註：教學方法、評量方式、參考書目、教學網頁、AI使用規則等請參考課綱附檔。第一週將詳細說明。

briefs.name: 日語聽解一
briefs.tags: 日語 Japanese, 聽力 listening, 會話 conversation, 閱讀Reading, 寫作Writing
briefs.desc: 1. 教學目標：培養學生具有中級程度以上的日語聽解能力。透過討論、聽力練習與會話演練來培養溝通表達能力。提升至日語 JLPT N5-N4實 力。 2. 指定教科書：上學期《大家的日本語初級II 聽解25（改訂版）》、下學期《大家的日本語進階I 聽解25（改訂版）》。請自備課 本。 3. 教學進度：搭配校內中高級日語的學習教材，採用同系列的聽力課本。以指定教科書為主，輔以日語能力檢定的聽解內容。上學期進度《大家 的日本語初級II 聽解25》第13-25課＋日檢JLPT N5聽解; 下學期進度《大家的日本語進階I 聽解25》第26-35課＋日檢JLPT N4聽 解。 4. 課程說明：上課方式主要分為「授課」(老師補充詞彙句型)、「發表」(學生上台報告JLPT聽解問題或指定教科書句型)、「聽解」(播放教科書 與參考資料 CD 做聽力與對話練習)。利用指定教科書與網路視聽教材的聽力練習，輔以平時作業(日檢聽力)的寫作練習，培養日語的聽解、對話 能力。課程中適時加入相關日語句型的日語歌曲或新聞日文，以期有效應用本學期所學習的內容。 5. 成績考核：期中考（35%）、期末考（35%）、作業與小考（20%）、出席（10%） 備註：第一週課堂上公布教學方法、評量方式、參考書

briefs.name: 從書頁到影像：電影中的文學(二)怪誕奇異篇
briefs.nameEn: Reading Literature Through Film: From Text to Context (II) - The Uncanny in Representations
briefs.tags: Literature,Film, Early AI Narratives,Gothic Romance, The Uncanny
briefs.desc: This course aims to introduce students to the intersection of literature and its cinematic adaptation within broader literary and cultural contexts. It offers a fundamental exploration of an interdisciplinary field regarding representations of the uncanny. Focusing on the works of Mary Shelley, Robert Louis Stevenson, and the Brontë sisters, this course examines how literature and the film adaptations engage with key themes such as an early imagining of artificial life, the duality of human nature, psychological horror, gothic romance, and the complexity of human experience. By the end of the semester, students will have developed the growth of Critical Thinking Skills (CTS) and heightened their sensitivity to language, dialogue, and visual representation.

briefs.name: 諾貝爾文學獎跟小說
briefs.nameEn: Nobel Prize in Literature and Novels
briefs.tags: Nobel Prize in Literature, Modernism, Satire, Southern Gothic, Lost Generation, Imperialism.
briefs.desc: This course offers a critical survey of the Nobel Prize in Literature through the lens of the early 20th-century novel. By focusing on four foundational laureates—Rudyard Kipling (1907), Sinclair Lewis (1930), William Faulkner (1949), and Ernest Hemingway (1954)—we will examine how these writers redefined narrative form and addressed the shifting moral and social landscapes of their time. Students will analyze Kipling’s imperial picaresque, Lewis’s satire of middle-class conformity, Faulkner’s Southern Gothic modernism, and Hemingway’s “Iceberg” style of war and loss. The course investigates the criteria used by the Swedish Academy and explores how these “notable” works continue to resonate in contemporary literary discourse.

Moreover, since the names and other vocabulary in the books contain many meanings unavailable to those who read the books in a language other than English, this course uncovers the mythological and other deeper references to broaden students vocabulary in English and their knowledg of European cultures.

briefs.name: 魯濱遜漂流記：全球脈絡下的多重文本
briefs.nameEn: Robinson Crusoe: A Multilayered Text in Global Contexts
briefs.tags: Daniel Defoe, Robinson Crusoe, adventure story, providence, prudence, nature, mercantilism, colonialism, prose fiction, eighteenth-century, English literature
briefs.desc: Daniel Defoe’s (1660?-1731) Robinson Crusoe is a trilogy of adventure stories consisting of three novels--The Life and Adventures of Robinson Crusoe (1719), The Farther Adventures of Robinson Crusoe (1719), and Serious Reflections of Robinson Crusoe (1720). In these texts, the novelist embodies the ideology of mercantilism and colonial expansion which, in turn, intersect and re-enforce each other. Therefore, we can clearly see that the protagonist is a typical colonizer, who roves all over the globe to go on expeditions, to cultivate plantations, and to accumulate capitals. Being at the threshold of the industrial revolution, the English society was driven to explore new territory, to secure the supply of raw materials, and to search for new markets. To be sure, Crusoe has no scruples about betraying his own ideas or upholding contradictory doctrines, insofar as his interest is concerned. As Maximillian E. briefs.name: 詩歌文類
briefs.tags: The idea of the lyric, concrete poems, odes, sonnets, metaphysical poets, dramatic monologues, confessional poems
briefs.desc: This course aims to acquaint students with practices of poetry, generally in terms of the shorter verse forms, and explore the idea of poetry as a genre. The students will be familiarized with various verse forms established in the course of history, read a variety of poetic endeavors, and discuss how these works variously explore the multiple aspects of the self and boldly imagine and invent ways of living and acting in the society and the world.

briefs.tags: 時事 current affairs, 經濟學人 The Economist, 政治 Politics, 商業 Business. 文字遊戲 Wordplay
briefs.desc: The course is designed to introduce students to the characteristics and conventions of journalistic writing. Great emphasis is placed on honing reading and language skills that students need most in comprehending news reports and articles in English. Training in key vocabulary skills and knowledge includes connotations, loanwords, metaphors, allusions, and idioms. Training in reading is aimed at inferring word meaning from context, identifying contextual clues, and grasping main ideas. A selection of texts will be used to sharpen students’ abilities to detect hidden bias and to raise students’ awareness of cohesive and discourse features that tie a text together.

briefs.tags: Realism, Regional Writings, Modernism, Minority Writings, Multiculturalism
briefs.desc: This course studies American literature from the end of the 19th century to the present day. We will explore some of the major issues which the literary works in these periods have distinctively articulated and/or born witness to. Our reading of the literary texts will build on critical and historical contexts in order to acquire a general knowledge of the literary developments in the U.S. since 1865 with attention to their historical (dis)continuities and their relation to social changes.

briefs.tags: 歐洲文學European Literature, 中世紀文化Medieval Culture, 文藝復興Renaissance, 歷史與虛構Fiction and History, 世界建構World-Making, 寓言與想像Allegory and Imagination, 歐洲思想史Intellectual History
briefs.desc: This course offers a critical survey of European literature from the Middle Ages to the Classical Age, with particular emphasis on the development of major literary forms, cultural paradigms, and epistemological frameworks. Through the study of texts situated within religious, political, military, scientific, and intercultural contexts, students will examine the role of literature in shaping historical consciousness and modes of world-making. The course traces both continuities and transformations across literary periods and genres while engaging critically with the construction and critique of Eurocentric worldviews. Particular attention is devoted to the function of fiction, allegory, imagination, and narrative representation in the production of historical knowledge and truth regimes. By situating literary works within broader intellectual and cultural histories, the course encourages students to develop a nuanced understanding of the reciprocal relation

briefs.name: 後現代小說
briefs.tags: Postmodernism, Reality, Fiction, Simulation, Entropy
briefs.desc: In this course, we will examine the theoretical framework and concept of Postmodernism and how they are executed in Postmodern Fictions. We will begin with a discussion of Postmodernism relation to Modernism as well as to the socioeconomic of what we now considered as Late Capitalism. We will further discuss the writing strategies employed by the Postmodernist writers such as Kurt Vonnegut, Thomas Pynchon, Salman Rushdie, Italo Calvino, etc.

briefs.name: 創傷跟美國詩
briefs.tags: Trauma Theory, Confessional Poetry, Lyric Subject, Memory and Identity, Historical Witnessing, Psychological Realism.
briefs.desc: Brief Course Description (required) (50-200 words if possible, up to 1000 letters) This course explores the intersection of psychological trauma and American poetic expression from the mid-20th century to the present. We will examine how poets use the “lyric subject” to navigate personal, historical, and collective wounds. By integrating Trauma Theory (including psychoanalytic and contemporary approaches) with close readings of Confessional Poetry and post-war American verse, students will investigate how language can represent the “unrepresentable”. The curriculum focuses on the development of a “confessional mode” and its evolution into contemporary narratives of social and political trauma, including themes of motherhood, racial identity, and war. Key questions include: How does poetry facilitate “reconstructing meaning” after trauma? What is the relationship between the poetic “I” and the clinical “self”?.

briefs.name: 生物體與社會體：二十世紀戲劇、醫療與倫理
briefs.nameEn: Bio and social communities: Drama, medicine and ethics in the 20th century
briefs.tags: medicine, theatre, ethics
briefs.desc: This seminar aims to discuss the intricate relationship among medicine, theatre and ethics in last century. In the context of positivism, Darwinism, realism and naturalism, both medicine and theatre redefined their own discourses and practices in the modern period, and explored the technological relations of human bodies and living environments. In modern science’s attempt to control human fate, it (un- )wittingly shapes ethics, especially those ethical issues arising in personal and professional relationships. Theatre and medicine come into confluence as theatre becomes a venue of contagion, and emotions and empathy are generated to such extent that identity transformation becomes possible; similarly, clinical practices, as a cultural form in their own right, share the goal of managing human lives, albeit through medicine. Issues that will be discussed include the political/social meaning of diseases, the formation of influential medical policies and the et

briefs.name: 研究方法
briefs.tags: quantitative data analysis, research method, research design, experimental research, artificial intelligence
briefs.desc: This course is an introductory course in research methodology and it aims to develop graduate students’ abilities in conducting research in areas such as second/foreign language acquisition, computer-assisted language learning/teaching and general behavioral and social sciences. Basic skills and approaches to conduct experimental/non-experimental research will be introduced with a pedagogical focus. The instructor will guide students step by step from selecting a research topic, reviewing relevant literature, designing research method, collecting data to the end of putting together a research proposal. Each research method will be introduced by reference to studies using that method. It has to be noted that data-analysis and qualitative research paradigm will NOT be covered in this class due to time constraint.

briefs.name: 論文寫作
briefs.tags: Applied Linguistics Masters Thesis Writing, Applied Linguistics Research Methods
briefs.desc: This course aims to teach Master’s degree students to write a proposal for their thesis research. The course takes the students through each part of a thesis, from the abstract to the introduction, literature review, methodology, results, discussion, and conclusion chapters. Students will also learn the APA style of the American Psychological Association. There will also be a review of research methodology in applied linguistics that applies to individual students’ thesis. Throughout the semester, each student will focus on only one research topic and draft the abstract as well as the three chapters of their thesis proposal. The accumulated written products will be the first draft of a thesis proposal that is ready to be presented to each student’s thesis supervisor for future revisions and expansion. It is strongly recommended that the students only take this course when they are ready to start working on their own thesis. It is best for the students to t

briefs.name: 雙語心理學
briefs.tags: bilingual lexicon, bilingual sentence processing, bilingual speech production, cognition and bilingualism, bilingual brain
briefs.desc: With more than one language in mind, how does the bilingual/multilingual keep the languages apart in her/his mind, or does s/he? How are multiple language systems represented in the bilingual’s/ multilingual’s mind? How does the bilingual/multilingual process them in perception and production? What role does the learner’s first language play in her/his acquisition of new languages? Will the learner’s knowledge of a new language (or languages) in turn have an impact on his/her competence and use of the mother tongue? These as well as other psycholinguistic issues of bilingualism will be discussed in the course. In addition, the research methods that researchers use to investigate bilingual language processing will be explained. The topics to be covered are listed below. The course will be run in a seminar fashion where participants will take turns reporting on the articles they are interested in and leading the discussion.

briefs.name: 內隱與外顯語言學習
briefs.tags: language learning,implicit and explicit learning,applied linguistics,second language acquisition,psycholinguistics.awareness
briefs.desc: Language learning is either implicit or explicit, depending on learners' awareness of the process. This distinction has been commonly extended to explain the fundamental difference between L1 acquisition and L2 learning; the former occurs with leaners' "instinct" in natural language learning settings in their early infancy and childhood, whereas the latter could involve more explicit motivations and instructions. These qualitative differences have inspired an ongoing discussion of L1 language acquisition models, the extension of these models in L2 language learning, and the roles of implicit and explicit learning / knowledge for both L1 and L2 learners. In this course, we will join this discussion by reviewing crucial theoretical proposals as well as experimental findings in hopes of contributing to our understanding of language learning as a whole.

briefs.name: 語言習得專題
briefs.tags: Language acquisition, L2 syntax, experimental research
briefs.desc: This course takes a linguistic/psycholinguistic perspective to study grammar acquisition. Relevant linguistic theories, experimental methods, and empirical evidence will be introduced and discussed. Specifically, this course focuses on the aspects of syntax, semantics, and pragmatics, asking “why” questions instead of “how” questions. Students are expected to learn how linguistic/psycholinguistic theories can be relevant to L2 acquisition as well as how theories can be tested empirically. Most importantly, this course will enhance students’ knowledge of various linguistic constructions, helping them not only to identify but also to explain interesting phenomena or errors observed during language learning/teaching experiences. Such knowledge is particularly useful for developing new insights that can be incorporated into future language learning and teaching practice.

briefs.desc: 在大洪流的環境中許多發燒的議題都隨時間消逝，工業4.0是少數仍受到重視與討論的議題，近兩年ChatGPT更是火熱，使用 與否都受到放大鏡的審視，但這背後代表的意義為何?科技領域討論實體虛擬、經濟領域討論產業戰略、文化領域討論人類和 諧共榮等，無論是哪個論述，或許都離不開機器與人或是人與人彼此的融合。這場全世界都爭相競爭追逐的科技夢，現在已 經改變人類的生活方式(通訊溝通)，未來勢將帶來更大的改變。 本課程旨在結合工業4.0理論與情境應用，以期讓各科系學生能1.了解何謂工業4.0；2.工業4.0對製造業的影響；3.以實務 案例說明工業4.0；4.實作展示自走車設計、基礎DNN/CNN以及PLC自動控制，修習本門課將對工業4.0整體領域建立初步的了 解，並一同探討在科技、經濟與人文在4.0中的衝擊與領悟。

briefs.desc: 面對不可逆的全球暖化與能源短缺，當地球溫度快速上升，全球多數人口將成為環境的災民，無家可歸。各國應重視二氧 化碳排放的問題，藉由提高綠色能源的使用並節能減碳才能緩和暖化造成的災難。為了現在與未來後代的環境著想，所有 人都該保護環境追求永續發展。 聯合國大會於103年採納「永續發展目標(SDGs)」決議，並後續制定「聯合國後2015 年發展議程」。永續發展目標包含 17 項目標(Goals)及 169 項細項目標(Targets)。其中較為耳熟能詳者，為首要目標（目標 1. 消除各地一切形式的 貧窮），另外，也包括實現性別平等，並賦予婦女權力（目標 5.）及因應氣候變遷之目標（目標 13. 採取緊急措施以 因應氣候變遷及其影響）。 永續發展目標提出後，帶起一股國內產官學研各界對應的風潮，舉例言之，國內企業致力於讓其公司社會責任 （Corporate Social Responsibility）能夠對應永續發展目標而發展出所謂企業永續報告（Corporate Sustainability Reports，CSR）之概念。另外，於2019年美國時代(Times)首度頒佈大學影響力排名（University Impact Rankings）希望透過大學教育可順利培養出可對應永續發展對應能力的大學高等人才。 本課程之目的，希望讓大學生

briefs.name: 智慧財產權
briefs.tags: 著作權法、商標法、專利法、學術倫理、網路侵權、生成式AI
briefs.desc: 1.希望同學了解智慧財產權法的基本概念。除了講解我國智慧財產權內容外，讓同學具備基礎的智慧財產權法與相關法律知 識。 2.許多智慧財產權的問題，可以透過案例討論，讓同學更瞭解實際運作上以及各方的利益。故本課程會以爭議案例，帶領同 學討論及思考，掌握具體的智慧財產權法爭議問題。 3.智慧財產權在科技發展、網路應用、學術倫理，不斷出現各種新的問題。因此，本課程也會隨時補充這些新的問題，讓同 學思考在網路科技發展、生成式AI、網路應用上，對智慧財產權的衝擊與因應；以及在同學將來可能邁入學術生涯上，需要 注意的學術倫與智財權問題。

briefs.name: 法律與文學

briefs.desc: 「本課程將導入「台灣法律史 × 台灣文學」的跨域文本教學為中心，透過閱讀、討論與書寫之循環學習設計，培養學生理解歷史議題、思 考法律的角色、詮釋文本與建構敘事的能力。課程中將以混合式學習法進行，依序進行1. 以講述教學法有系統地導讀文學作品的歷史背景 與法律意識。2. 以問題導向式學習法（PBL）增進討論氛圍，經由思辨、敘事和討論，進而發現法律敘事之主軸。3.在團體討論後，將由 學生自行構思改編、續寫和批判小說的可能，進而在「教師本位」和「課程本位」的學習之外，開啟「學生本位」的學習空間，用以完善期 末報告的撰寫並預計於台灣文學虛擬博物館發表成果，希冀成功達成本次教學實踐研究的三個目標：「從台灣文學之中探索法律意識」、「融 合臺灣法律史的知識內涵」以及「深化敘事力的沈浸式寫作」。

briefs.name: 基礎素描
briefs.tags: 藝術，繪畫，素描，Art，Painting，Sketch，Drawing
briefs.desc: 素描是進入繪畫世界的基礎入門之一，透過理性和感性交互使用，讓學生得以學習從對物象外觀精準掌握，到循序漸進地將 情感自然流露於作品中，除了學習精準的繪畫也能欣賞名家的作品；素描能培養學生專注力、觀察力的一種訓練方式，素描的 作畫過程是一種客觀、主觀，理性和感性交互運用的訓練，一種人生規畫和實踐的縮影。

briefs.name: 百年來的中華民國對外關係
briefs.nameEn: Foreign Relations of Republic of China, 1912-now
briefs.tags: 中華民國, 中華民國外交, 國際關係, 兩岸關係, 外交政策, 國際關係理論,
briefs.desc: 本課程將從一個新國家－中華民國，也就是學生及教師所共同歸屬的國家－於1912年的誕生開始，探討前一代政權所留下的遺緒和深刻影 響，以及新國家誕生後參與決策或實際的領導者如何運籌帷幄，再加上伴隨而來的內部社會在思想、觀念、體制上的連串變化並從而影響對 外決策；更重要的，外在國際環境的強大衝擊，特別是強權彼此間的對抗與弱肉強食所導致的一連串事件更進一步影響－－甚至是決定－－ 了這個國家在二十世紀大半的命運。藉由快速、客觀地檢視歷史，翻轉過去悲情式的思考，改以國際關係的核心分析架構，帶領學生以嶄新 的思維回顧與學習中華民國的對外關係史，將有助選課學生以更客觀的角度、更多面向的思維來看待當前中華民國的外交政策以及整體對外 關係。

briefs.name: 世界古文明
briefs.tags: 世界,古文明,world,ancient,civilization
briefs.desc: 隨著科技進步、交通便利，國與國、民族與民族之間，逐漸形成「地球村」的社會，已非過往的冷戰對立或是壁壘分明。而臺 灣位處東北亞，亞洲交通要衝樞紐，成為世界地球村的一份子，更是當務之急。據史界前輩高亞偉所述︰「所謂『文明』乃指 高等文化而言，起碼的條件要有文字」；因此，了解世界文明的歷史發展，不僅是加入世界文化的第一步，同時也能拓展同學 們的視野。 本課程的編排方式，共分成三大單元，包括人類文明遺產、世界宗教衝突、東亞文化融合等。從橫向面而言，內容包含四大古 文明區，即西亞、埃及、印度、中國，縱向面從上古時代至近代，以兩河流域為起點，依序介紹埃及、希臘、羅馬文明，緊接 而來便是西方精神文明堡壘—基督教，再接續論述與伊斯蘭教的關係。第三單元則以東亞為主軸，略述中國與印度文明區，以 及東亞文化的交流。

briefs.tags: 創作思考 系列表現 美感 藝術創作 公共藝術
briefs.desc: 【現代藝術創作專題】 綴補大地藝術計畫 教育館108教室/ 現代藝術創作專題科目 Art Project 課程說明：本課程以現代藝術創作為核心，並以自我探索作為創作的起點。藝術教育的價值，不僅在於技法的學習，更在於 透過材料、思考與實作，引導學生體驗創作歷程，將內在感受轉化為視覺語言。當雙手投入創作時，情感、記憶與生命經驗 也隨之被整理與表達，使藝術成為認識自我、探索世界的重要媒介。 本學期將結合繪畫與馬賽克公共藝術兩種媒材，完成二件創作作品，並將部分作品設置於清華大學校園中，讓藝術走出教 室，進入日常生活空間。學生將親身參與公共藝術從構思、設計、製作到安裝的完整歷程，理解藝術如何介入環境，並與空 間、使用者及校園文化建立連結。 「綴補大地藝術計畫」相信，藝術不只是展示於美術館，更能回應生活、修補環境，並重新賦予空間新的意義。學生將原本 不起眼的校園坑洞，轉化為充滿故事與溫度的藝術作品，使校園景觀成為共同參與、共同維護的公共美學場域，也讓日常行 走的空間成為欣賞藝術、感受美感的生活現場。 本課程特別強調場域回應（Site-specific Art）的創作精神。學生須以校園環境為創作起點，深入觀察建築、地景、植 栽、

briefs.name: 認識真菌
briefs.tags: 真菌, 黏菌, 黴菌, 菇菌, 地衣, 酵母菌, 生物多樣性 fungi, mould, mushroom, lichen, yeast, biodiversity
briefs.desc: 「認識真菌」介紹真菌的多樣性，形態及生態等。目的是有系統的認識多種真菌，明白真菌在生態系中的角色，與環 境、 文化 及與其他物種（動植物、人類）的關聯。 雖然中小學的生物課程中，對真菌學著墨不多，但其實真菌比想像中影響我們更多：各種傳統發酵食品、發酵機能性食 品、可食與不可食的菌菇、牆角的黴菌、皮膚的癬病、蔬果的病害與防治、食品的毒素等等，皆有真菌參與。課程中我 們將提及這些生物的多樣性、分類形態、生態角色、對人類及日常生活的影響，對於媒體上與真菌學相關的報導，課堂 上將提供查找完整資訊的方法，並討論如何判斷資訊是否正確。 同學可透過本課程知道多種真菌的知識及其與生活的連結，例如雨後出現在草地的各種菇類是否有毒，是否可以食用？ 毒菇應該消滅以免有人誤食嗎？爬山時常常看到各種顏色形狀怪怪的東西，是菌類嗎？為什麼要保護森林和森林裡面的 菌類，可以賺錢嗎？為什麼酵母菌可以製作發酵食品又好像會造成「酵母菌感染」？

briefs.name: 台灣當代戲曲
briefs.tags: 當代戲曲、京劇、歌仔戲、布袋戲、台灣
briefs.desc: 本課程以「台灣當代戲曲」為主題，藉近年在台灣的京劇與歌仔戲演出為素材，通過課堂講解、分組報告與影像觀賞（若情況允許，亦會安 排觀看現場演出或後台參訪）讓學生理解「戲曲」在台灣的演出內容、轉型、生態與生存狀況，藉此提升美學與文化涵養，同時也更能認識 台灣的傳統藝術與藝文發展，並能夠在世界傳統藝術的發展脈絡裡，替台灣戲曲創作與文化找到定位的可能。

briefs.name: 俄國史
briefs.tags: 俄國史（Russian History），莫斯科公國（Muscovite State），羅曼諾夫王朝（Romanov Dynasty），蘇維埃（Soviet Russia），史達林（Stalin)
briefs.desc: 本課程屬於通識課程核心課程的歷史分析類。宗旨在協助同學瞭解俄國歷史發展的脈絡。在現今的國際舞台，俄國佔有舉足 輕重的地 位。 但是我們對於該國的歷史背景卻所知甚少。我希望透過課程講解，協助同學瞭解俄國史發展的一些特性，例如多元性、極端 性，以及 歷史 上俄國人的喜樂與悲哀的生活經驗。由此進而理解俄國國勢崛起的背景動力來源。例如，嚴峻的地理環境、複雜的自然條 件，迫使俄 國人 民為追求生存與安全而不斷擴張。為了因應生存的艱難，俄國人被迫放棄了民主，而採取高度集中資源與管理的專制模式。 本課程的另一項目標是訓練同學建立一個照顧面更廣、更周延，也更寬容的思考方式。俄國是個多元文化的國家，在 多元的發 展 流程中，不乏衝撞，但也發展出不少的互賴相處之道。因此希望透過俄國歷史的多元性，讓同學體認到多元文化的難以維繫 和凝聚， 唯有 靠相互的尊重與互動方能共處。進而培養出寬容的精神。寬容、互相尊重則是發展民主政治與文化的不二法門。

briefs.name: 中亞國際關係
briefs.nameEn: Central Asia: Politics and Society and Contested Powers
briefs.tags: Central Asia, power politics, the Great Game, US, Russia, China
briefs.desc: 課程介紹中亞政治與社會，以及檢討中亞在國際權力結構中的位置。中亞從地域上來定義，泛指蘇聯解體後的五國；包括哈 薩克斯坦、烏茲別克斯坦、吉爾吉斯坦、塔吉克斯坦、土庫曼斯坦，還加上所謂的內亞地區，也就是新疆、西藏、相關周邊 區域。課程內容含括當代中亞政治議題，像是民主化與再威權化的爭辯、政治伊斯蘭與恐怖主義、公民社會、貧窮與經改、 民族認同。 中亞天然資源豐富，又有尚待開發的市場，特殊的地緣政治，也因此成為國際政治的焦點，引起全球強權(像是美國、俄羅 斯、中國、歐盟)，以及區域強權(像是土耳其、伊朗、巴基斯坦、印度)的關注，互相爭奪。這個課程不僅嘗試介紹中亞歷史 背景與相關政經社議題，同時檢討中亞在當前國際政治扮演的角色。 課程分為三個部分:歷史背景、蘇聯解體後的發展狀況、當前中亞國際關係。 第一部分、介紹十九世紀強權競逐大戲局(the Great Game)以凸顯出中亞區域的重要性，以及後續如何影響蘇聯與中國統治 下的中亞區域。第二部分、討論蘇聯解體後的中亞發展狀況，以及其他相關的政治與社會議題。第三部分、集中討論中亞的 地緣政治，以及與其他全球或區域強權的來往。

briefs.name: 中東地區研究
briefs.nameEn: The Research of Middle East Region
briefs.tags: 中東,北非,伊斯蘭,石油產業的政治經濟學,清真產業, Middle East, North Africa, Islam, Political Economy of Oil Industry, Halal Industry
briefs.desc: 本課程教學主要宗旨與目標有三：一、增進同學對中東地區政治情勢概況了解；二、協助同學了解中東地區主要經濟與產業 發展情況；三、增進同學對中東人文社會與市場發展趨勢的關注與了解。本課程強調培養同學跨領域的觀察、資料蒐集與分 析能力，希望透過教師提供與引導同學自主掌握關鍵資訊的過程，提升同學在短時間內從總體面到微觀面，理解區域重大事 件、當地人文社會及市場發展趨勢的能力。在課程規劃方面，本課程將從政治、經濟、人文社會與市場發展等範疇切入，依 據從總體面到微觀面的途徑，聚焦在政治、經濟、人文社會及市場領域重疊的主要核心議題與趨勢的介紹，以逐步加深同學 對中東北非區域主要政治情勢、經濟產業、人文社會及市場發展趨勢的了解，並藉此開拓同學跨領域與跨區域發展的視野及 國際觀。同時透過期中、期末分組報告及討論，培養同學掌握中東北非市場趨勢，並就當地需要且臺灣本身具優勢之產業， 提出觀察與拓展市場建議的能力。

briefs.name: 環保與生活
briefs.tags: 環保與生活,食安,能源,氣候與汙染,人口,地球資源
briefs.desc: 1、課程內容除了環境知識外，也包括食品、農學、能源、氣象、毒物、生態、社會科學及經濟學等。共分八章、包括一、瞭解 我們的環境，二、人口，三、食物與農業，四、氣候與污染，五、環境汙染，六、能源與未來能源，七、台灣環境問題，八、身 心靈綠色觀念 2、目的乃希望學習者能建構起個人的生活環保觀念與行為，時時做環保，處處做環保，讓美麗寶島能早日來到。

briefs.name: 音樂賞析二
briefs.tags: ＃音樂賞析，＃浪漫派，＃歌劇，＃Appreciation of Music, #Romantic music
briefs.desc: 本課程為一針對非音樂科系學生所開設之音樂賞析課程，提供學生在理工為主的大學課程裡一個思索人文藝術的空間。引導學生欣賞音樂、瞭解音樂及接觸音樂。進而主動蒐集資料並參與音樂活動。日後成為藝術欣賞的中堅人口，並提升整體藝術品質。 全部課程概分為四個部分（四學期），內容以西洋古典音樂為主，依音樂史進行，自巴洛克時期、古典時期、浪漫派至近代及現代。以代表性音樂家為單元，介紹其時代背景、生平、作品及影響。並視情況許可邀請音樂家做現場示範及演說。學生可依意願選擇，修習。 除被動的教師單向教學之外，學生需經由分組報告主動收集資料。 經由各組組長與組員共同策劃討論之後，除口頭報告之外並需以書面報告分發全班同學。印製之前需與教師充分溝通及經批改之後始得完成製作，以確實掌握報告時間與品質。

briefs.name: 行銷管理
briefs.tags: 設計顧客驅動的行銷策略。 Design Consumer-driven marketing strategy 數位時代的行銷變革。 Marketing in the Digital Era 行銷環境分析。 Marketing Environment Analysis 消費者與消費者購買行為模型。 Consumers and Consumption Behaviors 數位時代的消費者消費變革。 Consumer Behaviors in the Digitial Era 產品服務與品牌策略。 Services and Branding Strategies 品牌、品牌建立、品牌經營與管理。 Branding: how to bu
briefs.desc: 課程概述 (1) 講授行銷學之『理論基礎與知識』。 (2) 課程主題導入相關『個案探討』。 (3) 數位時代的行銷知識與應用 (4) 產品、服務與品牌建立 (5) 品牌策略與行銷操作 (6) 行銷與商業模式、顧客體驗、顧客價值 (7) 小組 Workshop 工作坊的討論成果 本課程之教學目標 (1) 講授行銷知識，理論與實務，以個案導入行銷管理的核心課程。 (2) 探討解說最新行銷議題，引導學生學習具創見的行銷思維。 (3) 探討全球脈動下的最新行銷議題與趨勢。 (4) 導入傳統行銷的知識與演進及數位時代的行銷科技應用。增進同學認知與了解行銷趨勢與議題的學習。

briefs.name: 聖經與人生
briefs.tags: 聖經, 人生探索, 生命的意義, 生活的準則, 思考, 文化
briefs.desc: 「聖經」在西方文化中有非常深遠的影響，也成為生活中的一些重要的準則。我們學習西方的科技之時，也受他們 的文化影響，特別是現代資訊便利的世代。本課程提供一個認識與討論聖經的平台，以聖經的思想及其在人生上的 應用為範疇，採多元化的方式提供學生瞭解聖經的生活哲理。我們盡量鼓勵學生一方面學習聖經的知識，一方面以 客觀的立場作為思考。希望在這多元化的世代增加學生多方面的思維知識與能力，並在未來複雜多變的人生中能得 著智慧、力量與平安。 本課程乃基於聖經的觀點作介紹，務求忠實地呈現聖經的內涵，採用的輔助資料也力求真確可靠。 課程內容可歸納成三大部分： 1. 聖經內容介紹 2. 聖經與科學的對話 3. 聖經在人生中的實踐

briefs.name: 美國政治
briefs.tags: Constitution, Federalism, Political Parties, Ideologies, Elections
briefs.desc: This course aims at introducing students to government and politics of America, including its major elected offices (president, senators, congressmen and state governors), nomination process (caucuses and primaries), political parties and candidates, campaign issues and financing, and the general election. We will also look into the cleavages that divide the American societies and understand how race, ethnicity, gender, religion, region, and sexual orientation affect people’s support for political parties and voting behavior. In addition, there will be discussion on American foreign policy. We are going to use President Barack Obama's book as the basis of our approach as most of his arguments remain valid in the eras of Trump and Biden. There will be questions provided for each chapter to help student to prepare and study so they can make meaningful participation in the class.

briefs.name: 古典詩歌選讀
briefs.tags: 古典詩歌(Classical Poetry)
briefs.desc: 古典詩歌大多短小精悍，字字珠璣。一首好詩本身就是一幅優美的圖畫、一曲動聽的音樂。在品讀詩歌的過程中，讀者 可以展開豐富的想像，心馳八極，神游萬仞。本課程大體是從「體悟形象」、「感受詩心」、「以意逆志」、「熟悉嬗變」、「知人論 世」這五種途徑尋求古典詩歌鑒賞教學的審美回歸。中國古代詩學的積澱非常深厚，其思維模式、範疇體系等方面都有不同於 西方的特點。本課程講授共分四個部份：一、詩學生命精神闡釋論，二、詩法創作論，三、詩歌發展源流論。四、詩史各階段 名家名作論。從詩的生命內涵到形式的表現到詩歌的發展淵流，每部分選出部分篇章，藉由點的接觸貫串成整個面，讓同學了 解中國詩歌發展的背景、歷程、現象。更重要的是賞識每一位詩人獨特的風格所形成的人格範式與性情典型，恰當地掌握了詩 學之創作規律，以提昇其對於詩歌現象的分析評論的能力。

briefs.name: 圖畫書的藝術：從視覺到多模態敘事
briefs.nameEn: The Art of Picturebooks: Visual and Multimodal Storytelling
briefs.tags: picturebooks, children’s literature, multimodality, word-image relations
briefs.desc: 本課程以圖畫書（picturebooks）作為當代兒童文學的重要形式，將其視為結合文字、圖像與書籍設計的多模態文本（multimodal texts），探討其獨特的敘事特色與文化意義。課程透過經典與當代圖畫書作品的閱讀與討論，引導學生分析語言與圖像如何互動以建構 意義，並理解圖畫書作為文學與藝術作品的表現形式。 課程前半將介紹兒童文學與圖畫書的發展脈絡，並探討不同作品中的主題、敘事形式與表現手法。同時，學生將接觸基本的圖畫書分析框 架（如圖文關係、多模態敘事、讀者回應等），培養對文本的詮釋能力與批判思考。 在課程後半段，學生將進一步思考故事在不同媒介中的轉化，探討當圖像敘事轉換為聲音或口語形式時，文本如何被重新詮釋。透過文本 賞析、討論與創意實作，本課程旨在培養學生對圖畫書作為文學與藝術形式之理解及欣賞，並深化其跨媒介敘事的分析能力。 本課程以英語授課，重點在於對文本的理解與詮釋，英語作為學生進行討論、分析與表達詮釋觀點之媒介，而非語言技能訓練課程。

briefs.name: 人類語言的奧秘
briefs.tags: 語言，語音，音韻，構詞，句法，語意
briefs.desc: 人類日常生活時時刻刻都在使用語言，因此它也是和教育、社會、歷史、心理、神經科學、以及人工智慧等各領域都有關的一個基礎學科。然 而，正因為我們無時無刻不在使用語言，很多時候我們是「知其然而不知其所以然」，甚至可能產生錯誤的概念（譬如認為我們從小使用熟悉的 語言沒有語法，或某個語言比別的語言原始或沒有邏輯等），渾然不知我們所視之為理所當然的日常語言使用，不管是哪個語言，其實都蘊含了 人類心智高度複雜卻又具有規律結構的運作。 這門課將以淺顯易懂的一些現象，介紹人類語言各層面的特性，對所有修課的學生，期能充實學生對語言本質的瞭解，並提升對日常生活不同語 言使用的覺察力。而對於有興趣繼續從事語言相關領域更深入探索的學生，也能為其跨領域的學習建立正確的概念及分析能力的基礎。 不同於一般外語課程，這門課會透過各個層面（包含音、詞彙、句子、語意）以不同語言的語料進行實作的分析，並且用生活中的一些常有的經 驗，帶領學生探索人類語言訊息處理的基本特性，並透過過去語言習得和心理語言學、腦神經語言學的研究發現，讓學生瞭解人類心智的運作在 表象看來各自不同的語言間，實則有高度的相似和一致的原則。

briefs.name: 插畫技法與運用
briefs.tags: 插畫技法與運用 Illustration Techniques and Their Practical Application
briefs.desc: 本課程依繪畫創作過程分為：1.理解素材運用2.示範繪畫基礎技法3.分析插畫風格與商業運用。讓學生在實作過程中嘗試各 種素材 呈現不同的表現形式，建立個人的插畫風格與特色，學習創作者對作品內心情感的表現與傳達。 以下說明三項目標：1.理解素材運用：水彩、彩色墨水、色鉛筆、粉彩。2.示範繪畫基礎技法：造型設計、色彩調配與運 用、光影 與質感。3.分析插畫風格與商業運用：介紹各國插畫作品特色以及如何與商業結合，加強視覺傳達與附加價值。尤其當插畫 在不同 的媒介上呈現，插畫目的也迥然不同，例如：兒童繪本插畫的親子性，與商品包裝插畫的說明性，有著極大的差異……。

briefs.name: 插畫技法與運用
briefs.tags: 插畫技法與運用 Illustration Techniques and Their Practical Application
briefs.desc: 本課程依繪畫創作過程分為：1.理解素材運用2.示範繪畫基礎技法3.分析插畫風格與商業運用。讓學生在實作過程中嘗試各 種素材 呈現不同的表現形式，建立個人的插畫風格與特色，學習創作者對作品內心情感的表現與傳達。 以下說明三項目標：1.理解素材運用：水彩、彩色墨水、色鉛筆、粉彩。 2.示範繪畫基礎技法：造型設計、色彩調配與運 用、光影與質感。 3.分析插畫風格與商業運用：介紹各國插畫作品特色以及如何與商業結合，加強視覺傳達與附加價值。尤 其當插 畫在不同的媒介上呈現，插畫目的也迥然不同，例如：兒童繪本插畫的親子性，與商品包裝插畫的說明性，有著極大的差 異……。

briefs.name: 創傷與社會
briefs.tags: 創傷後壓力症(PTSD),背叛創傷,歷史創傷,德國猶太大屠殺,台灣228和白色恐怖,轉型正義,殖民種族主義,見證,敘事治療,心理韌性
briefs.desc: 本課程探討倖存者的個人創傷和集體創傷。主要的內容包含三個主題。第一是關於創傷後壓力症候群，介紹其症狀概況，以及復 原治療的原則。第二是關於背叛創傷，探討由信任者所帶來的背叛，導致倖存者會盲視背叛。介紹關係背叛和體制背叛兩種形 式。第三是關於集體創傷，分別介紹四個案例：德國納粹的極權主義下，猶太倖存者的見證文學；台灣威權主義下的二二八事件 和白色恐怖統治；法國殖民主義下對非洲的殖民創傷；近期全球新冠肺炎疫情的創傷。

briefs.name: 電視製作的理論與實務
briefs.tags: 電視製作，Television Production，電視製作理論，電視製作實務，Camera movements
briefs.desc: 數位影音時代，利用影像傳遞訊息是一項迅速，有效，直接的溝通方式。本課程將各種攝影技巧，剪輯觀念，節目企劃，燈光，配樂，音 效，收音...等影像製作的理論知識與實務經驗，由淺入深的教授同學，期能以更成熟的技巧製作影像，創作出感動自己，也感動別人的好 作品。

briefs.name: 國際時事與英語溝通
briefs.tags: environment, democracy, free trade, peace, conflict
briefs.desc: 國際時事與英語溝通顧名思義是要透過閱讀英文文獻，討論目前的國際時事。學生不僅在課堂上要學習說英語，也要 透過對議題的回應，訓練個人的觀察及分析能力。每位學生除了上課時的參與外，還要寫四篇兩頁的報告，讓老師有 機會協助改進發音及寫作能力。 Current Events and English Communication is by name a course designed to discuss current English international events by reading English language news reports and analysis by experts. Students are expected to learn to read and speak English in the class. They will also get to trained to improve their observation and analytical ability through response of each topic. In addition to class participation, a student has to turn in 4 two-page report to allow the professor an opportunity to assist in pronunciation and writing skill.

briefs.name: 中國神話故事選讀
briefs.tags: 中國神話、三海經、伏羲、女媧、黃帝
briefs.desc: 人人喜歡聽故事，因為在那些奇幻與超現實的想像國度裡，思緒可以依循著故事的腳步，無拘無束地翱翔，正因為如此，我們時 常可以看見先秦諸子、史官、小說家以故事為法，闡述深奧難懂的哲理意涵。 神話的本質就是故事，精采的中國神話故事，可能是某個理想的寄託，或是某種價值認知的建構。本課程以中國神話故事為內 容，主要就是藉此說明中國傳統的價值觀，同時也期望學生能因此更加瞭解我們的文化思想精隨。

briefs.name: 西洋數學史
briefs.nameEn: History and Philosophy of Western Mathematics
briefs.tags: history of mathematics, European mathematics, Greek philosophy and mathematics, philosophy of mathematics, geometry, calculus
briefs.desc: This course introduces the logic and development of Western (mainly European) mathematics, from ancient Egyptian and Babylonian mathematics, to Greek legacies (especially philosophies of mathematics and Euclid’s Elements), through medieval Islamic and European mathematics and Renaissance developments, to the invention of modern calculus. Except mathematics per se, this course also discusses the interactions between mathematics and society in Western civilisations. For example, in ancient Egyptian and Babylonian societies, what kind of people participated in mathematical activities? Did they have similar or distinct mathematical conceptions from those in modern times? How did Greek philosophies help shape the forms and contents of Euclidean geometry? What was the relationship between Islamic culture and their mathematics? Also, we discuss the concept developments of modern calculus.

briefs.name: 廣告學概論
briefs.tags: 廣告學基本概念、起源,廣告製作流程,廣告與消費者行為,廣告與行銷傳播,廣告與創意,廣告與媒體投放,廣告企劃實務,公共關係與廣告,廣告與法律
briefs.desc: 從社會學與心理學的橫切面建構廣告學的基礎與經濟效益,並深入淺出， 介紹廣告的起源,功能,作業流程,廣告與消費者行為, 廣告創意企劃製作, 最後將帶領同學討論廣告學所衍生的品牌管理,公關,整合行銷傳播(IMC), 網路行銷及AI等新領域對廣告 產業之影響。

briefs.name: 電影配樂發展史與風格賞析
briefs.nameEn: The History of Film Scoring--Analysis and Development
briefs.tags: 電影配樂、好萊塢、 管弦樂團、 聲音產業、 台灣國片
briefs.desc: 此課程主要內容為: 電影配樂發展史與風格賞析。16 週的課程會循序漸進地從電影配樂的三大要素開始講起，配合好萊塢電影配樂不同的主要時 期，從早期的後浪漫時期到合成器與世界音樂元素運用，分別研討其中之歷史沿革與配樂風格分析。每一時期皆會以最具代表性的作品與配樂家 做為研討實例，比較討論其中之脈絡與創作風格。最後的專題研討部分則會選擇三位台灣目前最具代表性的電影配樂編曲家，分析比較台灣電影 配樂現況與好萊塢之差異。

briefs.tags: 電影配樂、好萊塢、 管弦樂團、 聲音產業、 台灣國片

briefs.name: 歌劇欣賞--普契尼
briefs.tags: #歌劇，＃普契尼，＃波希米亞人，＃托斯卡，＃蝴蝶夫人，＃杜蘭朵，＃Opera, #Puccini
briefs.desc: 本課程為一針對非音樂科系學生所開設之歌劇欣賞課程，提供學生在理工為主的大學課程裡一個思索人文藝術的空間。引導學生欣賞音樂、瞭解音樂及接觸音樂。進而主動蒐集資料並參與音樂活動。日後成為藝術欣賞的中堅人口，並提升整體藝術品質。 內容以西洋歌劇為主，每一學期以一重要時期或作曲家為主。諸如莫札特、美聲時期歌劇、威爾第、華格納、普契尼、近代歌劇等。每學期原則上欣賞四部完整歌劇，介紹演出方式、製作過程、欣賞方向、人聲分類及演出創作背景。希望藉由此種方式，讓一般愛樂者不因語言隔閡，認識此種綜合音樂、文學、戲劇、人聲之美好藝術。學生可依其意願，自由選擇修習分段課程。 上課方式採取教師講述及學生分組報告方式交互進行，提供學生充分參與的可能 性，學習相關資料之蒐集，並有機會與教師充分交換意見。

briefs.name: 高科技人力資源管理--基礎與實務應用
briefs.nameEn: Human Resource Management-- fundamentals and Practice
briefs.tags: 人力資源管理、人才發展、領導力、職涯發展與職涯管理、企業倫理 台灣經濟發展史與全球人力資源管理的發展、企業人力資源管理運作、組織文化、績效管理、薪酬管理制度、職稱職等設計、 領導力-管理技能、領導力-團隊建立、職場溝通 、企業倫理、職涯發展。 員工激勵制度、人才發展與員工訓練、員工關係、招募計畫 Human Resource Management, Talent Development，Company Culture， Leadership Career Development and Career Ma
briefs.desc: 課程說明 綜觀全球商業環境的脈動，當今充滿競爭與變化的年代，全球人才的需求與競選更為白熱化。因此，取得人才培訓發展的最新 趨勢是企業組織的首要目標，也是高等教育責無旁貸的一門學科與橋樑。本課程重在重在企業人力資源管理與發展的相關議 題，包括組織文化與效能、領導力、人才分析、團隊建立、人力資源實務、未來工作趨勢和產業洞察及全球化等。同時，課程 中也注入Z世代 (社會新鮮人) 對於組織文化的認知與職場人與事的關係維護思維與探討。 授課解說 本課程以老師在企業從事人力資源高階主主管多年的經驗、講授企業勞資個案的涉獵與專業知識，透過課程設計與實分享，協 助同學在進入職場前了解競爭新境界，為學生帶來實質的影響力。 本課程講授人力資源管理的基礎與應用知識，講授人力資源管理的發展與未來，以最新學術著作為教材講授，並依課程內容加 入企業相關個案探討。課程擬設計多元，擬幫助學生成為社會新鮮人的職前學習與準備。

briefs.name: 歐洲政府與政治
briefs.tags: 歐洲政府與政治
briefs.desc: 本課程「歐洲政府與政治」主要在介紹歐洲的政治制度特色，而整個歐洲國家的政治制度又可劃分為「議會內閣制」與 「雙首長制」等兩大類；此外，若就歐洲各國的權力大小與影響力強弱來做比較的話，德國、英國與法國可以說是歐洲三個 最重要的領導國家；因此，本課程將以德國與英國的「議會內閣制」，以及法國的「雙首長制」為範例說明歐洲國家的政治 制度特點。 更值得一提的是，德國是歐盟會員國，因此，在國際社會上漸漸扮演重要政經角色的歐盟，其組織結構與運作方式如何？德 國又是如何透過歐盟制度與程序將其國家偏好投射到歐洲層面，並與其他歐盟會員國合作制定共同政策呢？是故，本課程聚 焦剖析德國與歐盟的政治制度差異，並利用媒體與時事議題來補充闡釋德國與歐盟的政治運作與發展。而在課程操作上，本 課程將採取業師講授、分組討論與視聽教學的方式，帶領學生系統性探討德國與歐盟政治制度的本質、發展與影響，進而提 升學生對歐洲政治的興趣與暸解，並增加學生的政治知識與分析判斷能力。

briefs.name: 職場溝通學
briefs.tags: 溝通(Comminications),職場溝通(Business Communications),管理學(Management),行銷學(Marketing),個案討論(Case Study)
briefs.desc: 課堂上以理論結合實務，採個案教學方法論為主，以期達到目的如下： 1. 從理論連結實務，使學生習得溝通管理之內化及應用 2. 培養學生良好的品格與正確的職場競爭觀念、及思辨整合能力在企業內外部擁有溝通能力 3. 形塑感謝文化及雙向討論之上課型態，訓練學生於企業進行溝通、提問乃至於簡報之能力教師將於課堂上講解相關的議 題，學生參與討論。 4. 期末考分組報告微影片之設計概念：整個「職場溝通學」設計便是以期末考分組報告為畫龍點睛，以期同學回顧清華園的 學習及生活、人際歷程，進行期末報告目標聽眾(Target Audience)的選定，如潛在會選擇清華的高三學生、清華畢業生、 在校同學、校友等，預設目標聽眾期待反應及評估結果。以期通過微影片的故事線設計，讓上述目標聽眾得以共鳴感動。此 部分的歷程將引導學生進行反顧與省思，將在清華時期的感動以影像的方式創造與紀錄，亦將有助於職場面試時的整體內化 呈現。

briefs.name: 性別思考
briefs.tags: 性別研究, 平等, 自由, 公平, 女性主義, 創新, 整全思考, 合理多元價值觀, 實踐, 批判, 社會邏輯, 領導管理, 公共事務, Gender Studies, Equality, Freedom, Fairness, Feminism, Innovation, Integrated Thinking, Reasonable Pluralism, Practice, Critique, Social Logic, Leadership and Management, Public Affairs
briefs.desc: 性別無處不在，影響甚鉅，但是許多人卻看不到，誤解也頗多。本課程介紹性別基礎概念，帶領同學逐步覺察性別在許多不同脈 絡當中的無形及有形的作用，例如思想概念、知識生產、社會位置、權力享有、關係倫理、日常生活、個別身體、文化認同等， 再進一步評判這些作用之適當性。課程協助參與者打開或者造就性別之眼之餘，亦著重引導其反思性別平等的意義、培養其對於 性別的正確認識、能夠適當地運用性別分析於研究與生活脈絡，擁有真正客觀、公平待人與做自己的能力。

briefs.name: 產業創新與生涯探索
briefs.tags: 產業創新、生涯探索、社會實踐
briefs.desc: 產業創新是一種嘗試超越產業現況的努力，作為開創者與先行者， 創新產業大抵都有他們對社會的觀察與思考。了解產業創新 的 歷程，將會隨之探究台灣產業的整體面貌，並由此釐清並定位自己在世界中的位置。

briefs.name: 有趣的粒子物理簡介
briefs.tags: 標準模型The Standard Model,基本粒子Elementary Particles,微中子物理Neutrino Physics,對撞機物理Collider Physics,暗物質Dark Matter
briefs.desc: 地球上的萬物皆由原子與分子構築而成，而原子內部則包裹著我們熟知的電子、質子與中子。然而，這並非微觀世界的全貌。隨著科學家對 宇宙射線的觀測以及高能對撞機實驗的推進，一個更為宏大的粒子家族正逐步顯影——從組成核子的「夸克（quark）」、同樣由夸克構成的 「介子（meson）」、與電子性質相似卻更沉重的「渺子（muon）」，到行蹤如幽靈般、質量極輕的「微中子（neutrino）」。 為了拼湊這幅微觀宇宙的拼圖，科學家建立了當代物理的基石——「標準模型（the Standard Model）」，用以預測現存粒子及其相互作用 力。隨著2012年大強子對撞機成功觀測到「希格斯粒子（Higgs particle）」，標準模型所預測的粒子已全數被實驗證實。本課程將依序 帶領同學認識這些已知的基本粒子、探討經典的物理實驗，並剖析其中引人入勝的科學現象；最後，我們也將眺望未來，共同探索那些理論 上存在、卻至今尚未被觀測到的神祕未知物質。R32;

briefs.name: 消費者保護之理論與實務
briefs.nameEn: The Theory and Practice of Consumer Protection Law
briefs.tags: 產品責任,懲罰性賠償金,定型化契約,引人錯誤虛偽不實,特種交易
briefs.desc: 本課程主要以案例事實開場，希望透過案例解析，讓同學們可以了解如何處理具體消費爭議個案。然後再引申相關的消費者保護 理論及實務判決予以補充說明，期使同學在上完本課程後，可以建立最基本的消費者保護理論的概念。尤其在大學時期就能以深 入淺出方式研習消費者保護法，認識消費者保護法不再只是一種學問，更是生活常識的一部份；由於人人均為消費者，所以每一 位消費者均須學習消費者保護法，才能有效保障其應有權益，其效果必能事半功倍。因此本課程內容 除對消費者保護權利之理 論 基礎作論述外，重在現實(或近日)實務上發生的真實案例解決，並提示法律爭議破解及防範之道。

briefs.name: 旅溯雙城：台南與新竹的自然與人文
briefs.nameEn: A Brief Fieldwork to Tainan and Hsinchu’s Nature and Histories
briefs.tags: Historical Fieldwork, Tainan, Hsinchu, geological survey, 跨領域
briefs.desc: 1.本課程以台南與新竹作為學習的現場，結合清華大學與成功大學的師資與資源，以兩校師生共學的模式，組成旅讀雙城課 程。課程內容主要依照台灣城市發展的脈絡進行，因此由府城(台南)到竹塹(新竹)正好是台灣歷史的重要議題。藉由雙城的 學習範圍，課程將討論台灣由南到北的自然與資源特色，以及生活與產業的連動關係，並思考漢人開發過程與原住民交融、 地方動亂以及被殖民的經驗。同時，本課程也透過田野調查的過程指導學習者觀察、統整與觸發的能力，不只是讓學習者作 為一個知識的接收者，更讓學習者理解如何創造知識與分享知識。課程也藉由自然與人文的實地觀察，讓學習者參與到地 方，由田野中體知地方的問題，並創發解決方案。 2.本課程為跨校、跨領域課程。由清華大學通識中心與成功大學踏溯台南辦公室合開共授，成員包括兩校師生。課程學習 後，學習者最少得到四個層次的知識與能力。其一、從多學科角度理解地方知識；其二、連結學術與研究現場的印證關係； 其三、學習觀察、探究與實作的基礎研究能力。其四、比較與接受多元觀點。透過這四個層次的學習，使學習者具有進一步 反思經濟成長、環境保護與社會進步等相關議題的基礎學養，並擁有解決問題的能力。

briefs.name: 認識甲骨文字與古代中國文化
briefs.nameEn: Oracle Bone Scripts and Ancient Chinese Culture
briefs.tags: 甲骨文,金文,考古,中國,古文字,中國考古學,漢字,考古學,文化史,歷史,漢字
briefs.desc: 本課程從中國考古學、器物研究、甲骨文字學和古代文獻的多元視角介紹目前已被釋讀且較無爭議之甲骨文字和商、周時期 金文的造字初意與發展脈絡，以及文字後續在隸變前的變化。課程主題根據文字的造字初義和性質區分為十四大類，包含 （1）商代考古、（2）人鬼巫、（3）人體、（4）生老病死、（5）商周青銅器、（6）兵器戰爭、（7）刑罰、（8）大自然、（9）動 物、（10）狩獵與農業、（11）食衣、（12）住行、（13）育樂，和（14）商業貨幣度量衡，共約1400餘字；其餘授課主題包括 甲骨文字的發現、文字起源和甲骨占卜與刻寫等基礎認識，以及甲骨文的龍字與「龍」的起源與形成這個特別專題。本課程 亦規畫有中央研究院歷史文物陳列館的校外教學，期透過文物觀察加深學習印象。學員可透過本課程充分了解到漢字的起源 與造字創意，同時對中國古代氣候環境、文化形成發展、工藝技術發展、戰爭形態、兵器發展、古代藝術呈現、宗教禮儀、 生死觀信仰等方面有更廣泛的了解。

briefs.name: 致命優雅: 自然界毒物之迷思、醫學與奧秘
briefs.nameEn: Deadly Elegance: Myths, Medicine and Wonders of Poisons from Nature
briefs.tags: Poison, 毒物; Toxin, 毒素; Pharmacology, 藥理; Toxicology, 毒理; Snake venom, 蛇毒
briefs.desc: Life begets life, and diversifies—such is the wonder of nature, filling the Earth with an abundance of resources, including poisons and venoms. Known by different names across cultures—毒, racun, bisa, and others—these bioactive molecules have been honed by evolution over millions of years, achieving remarkable precision and function. As one of nature’s most successful biochemical arsenals, poisons and venoms have enabled countless organisms to hunt, defend, and ultimately ensure their survival. To humans, poisons and venoms evoke both fear and fascination. To fear, or to love? Their lethal potential has the power to harm and heal, weaving a complex narrative of life and death throughout human history. From ancient hunters applying toxins to their arrows, to modern physicians using them to heal patients, these extraordinary substances have left an indelible mark on our world.
